izzyondroid:com.nostros.name: Nostros
izzyondroid:com.nostros.summary: Nostr client on Android. The only and truly uncensored social network.
izzyondroid:com.nostros.description:
Nostros is a nostr client for Android and nostr is a protocol that allows you to create a censorship-resistant social network.
 In Nostros you can create your keys to access nostr and start interacting with other people. Below we explain what you can do in nostr using Nostros.
 Functionalities: Post notes with text and images. You can indicate whether your note contains sensitive content so that other people who don't want to see it can filter that content.
 Reward other people with tips through the Lightning Network.
 Read other people's notes and react to them indicating: I like it or I don't like it.
 Share or quote other people's notes, just share or share them by adding your quote.
 Threads of conversation in the notes.
 Create and join public groups. Mute users.
 Visualizes in which relays a note has been seen by means of a color code.
 Activate or deactivate relays for your global feed.
 Block other people.
 Write private and encrypted messages to another person from nostr.
 View the feed of the people you follow or view the global feed, where you will see all the notes published in the relays to which you are connected.
 Do not miss anything by accessing the notifications section, where you can see all the interactions that other people have had with you.
 Add and follow other people on us or unfollow them.
 See all the people you follow and also those who follow you.
 Visualize by colors in which relays each note is.
 Verify yourself with NIP05.
 Add your Lightning Address to your profile so other people can send you Bitcoin tips through the Lightning Network.
 Set your preferred satoshi symbol.
 Global app settings: show or hide images in the global feed, show or hide notes with sensitive content.
 Manage the connections to the relays: add, delete, activate, deactivate and view the information of the relay.
 Nostros has his own database which reduces data consumption considerably and is relay friendly.
 Nostros is an open source project in full development, so we encourage you to contribute to the project.
 Before accessing nostr remember that in order to do so you have to generate a pair of keys: the private key and the public key. Summarizing it a lot, a public key is a password to access nostr in "read-only" mode, it will also help you share it with other people so they can follow you. The private key is like your password, by accessing us with it you will be able to publish and interact with other people's content.
 You can create your key pair when accessing the Nostros app, but remember to keep your private key in a safe place, it is the only way to recover your account and it will be impossible to do so if you lose it.
 If you want to know more about nostr you can visit the official repository on GitHub, where you will find all the information you need:
 https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nostr If you feel like contributing your skills to the project you can do so through the GitHub repository:
 https://github.com/KoalaSat/nostros Find the official Nostros account on nostr by adding this public key:
 npub19l0cks7zmf6sz062peqlq277zmuskhgad58lgnr2awpp3t95esfstaws8n

izzyondroid:com.viscouspot.gitsync.name: GitSync
izzyondroid:com.viscouspot.gitsync.summary: Git client for syncing a repository between remote and a local directory
izzyondroid:com.viscouspot.gitsync.description:
GitSync is an Android git client that aims to simplify the process of syncing a folder between a git remote and a local directory. It works in the background to keep your files synced with a simple one-time setup and a range of options for activating manual syncs.
 Supports Android 5+
 Authenticate with HTTP/S
 SSH
 OAuth (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea)
 Clone a remote repository
 Sync repository Fetch, pull, stage, commit, push
 Resolve merge conflicts
 Retry automatically when the network returns
 Sync mechanisms When an app is opened or closed
 On a recurring schedule
 From a Quick Settings tile
 From a home screen widget
 From a custom intent (advanced)
 Browse and edit in-app File explorer with code editor and image viewer
 Recent commits, plus file, line and commit diffs
 Branch management
 Multiple remotes
 GitHub and GitLab integration (when signed in via OAuth) View, comment on and create issues
 View, comment on and create pull requests
 View workflow runs (GitHub Actions)
 AI features Chat about your repository
 Wand auto-complete on text fields like commit messages
 Agent that can run repo actions for you
 A global toggle to hide all AI features
 Manage multiple repositories with containers
 Repository settings Signed commits
 Customisable sync commit messages
 Author details
 Edit .gitignore & .git/info/exclude
 Disable SSL verification per repo
 Accessibility Service Disclosure 
 To enhance your experience, GitSync uses Android's Accessibility Service to detect when apps are opened or closed. This helps us provide tailored features without storing or sharing any data.
 Key Points:
 Purpose: We use this service solely to improve your app experience.
 Privacy: No data is stored or sent elsewhere.
 Control: You can disable these permissions at any time in your device settings.

fdroid:com.anshlabs.miles.description:
MILES is a privacy-first activity and step tracker for Android. Every number it shows comes from real sensors — the pedometer, GPS and your own heart rate — or it isn't shown at all.
Features:

No Google Play Services required. No proprietary map SDK: maps use OpenStreetMap data, with satellite imagery from Esri World Imagery.

fdroid:com.cookiesextractor.app.name: Cookie Extractor
fdroid:com.cookiesextractor.app.summary: Extract your own session cookies after a manual login
fdroid:com.cookiesextractor.app.description:
A developer tool for inspecting and verifying session information.
Headless automation is increasingly blocked by 2FA QR codes, interactive
challenges, and anti-bot flows. This app takes the other road: you log in
by hand, exactly like in a normal browser, then one tap pulls the session
cookies for the loaded domain and hands them to the Android share sheet,
ready for curl, wget, or any script that needs an authenticated session.
What is inside:
- Address bar and in-app WebView; log in with password, 2FA, OTP, or most
 SSO-redirect flows. Passkeys for third-party sites do not work in a
 third-party WebView (Android privilege model); the README explains why.
- Non-http OAuth redirects are caught before an error page appears and
 shared as one line, so relays cannot corrupt the authorization code.
- A share template with live preview shapes the shared text: placeholders
 for payload, URL, title, host, and date, for example a ready-to-paste
 curl command.
- Bookmarks with add-by-URL and entry-URL memory: what you typed, not
 where the redirect landed.
- A session monitor: point it at a state document on your own gateway and
 get a native notification when a login expires.
- An opt-in, token-gated debug channel with a versioned agent API
 (/api/v1) to drive the app programmatically: navigate, read text and
 cookies, fill and submit forms. Off by default; the README documents
 every endpoint and the threat model.
It reads only the cookies of its own WebView through the public
CookieManager API: no root, no cross-app access, no automation of other
apps. Extracted cookies are session credentials; share them only over
channels you trust.
Licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

fdroid:com.hwloc.lstopo.name: hwloc lstopo
fdroid:com.hwloc.lstopo.summary: Display the topology of your hardware using the hwloc library and lstopo tool
fdroid:com.hwloc.lstopo.description:
The Portable Hardware Locality (hwloc) software package provides a portable abstraction (across OS, versions, architectures, ...) of the hierarchical topology of modern architectures, including NUMA memory nodes, sockets, shared caches, cores and simultaneous multithreading. It also gathers various system attributes such as cache and memory information as well as the locality of I/O devices such as network interfaces, InfiniBand HCAs or GPUs.
hwloc primarily aims at helping applications with gathering information about increasingly complex parallel computing platforms so as to exploit them accordingly and efficiently. For instance, two tasks that tightly cooperate should probably be placed onto cores sharing a cache. However, two independent memory-intensive tasks should better be spread out onto different sockets so as to maximize their memory throughput.

Esca Agnellis is a local Android app for friendly, low-pressure food-pyramid tracking.

Portion information is general orientation only. The standard pyramid and portion guidance use publicly available BZfE food-pyramid information as their data basis, current as of 25 September 2024. Esca Agnellis is an independent digital implementation, uses no BZfE/BLE artwork, and is not affiliated with, endorsed, supported, or sponsored by BZfE or BLE. The app is not medical, dietary, or individualized nutritional advice.
The application code and build scripts are free software under GPL-3.0-only.

fdroid:com.revold1985.secureqrshare.name: Secure QR Share
fdroid:com.revold1985.secureqrshare.summary: Share passwords and links securely via encrypted QR codes.
fdroid:com.revold1985.secureqrshare.description:
Secure QR Share lets you send passwords, PINs, and sensitive text to someone nearby without typing, screenshots, or cloud services — just a QR code.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Sender enters text or a password and chooses a shared PIN.
2. The app encrypts the payload with AES-256 and displays a QR code.
3. Receiver scans the code with Secure QR Share, enters the same PIN, and the original text is instantly decrypted and copied to the clipboard.
FEATURES
• AES-256-CBC encryption with PIN-derived keys — no server, no cloud
• Works fully offline — no internet permission required at runtime
• Share sheet integration — highlight text anywhere and share directly into the app
• App Links support — QR codes can be opened from the camera or browser
• Optional unencrypted mode for non-sensitive public links
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no accounts
PRIVACY
Secure QR Share never transmits your data. Everything is processed locally on your device. The encryption key is derived from your PIN and never stored or sent anywhere.
OPEN SOURCE
The full source code is available on GitHub under the MIT license.

fdroid:com.southerntemp.thermocouples.name: Thermocouples
fdroid:com.southerntemp.thermocouples.description:
Thermocouples is a reference guide to get general information on thermocouples for all those in the industry that regularly deal with thermal sensors.
This handy app features the colour codes for a wide range of thermocouples in a wide range of standards on easy to see images. The shown standards are IEC, BS, ANSI, NFE, DIN, and JIS.
The included thermocouples are B, E, J, K, N, R, S, T, U, Vx.
Main features:
* Shows thermocouples colours for 10 thermocouples across 6 standards.
* Information on range, conductor materials and compensates.
* Search thermocouples by conductor colours to find type and colour code.
* Temperature converter with °C, °F and K.
* Cold junction °C to mV calculator.
* Modern design.
* Open-source via the MIT licence.
* mV to °C converter using NIST values for main thermocouple types.
Thermocouples is open source. The source can be found at:
https://codeberg.org/danb/Thermocouples
Feel free to create a pull request or open issues there.
This app is 100% free with no "upgrade", "pro" or "unlocked" versions.
This app requires no permissions and does not use any user data.
Remarks:
This application is for quick reference use only, there may be errors or inaccuracies although I try to ensure the information is as accurate as possible. Me, the app maker, or the company advertised, STS, will not be held liable for any misinformation or misjudgement as a result of using this app.

fdroid:de.storchp.fdroidbuildstatus.description:
Android App for the F-Droid build status API.
Features

fdroid:dev.tagmacro.name: TagMacro
fdroid:dev.tagmacro.summary: Tap an NFC tag to run actions, or write tags for Wi-Fi, links and contacts
fdroid:dev.tagmacro.description:
TagMacro turns cheap NFC stickers into buttons. Tap a tag with your phone and it runs a list of actions you chose: silence the phone at bedtime, tell someone you got home, start a timer, open your maps app in the car, or note when you fed the cat.
It is also a complete tag tool: read any tag, and write links, Wi-Fi details, contact cards and more that work on any phone, with no app needed.
 Private by design 
 No internet permission. Android does not let TagMacro open a network connection at all.
 No ads, no trackers, no analytics, and no libraries beyond the Android framework and Kotlin's standard library.
 Macro tags hold only a random code: the macro and its messages stay on your phone. (Tags you write with the tag tools, such as Wi-Fi details or contact cards, contain that information, so anyone who taps them can read it.)
 Every permission is optional and only requested for the actions that need it.
 Actions 
 Messages and calls: send an SMS, call a number, send a Signal or WhatsApp message, share live location on WhatsApp
 Sound: ringer mode, Do Not Disturb, volumes, play/pause/next
 Screen and device: brightness, screen timeout, auto-rotate, flashlight, lock screen, Wi-Fi/NFC/volume panels
 Apps and places: open an app, open a link, get directions
 Time: alarms, timers, waits
 Feedback and notes: on-screen message, speech, vibration, clipboard, and a journal that records when things happen
 Run another macro
Messages can include the time, date, battery level or a map link to where you are.
 Triggers and conditions 
 A tag written by TagMacro, any tag or card by its serial number, or a home screen shortcut
 Ask before running, cooldowns, time-of-day windows and days of the week
 Tag tools 
 Read: chip type, capacity, lock state, every record, and which macro a tag runs
 Write: links, Wi-Fi networks, contact cards, map locations, phone numbers, SMS, email, text, app launchers
 Erase, format and permanently lock tags
 Also 
Ready-made templates, a run log that shows each step, journal export to CSV, and full backup and restore.
 Good to know 
Signal, WhatsApp and lock-screen actions use an accessibility service that only receives events from Signal and WhatsApp and only acts while a macro is running. WhatsApp's terms forbid automated messaging, so use those actions at your own risk. Android does not allow apps to switch Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, mobile data or airplane mode on or off.

fdroid:fr.kooksession.app.name: KOOK SESSION
fdroid:fr.kooksession.app.summary: Surf and wingfoil session logbook, stored in your own Nextcloud
fdroid:fr.kooksession.app.description:
KOOK SESSION is a logbook for surfers, wingfoilers and other water sports lovers. Log every session with its conditions, keep track of your spots and your quiver, and learn from your own statistics.
 Your data stays in your Nextcloud. The app works with the KOOK SESSION app for Nextcloud, which must be installed on your server. There is no account with a third-party service, no advertising and no tracking. The app works online only: nothing is stored on the phone except your sign-in details, encrypted with the Android Keystore.
 Sessions 
 Date, start and end time (duration computed), sport, spot, 1 to 5 stars, comment
 Number of waves or distance, maximum speed in knots and km/h, equipment used, buddies
 One photo and one video per session, from the camera or the gallery, saved in your Nextcloud Files
 Filters by year, sport, spot, rating, equipment and buddy
 GPS tracks 
 Import a GPX file (Garmin Connect, Strava, phone apps) or an IGC file into a session: map of the track, distance, duration and maximum speed
 Empty fields are filled in from the track (date, times, distance, speed, sport, nearest spot); a spot can be created at the start of the track
 Help explains how to export a track from Garmin Connect; tracks are analysed by your Nextcloud server (KOOK SESSION 1.3.0 or later)
 Conditions 
 Swell height and period, tide reference, offset and coefficient
 Wind direction on a touch wind rose, wind and gusts in knots or Beaufort force, with km/h conversion
 Water and air temperature
 Spots, quiver, buddies 
 Map of your spots (OpenStreetMap), place search, draggable marker, up to 4 photos per spot
 Boards (dimensions in feet and inches with metric conversion, volume), wings, foils, wetsuits, up to 4 photos each
 Preferences: add your own sports, equipment types and wetsuit thicknesses
 Sharing (KOOK SESSION 1.4.0 or later on Nextcloud)
 Share a session, a spot, a piece of equipment or your statistics as a message
 Read-only public link for friends without Nextcloud, valid 24 hours or 7 days, revocable
 Send a copy to another user of your Nextcloud; received items are in the ⋮ menu > Sharing
 Statistics 
 Favourite spot, sessions per month, time on the water
 5-star sessions, equipment by conditions, ideal conditions per spot, personal records (including highest speed)
Sign-in uses Nextcloud's Login Flow: enter your server address and approve the app. The app password can be revoked at any time in your Nextcloud security settings.
Available in English and French. Maps use OpenStreetMap tiles and Nominatim place search.
This app was developed with the help of Claude, an AI assistant by Anthropic.

fdroid:io.github.mimoguz.tripeaksneue.name: TriPeaks NEUE
fdroid:io.github.mimoguz.tripeaksneue.description:
A simple Tri Peaks patience (solitaire) game.
This is a remake of tripeaks-gdx project, my previous implementation of the same game.
Main Features:

fdroid:me.biplobsd.rsm.name: Running Services Monitor
fdroid:me.biplobsd.rsm.summary: Monitor running services on your Android device with Root or Shizuku
fdroid:me.biplobsd.rsm.description:
Running Services Monitor helps you monitor running services on your Android device. With a clean and intuitive interface, you can easily view system and user apps and check their status efficiently.
 Features 
* Monitor Running Services: View a comprehensive list of all running services on your device
* Categorized View: Easily switch between All, User, and System apps
* Search Functionality: Quickly find specific apps with the built-in search bar
* App Details: Get detailed information about each app, including package name, version, and more
* Root & Shizuku Integration: First checks for root permission, then falls back to Shizuku for advanced system interactions (where supported)
* Material Design 3: A modern and beautiful UI that adapts to your device's theme
* Dark/Light Mode: Toggle between dark and light themes for comfortable viewing
* Localization: Support for English, Bangla, Chinese languages
 Requirements 
Essential:
* Android 7.0 (API 24) or higher
* Root access (preferred) OR Shizuku app installed and running
Permissions:
* QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES - To list all installed apps
* Root permission OR Shizuku permission - The app first checks for root access, then falls back to Shizuku if root is unavailable
 How It Works 
This app uses root access or Shizuku to execute privileged ADB commands. Starting from Android 8.0 (API 26), the `ActivityManager.getRunningServices()` API was deprecated and restricted. Third-party apps can no longer query all running services on the device for privacy and security reasons.
Root access provides the most seamless experience with direct access to system commands and no additional setup required.
Shizuku provides an alternative for non-rooted devices by running a privileged service that can access system APIs, allowing apps to execute ADB commands without root, working on non-rooted devices via Wireless Debugging (Android 11+) or USB ADB.
The app checks for root permission first, and if not available, falls back to Shizuku. It executes `dumpsys activity services` to get running service information, parses the output to extract service details (package name, PID, process name, etc.), and categorizes services into System and User categories.
 Limitations 
* Due to Android security policies, some service information may be limited
* When using Shizuku, the service stops when device reboots
* Dumpsys output format may vary across Android versions
* This app only displays services; it cannot start/stop them
This app is designed for users who want to monitor running services on their device, similar to the "Running Services" feature that was available in Android Developer Options in older Android versions.

flathub:io.github.loot.loot.name: LOOT

flathub:io.github.loot.loot.description:
LOOT is a plugin load order optimiser for:
 Starfield
 The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind
 The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion
 The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
 The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
 The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition (and Anniversary Edition)
 The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim VR
 Fallout 3
 Fallout: New Vegas
 Fallout 4
 Fallout 4 VR
 Nehrim: At Fate's Edge
 Enderal: Forgotten Stories
 Enderal: Forgotten Stories (Special Edition)
 OpenMW
 LOOT can automatically calculate a load order that satisfies all plugin dependencies and maximises each plugin's impact on your game. It can also detect many issues, and provides a large number of plugin-specific usage notes, warnings and Bash Tag suggestions for Wrye Bash.
 While LOOT can correctly handle the vast majority of plugins without help, some plugins need additional metadata to be sorted correctly. LOOT has a masterlist of metadata for each supported game, and you can add more to customise LOOT's behaviour.

It may be useful when you install some library/module/application manually - without having an RPM package. E.g., when you pip install somepackage And when some RPM package `Requires: python-somepackage` then /usr/bin/rpm refuses to install such package, because `python-somepackage` is not present on your system. RPMDB does not know what you know. So you can run: create-fake-rpm --build python-somepackage python3dist(somepackage) This create package `fake-python-somepackage-0-0.noarch.rpm` which provides: "python-somepackage" and "python3dist(somepackage)". fedora-packages:gfs-goschen-fonts/gfs-go.name: gfs-goschen-fonts

fedora-packages:gfs-goschen-fonts/gfs-go.description: Georg Joachim Göschen founded in 1782 the publishing house of G.J. Göschensche Verlagsbuchhandlung in Leipzig and was one of the most active publishers of the period in Germany. Göschen was very interested in typography, influenced by the fame and quality of the editions of G. Bodoni and F. Didot. In 1797, he collaborated with the leading scholar of the period, Johann Jakob Griesbach, to edit and publish the New Testament in Greek for which he formed a committee of scholars to decide the new Greek type which were eventually cut by Johann Prillwitz. The book appeared in 1803 and the types show many influences from the Greek types of Bodoni. Their characteristic was the neoclassical form of marked contrast between thick and thin strokes, the cursive style and the large size of the font. The design was too cumbersome to allow general use and can be considered successful only for its indirect influence on the later cut Greek Leipzig type. It is, however, part of the greater heritage of Greek type design and therefore the type has been digitized by George D. Matthiopoulos in 2009 and is part of GFS’ type library under the name GFS Göschen cursive, in commemoration of the great German publisher.

fedora-packages:python-git-revise/git-re.name: git-revise
fedora-packages:python-git-revise/git-re.summary: Efficiently update, split, and rearrange git commits
fedora-packages:python-git-revise/git-re.description: git revise is a git subcommand to efficiently update, split, and rearrange commits. It is heavily inspired by git rebase, however it tries to be more efficient and ergonomic for patch-stack oriented workflows. By default, git revise will apply staged changes to a target commit, then update HEAD to point at the revised history. It also supports splitting commits and rewording commit messages. Unlike git rebase, git revise avoids modifying the working directory or the index state, performing all merges in-memory and only writing them when necessary. This allows it to be significantly faster on large codebases and avoids unnecessarily invalidating builds.

firefox-addons:2847655.name: Sink It for Reddit
firefox-addons:2847655.summary: Upgrade your Reddit experience with color coded comments, easier nav, sub-reddit blocking, gestures for upvoting, ad+nag blocking, and more. It's like RES, for mobile!
firefox-addons:2847655.description:
Sink It for Reddit is a hyper focused extension that makes Reddit's web version usable. Features a ton of quality of life improvements including color coded comments, content muting, adaptive dark mode and more. Tired of seeing too many banners and buttons asking you to use the app or login? Sink It silently, and safely, removes all of them as well as the "promotional" content too! 
Make the "MODERN" Reddit Experience Usable
-------------------------------------------
Supercharge your Reddit experience with color coded comments, improved comments navigation, adaptive dark mode, content muting, and so much more. 
Sink It also de-clutters and removes most “omfg please use our app” banners and buttons as well as the annoying login popups from Reddit in addition to removing advertisements. Yeah, we loathe them too! 
Privacy First
--------------
Sink It has been built with a privacy first approach. 
- All the blocking happens on your device with literally ZERO data being recorded or sent back to be data mined. 
- We don't keep usage data like the count of how many popups and banners it has blocked or links it has redirected. 
- We don't even come with basic app analytics or telemetry to keep track of how many times you've opened or use the app. 
- It does check whether you have dark mode on or not so it can show you the correct tutorial video. (I hate opening a bright video on dark mode as much as you.)
If you're a security researcher, feel free to poke around to make sure the app isn't up to anything funky.

firefox-addons:3124277.name: sde.tools – Developer Tools
firefox-addons:3124277.summary: 70 developer tools that run entirely in your browser: encoders, converters, formatters, hashing, network calculators and more.
firefox-addons:3124277.description:
sde.tools puts 70 developer tools one click away in your browser. Every tool runs locally on your device: nothing you type, paste or upload is sent anywhere. The extension makes no network requests and asks for no access to the sites you visit.
HOW TO USE IT
• Click the toolbar icon (or press Alt+Shift+D) to search and use any tool in the popup.
• Open the full dashboard in a tab with Alt+Shift+T.
• Keep a tool open beside the page in the side panel.
• Select text on any page, right-click, and send it straight to a tool.
• Type "sde" and a space in the address bar to jump to a tool by name.
• Star your favorites; recently used tools stay at the top.
• Light, dark and system themes.
TOOLS INCLUDED
Encoding and conversion
Base64 text and file converter, JSON ⇄ YAML ⇄ TOML ⇄ XML, JSON to CSV, Markdown to HTML, case converter, color converter, date-time converter, integer base converter, text to binary, text to Unicode, NATO alphabet, list converter.
Web
JWT decoder, HTML entity encoder/decoder, JSON diff, basic auth header generator, meta tag generator, TOTP code generator and validator, MIME types, HTTP status codes, user-agent parser, keycode info, slugify, Safelink decoder, HTML WYSIWYG editor, device information.
Crypto and security
Hash generator (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and more), HMAC generator, bcrypt hash and check, text encryption and decryption, RSA key pair generator, BIP39 passphrase generator, ULID generator, password strength analyser, PDF signature checker.
Development
JSON formatter and viewer, JSON minify, regex tester, regex cheat sheet, cron expression generator, chmod calculator, docker run to docker compose converter, Git cheat sheet, email normalizer.
Network
IPv4 subnet calculator, IPv6 subnet calculator, IPv4 address converter, IPv4 range expander, IPv6 ULA generator, MAC address generator.
Text and data
Text diff, lorem ipsum generator, emoji picker, string obfuscator, numeronym generator, ASCII text drawer, IBAN validator, phone number parser and formatter.
Images and measurement
QR code generator, camera recorder, chronometer, benchmark builder.
PRIVACY
• No accounts, no analytics, no tracking.
• No host permissions: the extension cannot read or change the pages you visit.
• Settings, favorites and tool preferences are stored only in your browser.
• Text you send from the right-click menu is passed to the tool inside the extension and never leaves your device.
More tools and written guides for each one are available at https://sde.tools

firefox-addons:2662713.name: Download Twitter videos
firefox-addons:2662713.summary: Download videos, gifs, tweet photos, profile pictures, header banners, thumbnails, subtitles, color palettes, tags from Twitter.
firefox-addons:2662713.description:
[Required: Need create Twitter account and logged]
🚀 HOW DOES THIS TOOL WORK?
After you open this tool, a piece of code will be executed in the current tab. This code is responsible for analyzing the json code and find the id of the tweet currently showing on the screen. Tweets that do not appear in the screen frame are ignored.
After finding the video id, the tool continues to send a request to Twitter to get the json data. The download button will then show up below each tweet and inside the tools window.
Things you can download from each tweet include videos, gifs, every image in the tweet, detachable subtitles. You can view and enlarge avatars and banners with the highest quality. Easily copy palettes and tags in tweets.
Note: This tool only supports downloading files hosted by Twitter. This extension does not grant access to every website, so users cannot download videos from tweets embedded on other websites.
🚀 WHAT CAN THIS TOOL DO?
☀ Download Twitter video with caption.
☀ Convert Twitter video to mp4.
☀ Download video from Twitter.
☀ Download Twitter gif.
☀ Download Twitter broadcast.
☀ Download original images from Twitter.
☀ Twitter profile picture viewer.
☀ Twitter profile picture downloader.
☀ Download Twitter header image.
☀ Download Twitter thumbnails.
☀ Automatically download and save the file according to the title of the video and the selected quality.
☀ Multi language.
☀ Optimized for Android.
☀ Suggest queries.
☀ Generate random keywords.

It’s safe, convenient, fast and free.

bluejetty:00123091:ios.description:
It’s safe, convenient, fast and free. 
Enjoy a seamless mobile experience and manage your accounts on the go. Designed for either consumers or businesses, you’ll have instant access to your Presidential Bank, FSB accounts.
Use it to check your balances, transfer funds and more. It’s like having a branch at your fingertips.
Presidential customers must first sign up for Online Banking at https://www.presidential.com to utilize the app.
With the Presidential Bank mobile app you can :
Consumers can:
- View account balances and transaction history
- Transfer funds between your Presidential accounts or external accounts
- Pay bills 
- Move money to other people 
- View and activate Purchase Rewards
- Manage a debit card with card controls
- Make mobile check deposits
- Locate a branch and ATM
And Business users can:
- Log in securely with the same username and password you use on Presidential Bank, FSB.
- User access controls
- Text and voice approval options
- Check balances on your Presidential Bank, FSB business accounts
- View multi-TIN balances and create transactions
- Entitled account access: Entitlements enforced regardless of channel
- Transfer funds quickly and easily between your accounts
- Find locations and contact information for all of our convenient branches.
SAFE AND SECURE:
Presidential Bank’s Mobile App uses the latest encryption methods available. Just like in Online Banking, sign in with your secure credentials, where your login is protected by encryption technology. Users are logged out for inactivity or if the app is closed. Same account lockout features as online banking, apply.
Your mobile device carrier’s internet access and text messaging rates may apply.
FDIC insured.
To learn how we protect your privacy please visit https://www.presidential.com/deposit-rules-regulations/privacy-policy.

bluejetty:00160468:ios.description:
Stay up-to-date with the latest US lottery results with Lottery Tracker, the ultimate app for lottery enthusiasts. Whether you play Powerball, Mega Millions, or any other state lottery, our app provides real-time results, notifications, and comprehensive statistics to help you stay informed.
Key Features
 - Real-Time Results: Get the latest lottery results as soon as they're announced. Never miss a draw with instant updates.
 - Custom Notifications: Set up personalized notifications for your favorite lotteries. Receive alerts for draw results, upcoming jackpots, and more.
 - Historical Data: Access an archive of past lottery results. Analyze trends and patterns to make informed decisions for future draws.
 - Multi-State Coverage: Track results for all major US lotteries, including Powerball, Mega Millions, and state-specific games.
 - User-Friendly Interface: Navigate the app with ease thanks to its intuitive design. Quickly find the information you need, when you need it.
 - Lucky Numbers Generator: Need help picking numbers? Use our random number generator to create your lucky set.
 - Ticket Scanner: Simply scan your lottery ticket to check if you've won. Save time and avoid manual entry errors.
Our Lottery Tracker is designed for lottery players who want to stay on top of their game. With its comprehensive features, user-friendly interface, and real-time updates, this app ensures you never miss a chance to win big.

bluejetty:00185167:ios.description:
Get your metal guns ready and engage in the best shooting and action arcade game. It's time to call your soldiers to do their duty, as an army of renegade slugs has invaded an island and took control of it. Play with 4 brave soldiers, an epic squad of glorious commandos, heroes of previous war conflicts, choose your weapons, your vehicules (tanks, mechas...) and attack the ennemy in destructing battles.
Your soldiers will use their shooting skills in many battlefields (nite, days, indoor, outdoor, ...), but shooting only is not an option, you'll need to boost their capacities, as the forces of the ennemy's army will grow over and over. Make sure your soldiers guns booms the ennemies as more and more combatants will come to badly attack you.
Engage your metal squad in amazing battles and blow up all the ennemy army troops. Save the people on the island, rescue the hostages as they get prisonners within the ennemy vanguard, defend the country, and kill the ennemy commander in chief.
Your avengers will participate in many different misssions:
- Kill X ennemies in mega clash battles.
- Kill X ennemies in less than X seconds.
- Reach the helicopter rescue point (Capture the flag mode)
- Reach the helicopter rescue point in less than X minutes
- Defend the villagers
- Endless combat (infinity kills)
- Rescue the hostages
Engage in mega combats with different weapons such as knifes, guns, riffles, shotguns, flame throwers, rocket launchers, plasma guns, M16, uzi, MS2, ppkp, mp5, ak47, tanks, fighter planes,.... and many more.
Save the civils and survive in this fury riot... your goal is not to be missing in action... it's guns glory !

bluejetty:00075134:ios.name: My City: College Dorm Life
bluejetty:00075134:ios.summary:
The best college roleplay game, Enjoy and roleplay College life is fun!
Play mini-games, solve puzzles, and find hidden items in fun interactive dorm areas
•Reception Area: Go here to play mini-games with your friends or listen to a band
bluejetty:00075134:ios.description:
The best college roleplay game, Enjoy and roleplay College life is fun!
Play mini-games, solve puzzles, and find hidden items in fun interactive dorm areas
•Reception Area: Go here to play mini-games with your friends or listen to a band playing your favorite music.
•Living Room: You can cook and eat delicious meals with your friends. After that, why not spend the day watching your favorite cartoon shows on a big TV?
•Girls Room: This is where you can catch some sleep, study, play music together, and hang out with your friends.
•Nerds Room: Do you love gaming? This is the ultimate place to chill and have fun while playing video and computer games with your friends.
•COED Room: The best of both worlds – this room combines the most fun parts of the Girls Room and the Nerds Room.
•Study Room: Go here to do your homework and use the computers to do research. The best part? You can use the telescope to look at the stars!
•Rooftop: All the cool kids hang out here...playing fun mini-games or maybe making some juicy burgers.
•Pool Area: What better place to beat the heat? Go here to swim and play all your favorite water games.
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 5-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 12-year old to enjoy!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/mytowngames
Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00079746:ios.summary:
“Argus: Urban Legend" - An interactive horror thriller - Goosebumps guaranteed
A young woman contacts you with a desperate call for help! This will draw you deeper and deeper into a nerve-wracking story about murders, mysteries, urban lege
bluejetty:00079746:ios.description:
“Argus: Urban Legend" - An interactive horror thriller - Goosebumps guaranteed
A young woman contacts you with a desperate call for help! This will draw you deeper and deeper into a nerve-wracking story about murders, mysteries, urban legends and monsters.
It's up to YOU to find out if it's a human committing the murders or if a supernatural presence is responsible for them! The internet is full of reports about a gruesome creature called "Argus"...
Follow the clues and help a group of friends solve all the mysteries! But be on your guard, because ARGUS SEES EVERYTHING!
"Argus" is an interactive horror mystery game
Argus is YOUR story. Your decisions not only affect the course of the game, but also the ending of this thriller.
To make the gaming experience even more realistic, you can personalize the user profile with your name, gender, orientation and your own avatar.
Communicate with different characters via a messenger. Unravel the dark secrets surrounding ARGUS and other urban legends.
It's up to you to collect clues, solve puzzles and stop the horror.
But watch out because you can't trust everyone…
New features:
"Argus" comes with many new features! In addition to a customizable home screen, you can expect new, exciting apps, a new design and completely new ways to interact!

bluejetty:00152043:ios.name: Smart Screw Parking
bluejetty:00152043:ios.summary: During peak hours, the parking lot is packed with cars that can’t get out. You need to use your wisdom and logical thinking skills to carefully help them navigate through layers of obstacles, pick up the corresponding goods, and then drive
bluejetty:00152043:ios.description: During peak hours, the parking lot is packed with cars that can’t get out. You need to use your wisdom and logical thinking skills to carefully help them navigate through layers of obstacles, pick up the corresponding goods, and then drive onto the road. A gentle reminder: try to avoid hitting anything when moving the cars... However, you can also enjoy the fun of cars crashing into obstacles! bluejetty:00143726:ios.description:
- Bom Calendar, a unique period tracker you can customize
Get consistent with Bom Calendar! It’s the app you will want to see daily. Ever wondered when your next period will be? What about the chances of pregnancy? How about sexual interactions? Get the answers you want at any time with Bom Calendar. Customize everything from the calendar display, color, app icon, visibility, and order – all to your preference!
- Period, Schedule, To-Do List: All in One App
Accurate period tracking starts here. Add and manage your schedule and to-do-list with just one tap. Get notifications to keep up with your schedule, lunar calendar, and holidays. Save time and make your day more efficient with Bom Calendar.
- Accurate Pregnancy Probability and Period Cycle Estimation
Did you know only 6% of period tracker apps could accurately predict periods? Bom Calendar uses the same standard contraceptive guidelines and period calculation methods used by the American Board of OBGYN for a more accurate pregnancy probability and cycle prediction. 
Learn how to nurture your body. Bom Calendar tracks the female hormones that change daily to let you know what your mood is, your energy level, memory, focus, comprehension, cravings and more.
- Daily Updates About My Body condition
Let Bom Calendar help! Learn about the symptoms and causes of common illnesses for women and how to respond to them.
- My Special Doctor Keeping Up With My Health
It's easy to let your health slip with your busy day-to-day life. No more worries. With Bom Calendar, you can learn about the symptoms and causes of common illnesses for women and how to respond to them.
- Pregnancy Mode for Health Baby
Get weekly updates on the baby's size, the different changes in you and your baby and tips on what to do. Bom Calendar will support you until your baby comes.
- Easy Weight Tracking
No more complicated weight trackers! Simply enter your weight, and the app will show you the healthy weight range and BMI. Achieve your weight goals with Bom Calendar!
- Keep My Data More Securely and Conveniently
Use your email, Google or Apple accounts for an easy, fast sign-up process. We keep your user data safe on our secure server with an auto-backup/restore function even if you change your phone or reinstall our app.  - Share Your Calendar with a Special Someone
- Share Your Calendar with a Special Someone
Share your calendar to securely and easily share your days. You can customize what information you want to send and when important information is updated
- Export Your Data as a PDF Report
Generate comprehensive health reports based on your recorded data. Export your body's changes—including periods, medication, mood, and symptoms—into a professional PDF to share with your doctor or keep for your records. Even complex logs are neatly organized into a single, easy-to-read report.
[Premium]
- Share mood and health status with friends.
- Export menstrual cycles and basal body temperature as a PDF.
- Enjoy an ad-free experience.
- Simultaneous login on smartphones and tablets.
- Future premium features included at no extra cost.
Privacy policy : https://bomcomes.com/bomcalendar/en/privacy.html
Terms of service : https://bomcomes.com/bomcalendar/en/terms.html
How to "View/Change/Cancel" Subscription : https://support.apple.com/HT202039
For questions or issues while using Bom Calendar, please e-mail help@bomcomes.com

bluejetty:00041973:ios.description:
Introducing FitQueen VIP by Anita Herbert, your go-to app for reaching your fitness goals while feeling amazing every step of the way.
Whether you’re looking to shape your body, boost your energy, feel more confident, or simply spice up your usual workouts, we’ve got you covered with fun and highly effective fitness challenges.
Let’s embark on this journey together and unlock your full potential – because every woman deserves to feel like a Queen in her own skin!
What’s included:
Training Plan: A 6 week training plan with easy to follow home + gym options. The challenges are designed to be adaptable, whether you train 3, 4, 5, or 6 days a week, and suitable for all levels. Each challenge consists of 3 phases, so you get a new workout routine every two weeks!
Exercise Videos: Your training plan includes videos demonstration for each exercise with detailed instructions, ensuring you’re never confused about proper form.
Workout Tracking: Stay on top of your fitness game with our built-in workout logging feature. Easily track the weight you use for each exercise, monitor your progress, and stay driven as you conquer your goals.
Personalized Meal Plans: Reach your goals while eating the foods you love! Anita’s team of Registered Dieticians creates custom meal plans just for you. Tell us your goals, preferences, and any dietary needs, and we’ll make sure you’re eating right for your current goals and lifestyle.
Recipes: Spice up your nutrition with our extensive recipe library. Discover new dishes that fit into your meal plan, making healthy eating exciting and delicious.
Body Measurements: Stay motivated by recording your measurements and take progress photos to witness the amazing changes in your physique over time!
Extras: Additional educational ebooks on Nutrition and Training to help you along your journey. 
24/7 Support: Help is always at your fingertips. Whether that be messaging Anita via email, receiving personal updates via the app, in your check-ins or accessing our private FitQueen community on facebook of over 69K women from around the world.

bluejetty:00155055:android.description:
Take control of your financial future anytime, anywhere through the modern and intuitive design of the OneAmerica Financial app. The app provides access to financial wellness resources and allows you to complete the retirement account management transactions and activities that are most important to you. Additionally, OneAmerica Financial meets you where you are by providing the app experience in English and Spanish, depending on your language preference.
Using the app, you can:
· Register and enroll
· Use biometrics to log-in
· View current account balance
· View and change contribution amount
· View and change investment allocations
· View quarterly statements
We understand that account security is top-of-mind, and we take the safety and security of your data very seriously. We invest significant resources in people, processes, and technologies to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of your data. Our information security program helps ensure that your data is well managed and protected at all times.
Please note, the OneAmerica Financial app only supports retirement plan participants. If you participate in, or own, other OneAmerica Financial products, such as life insurance, employee benefits or annuities, you will not be able to access your account via the app.
For app support, contact us at support@oneamerica.com or visit www.oneamerica.com/contactus.

bluejetty:00070993:ios.name: Kids Autism Games - AutiSpark
bluejetty:00070993:ios.summary: AutiSpark is an educational program especially made for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) with learning games tested and approved by special educators and occupational therapists. If you are struggling to teach basic concepts to
bluejetty:00070993:ios.description:
AutiSpark is an educational program especially made for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) with learning games tested and approved by special educators and occupational therapists. If you are struggling to teach basic concepts to your child, AutiSpark is a must-try for you.
AutiSpark offers a multitude of well-researched, engaging, and interactive learning games. Kids can learn to associate objects via their pictures, understand emotions, do sorting, recognize sounds and words, and do much more.
- Suitable for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).
- Specially designed educational games and activities.
- Engaging content to ensure the child's focus and attention.
- Develop basic visual, communication, and language skills.
These educational games are made by considering the various needs of kids on the autistic spectrum, with the help and guidance of expert therapists. It includes positive reinforcement that kids need to learn and remember. These games are created keeping the core concepts in mind to help kids learn the basic skills needed on a daily basis.
Words & Spellings:
It can be challenging to teach reading skills to children with autism. Our early reading comprehension will focus on recognizing letters, letter combinations & words.
Basic Math Skills:
AutiSpark gives math a good start with the recognition of numbers, patterns, etc.
Tracing Games:
Writing is an important skill that every young child needs to master. AutiSpark teaches uppercase and lowercase letters of the alphabet, numbers, and shapes.
Memory Games:
Kids will sharpen their memory and cognitive skills by playing fun and educational memory games. There are different levels of difficulty to suit the child's needs.
Sorting & Matching Games:
AutiSpark will teach kids to sort and match different objects by color, shape, similarities, association, etc. It will make their logical thinking stronger.
Puzzles:
Puzzle games will help children to improve problem-solving skills, mental speed, and thought processes.
Yes or No Games:
The concept of Yes or No is difficult for kids on the spectrum to understand. These unique games will be helpful to them.
Eye Direction Games:
Children with autism respond better to visual cues. These games will help them to understand the directions and pick the objects by looking at the eyes on the screen.
AutiSpark has a 14-day free trial which you can cancel anytime if you do not want to auto-renew the subscription after the trial period.
Want your child to learn essential skills? Download AutiSpark - Autism Games now!

- Subscribe to get access to full content including future updates.

- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Manage App Subscriptions in your iTunes Settings.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Use the subscription in any iPad/iPhone/iPod registered with your Apple account.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.

Just solve 20 questions, and our AI will provide exercises tailored to your level!
- Learn new phrases and when to use them.
- Listen to sentences recorded at the speed native speakers actually speak.
- Practice your listening and pronunciation at the same time.
There's no need to worry about where to start.
2. Study English like You're Playing a Game.
Fill in the blanks, build sentences, and earn points.
Epop's exercises are designed so that you'll have fun learning grammar and vocabulary.
It doesn't even feel like studying!

Speaking English has never been so easy!

Thanks to our review system, you'll be able to keep vocabulary, expressions, and grammar points fresh in your mind!
Study, repeat, and memorize effectively!

Our app is designed so that anyone can learn, speak, and understand English easily and effectively.
We're constantly improving our app based on feedback from thousands of learners.

Waiting for the bus, during meals, before bed... Turn any spare moment into an opportunity to study English.
Everything You Need for Learning English in One App!
- [Vocabulary]

- [Grammar]

- [Listening & Speaking]
Improve your pronunciation and intonation through English listening and speaking practice.

Phrases are brought back for you to review at the best time to ensure long-term retention!
Over 8 Million Downloads!
Join the millions already learning English with Epop.
Download Epop now and master English through AI-powered learning, gamification, and realistic conversation practice!

bluejetty:00157504:ios.description:
Welcome to Clear Sky
The Clear Sky Restaurants app is your one-stop hub to order from all five Clear Sky restaurants in one place. Browse menus, order ahead for pickup or delivery, and manage your loyalty rewards across Clear Sky Club Haus, Clear Sky on Park, Clear Sky on Cleveland, Clear Sky Draught Haus, and Clear Sky Beachside Cafe – all in one app. No matter which Clear Sky location you’re craving, our app makes it easy to get your favorite dishes and earn rewards at the same time
Order Ahead & Pickup — Earn points on each purchase and redeem them for free drinks and discounts.
Order Ahead (Pickup) – Place your takeout order in advance and pick it up. Skip the line and save time by ordering ahead.
Delivery (In-App) – Conveniently order for delivery straight from the app and get your Clear Sky favorites brought to your door.
Exclusive Promotions – Unlock app-only deals and seasonal specials available exclusively to Clear Sky app users

Clear Sky Restaurants has been serving the Tampa Bay area with five unique dining experiences for years. Founded by industry veteran Dan Shouvlin, the Clear Sky family of eateries spans Clearwater Beach, Downtown Clearwater, Dunedin, Palm Harbor, and Seminole. Each location offers a distinct menu and atmosphere, yet all share a commitment to quality food and friendly service (always with an upscale twist). Whether you’re in the mood for beachside brunch or a gastropub dinner, there’s a Clear Sky restaurant for every occasion.
Download Clear Sky Restaurants today to order ahead, get delivery, and earn rewards across all five locations. Enjoy the convenience of having Clear Sky’s kitchens at your fingertips – your next great meal is just a tap away!

Drag and drop the blocks into the board, then clear the blocks by making a line of full bricks horizontally or vertically.

- Game ends if there is no more space for any given blocks.
- Given blocks can't be rotated.
- In Multiplayer game mode, time is limited in 5 minutes. You will win this match if you get more scores than your opponent.

- A Simple, Free and Fun block puzzle game that keeps your brain healthy.
- Save game.
- Support Game Center Leaderboard.
- Support Multiplayer game mode.
- Classic, Obstacle and Advanced game mode.
- Share scores with your friends.
- Offer in-app purchase.
- Smart block movement.
Have fun!!

bluejetty:00079734:ios.description:
سرهمبندی: بازی معمایی که فکرتان رو درگیر میکند. چالش های این بازی کلمه ای انقدر هیجان انگیز هستند که نمی توانید از آن دست بکشید!
این بازی کلمات فارسی برای دورهمی ها ایده آل هست. با این بازی ساعتها دورهم خوش بگذرانید و معماها را حل کنید و مرحله به مرحله مسابقه و دانش اطلاعات عمومی خود را به نمایش بگذارید. معماها مناسب بازی بزرگسالان همراه با کودکان هستند.
آیا آماده اید ذهن خود را به چالش بکشید و در دنیای کلمات و معماها غرق شوید؟ "سرهمبندی" همان بازی فکری و کلمه ای است که به دنبال آن بودید! سرهمبندی یک بازی اطلاعات عمومی هست که اوقات فراغت شما را پر میکند. این بازی یک تفریح سالم و مفید برای همه هست.
اگر از بازیهایی که بر مبنای بازی با کلمات و در ژانر جستجوی کلمه هستند لذت میبرید، ما فکر میکنیم حتما این بازی را هم دوست خواهید داشت. بازیکنان فعلی سرهمبندی به ما گفته اند که این بازی اعتیاد آور هست.
هدف این بازی جذاب، حل کردن معما و پیدا کردن واژه رمز است. به شما یک سوال داده میشود و تعدادی حرف. از رنگ های حروف به عنوان نشانه و سرنخ استفاده کنید تا به کلمات درست برسید. این بازی از مراحل آسان شروع میشود و به تدریج با چالش های سخت تر روبرو میشوید. این بازی فکری به شما امکان می دهد تا اطلاعات عمومی خود را تست کنید، هوش خود را تقویت کرده و به عنوان یک استاد حل معماهای کلمه ای شناخته شوید. این بازی فکری برای بزرگسالان مناسب هست. اما کودکان هم میتوانند با بزرگترها بازی کنند و دایره لغات خود را گسترش دهند. 
چطور بازی کنم؟
برای پیدا کردن جواب معما، کلمه ی مورد نظر خود را وارد کنید. پس از هر حدس، رنگ خانه های حروف تغییر می کند. این رنگها سرنخ شما هستند برای رمزگشایی کلمات. این رنگها شبیه رنگهای بازیهای نوستالژیک و قدیمی هستند. با چند تلاش، واژه ی رمز را پیدا کنید. 
معنی رنگهای حروف: 
- سبز: این حرف در جای درست قرار دارد 
- زرد: این حرف در رمز موجود است ولی باید جابجا شود 
- خاکستری: کلمه ی رمز شامل این حرف نیست 
ویژگی های فوق العاده بازی:
- سوالات بامزه برای بازی انفرادی یا دورهمی
- معماهای متنوع و جالب 
- بازی روزانه چالش برانگیز 
- صدها مرحله ی متفاوت و جذاب 
- انیمیشن های بامزه و دلنشین 
- گرافیک خیره کننده و چشم نواز 
- حجم کم و نصب آسان 
- کاملا رایگان و بدون پرداخت درون برنامه ای 
ویژگی های حافظه و ذهنی:
این بازی سرگرم کننده، دانش اطلاعات عمومی شما و قدرت تحلیلتان را ارتقاء می دهد: 
- افزایش توان تحلیل 
- افزایش اطلاعات عمومی 
- افزایش هوش (IQ) 
- بهبود و پرورش حافظه 
- افزایش دقت و نکته سنجی 
- تقویت هوش و تقویت حافظه 
- افزایش تمرکز 
- گسترش دامنه ی لغات 
آماده ی رویارویی با معماهای هیجان انگیز هستید؟ 
 همین حالا "سرهمبندی" را دانلود کنید و یک سرگرمی جدید و جذاب رو تجربه کنید و با دوستانتان به اشتراک بگذارید!

برای پیدا کردن جواب معما، کلمه ی مورد نظر خود را وارد کنید. پس از هر حدس، رنگ خانه‌ های حروف تغییر می‌ کند. این رنگها سرنخ شما هستند برای رمزگشایی کلمات. این رنگها شبیه رنگهای بازی‌های نوستالژیک و قدیمی هستند.  با چند تلاش، واژه‌ ی رمز را پیدا کنید. 

معنی رنگهای حروف: 


  
- سبز: این حرف در جای درست قرار دارد 
- زرد: این حرف در رمز موجود است ولی باید جابجا شود 
- خاکستری: کلمه‌ ی رمز شامل این حرف نیست 







ویژگی‌ های فوق‌ العاده بازی:

  
- سوالات بامزه برای بازی انفرادی یا دورهمی
- معماهای متنوع و جالب 
- بازی روزانه چالش‌ برانگیز 
- صدها مرحله‌ ی متفاوت و جذاب 
- انیمیشن‌ های بامزه و دلنشین 
- گرافیک خیره‌ کننده و چشم‌ نواز 
- حجم کم و نصب آسان 
- کاملا رایگان و بدون پرداخت درون برنامه‌ ای

این بازی سرگرم‌ کننده، دانش اطلاعات عمومی شما و قدرت تحلیلتان را ارتقاء می‌ دهد: 

  
- افزایش توان تحلیل  
- افزایش اطلاعات عمومی 
- افزایش هوش (IQ)  
- بهبود و پرورش حافظه

- تقویت هوش و تقویت حافظه

- گسترش دامنه‌ ی لغات

bluejetty:00063233:ios.description:
● Advanced Auto-Scoring
Auto-scoring is supported on iPhone and iPad models equipped with A12 chips (or newer), including iPad models with M-series chips.
• Auto-scoring using only your device’s rear camera
Dartsmind provides accurate auto-scoring with nothing more than your device’s built-in rear camera — no extra hardware or external sensors required.
• Works at any height and angle
Auto-scoring functions reliably from a wide range of camera positions. No complex calibration, no precise mounting, and no manual lens correction needed.
• AI designed specifically for darts, running fully on-device
Dartsmind uses a custom AI model specifically designed for real dart scenarios. All processing runs locally on your device, ensuring fast response, offline use, and complete privacy.
• Compatible with most steel-tip dartboards
Auto-scoring is designed to work with the vast majority of standard steel-tip dartboards, making it easy to use at home, in clubs, or during online games and practice sessions.
• Optional dual-device, dual-camera auto-scoring for enhanced accuracy
For advanced setups, Dartsmind supports a dual-device configuration that combines two camera views into a dual-camera auto-scoring system, further improving detection accuracy and stability.
● Darts Games Included

• Cricket Games: Standard Cricket, No Score Cricket, Tactic Cricket, Random Cricket, Cut-Throat Cricket
• Practice Games: Around the Clock, JDC Challenge, 41-60, Catch 40, 9 Darts Double Out (121 / 81), 99 Darts at XX, Round the World, Bob’s 27, Random Checkout, 170, Cricket Count Up, Count Up
• Party Games: Hammer Cricket, Half It, Killer, Shanghai, Bermuda, Gotcha
● Key features
• Auto-scoring using device camera.
• Supports both iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape orientations.
• Game Lobby for global online games.
• Most Games Support up to 6 players.
• Detailed statistics for every game to help analyze and improve your skills.
• DartBot with multiple difficulty levels for X01 and Standard Cricket.
• Match modes (legs and sets formats) for X01 and Standard Cricket.
• Extensive custom settings for each game

bluejetty:00184869:ios.name: Rook
bluejetty:00184869:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00184869:ios.description:
Play the classic Rook trick-taking card game on your iPhone or iPad.
You play South, partnered with North, against the West/East team. Rook uses a special deck with four colored suits numbered 5 through 14, plus the powerful Rook card. In this app, the Rook is represented by a castle chess piece, and the cards are designed to be color-blind friendly.
Customize the game to match the Rook rules you know. Change the wallpaper, add optional 1 cards ranked above the 14s, choose whether players must play trump when unable to follow suit, award a bonus for winning every trick, adjust the winning score, and more.
HOW TO PLAY
Dealing: The deal rotates to the left each hand. Each player receives 9 cards, with 5 additional cards dealt to the widow in the center of the table.
Bidding: Players bid for the right to choose the trump suit. The player to the dealer’s left opens the bidding at 70 or passes. Bidding continues to the left, usually in 5-point increments. Once a player passes, that player is out of the bidding for the hand.
The Widow and Trump: The high bidder takes the 5 widow cards, which are revealed to all players, chooses the trump suit, and then discards 5 cards. The discarded cards remain hidden from the other players. Depending on your settings, point cards in the discard go either to the bidding team or to the winner of the last trick.
Playing Tricks: The dealer—or optionally the high bidder—leads the first trick. Play continues to the left, with each player playing one card. Players must follow the suit that was led when possible. If unable to follow suit, a player may play any card—or, with the appropriate option enabled, must play trump when possible.
The highest card of the suit led wins unless a trump card is played, in which case the highest trump wins. The Rook is the highest trump card and can be played strategically to capture a valuable trick.
Standard card ranking from highest to lowest is: Rook – 14 – 13 – 12 – 11 – 10 – 9 – 8 – 7 – 6 – 5
With the optional 1 cards enabled: Rook – 1 – 14 – 13 – 12 – 11 – 10 – 9 – 8 – 7 – 6 – 5
The winner of each trick collects the four cards and leads the next trick.
Scoring: At the end of the hand, each team counts the point cards it captured:
• Rook: 20 points
• 14: 10 points
• 10: 10 points
• 5: 5 points
Other cards have no point value.
If the bidding team fails to score enough points to make its bid, the bid amount is deducted from its score. An optional bonus can also be awarded for winning every trick.
Winning: The first team to reach the selected winning score wins the game. You can adjust the target score in the game settings.
Rook is free to play and supported by advertising. Prefer to play without ads? Rook+, the paid ad-free version, is also available on the App Store.

bluejetty:00023386:ios.description:
MEET THE CHICKEN POLICE
Sonny Featherland and Marty MacChicken were once a legendary detective·duo, called the Chicken Police. But that was almost a decade ago, and time had ruthlessly passed them by. Now Sonny and Marty are forced to work together on a case that is weirder than anything they've ever encountered before!
NARRATIVE·DRIVEN, DETECTIVE GAMEPLAY
Chicken Police is a story·rich and dialogue·heavy game combining elements of the visual novels and classic adventure games. The game has more than 30 characters to talk to, with some having to be seriously interrogated. Collect tons of clues, evidence, and highly sensitive personal information from the shady characters of Clawville to use ruthlessly against them!
EXPLORE THE CITY OF CLAWVILLE (again, and again...)
There are more than 30 places to visit and some of them will change several times during the story. You can return to previous locations on several occasions, to find hidden secrets, meet new characters and gather information about the world and its inhabitants.
A CINEMATIC EXPERIENCE
Chicken Police has a weirdly stunning visual style made with the usage of real photos and photo·realistic 3D backgrounds, inspired by classic film·noir movies and influenced by animated features. Its noir mood is enhanced by an original music soundtrack, backed up by professional voice acting for all characters with more than 8 hours of spoken dialogue!
Chicken Police is a satire, which recalls the mood and atmosphere of the 40's film·noir movies, and as the best noirs and hardboiled detective stories, it's so gritty and hopeless, that it can only be served with a lot of cynical humor.
KEY FEATURES
· A thrilling, rich storyline with a classic film·noir twist
· Professional voiceover with more than 8 hours of spoken dialogue!
· A carefully crafted, ""colorful"" world
· A complex interrogation system
· More than 30 unique, fully voiced characters
· A cinematic film·noir like experience with more than 20 cutscenes!
· Lots of clues, information, and collectibles to find
· A beautiful original soundtrack
· Game Center support
© HandyGames

bluejetty:00164293:ios.description:
Wellcee — Find Your Place Anywhere in the World.
Wellcee, founded in 2017, is a commission-free rental and social platform dedicated to helping young people rent directly from landlords and connect with like-minded communities. For domestic users, Wellcee offers direct landlord connections, roommate matching, and sublets. For international users, Wellcee connects tenants with landlords, serving a community that spans over 170 countries.
With the Wellcee App, you can:
Rent Directly from Landlords with Zero Agent Fees
Wellcee is China's leading no-agent rental platform, covering 40+ cities including Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Hangzhou, and Chengdu. All listings are posted by real users — including verified sublets and direct landlord rentals - with no middlemen. Choose from shared rooms, entire apartments, short-term stays, and long-term leases.
Find Roommates Who Get You
Wellcee’s two-way matching system lets landlords and tenants choose each other, helping you find the right match — whether you’re seeking a roommate, a private rental, or a short-term stay. Recent grads, international students, or working professionals: you’ll find compatible living partners here.
Join a Global Living Community
Wellcee brings together young people from over 170 countries, making it the go-to platform for cross-border rentals and cross-cultural connections. Whether you’re a recent graduate, an international student, or a young professional, you’ll find like-minded roommates and a warm, welcoming home.
A Lifestyle Beyond Just Renting
Wellcee is more than housing - we build communities with heart. Our platform hosts an LGBTQ+ friendly community, a second-hand marketplace, pet adoption, and offline social events — because finding a home should be the beginning of something wonderful.
Our vision: To make everywhere in the world feel like home.
Nine years in, Wellcee has grown from zero into a global rental social platform connecting young people worldwide. We believe renting shouldn't just be a transaction — it should spark genuine human connection. If you spot any agent listings, feel free to report them. We are committed to keeping our community real, warm, and inclusive.
Filter by Whole apartments, shared apartments, short-term stays, long-term leases, metro lines, and map districts. Covering direct landlord rentals, personal sublets, and roommate matching, across individual listings, branded apartments, and more. Now available in 40+ cities including Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Hangzhou, Chengdu, Nanjing, Wuhan, Chongqing, Tianjin, and Xi'an.
——————————
Website: www.wellcee.com
Email: hello@wellcee.com

Every market is a question with a probability attached, set by thousands of traders putting their (play) money where their mouth is. Think the crowd is wrong? Trade against it and profit when you're right.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Trade on thousands of live markets, from elections and championships to "will my friend finish their novel this year"
• Create your own market on anything in seconds and let the world weigh in
• Compete on leaderboards, climb the league ladder, and keep your daily streak alive
• Follow friends, comment on markets, and argue about the odds
• Get notified when markets you care about move or resolve
• Track your portfolio, profit, and forecasting accuracy over time
WHY PREDICTION MARKETS?
Prices are probabilities, so a market at 70% means traders collectively think there's a 70% chance the event happens. Manifold's forecasts have called elections, sports, and world events with striking accuracy — and you can be part of the signal.
WHO IT'S FOR
Forecasters, sports fans, politics junkies, news addicts, superforecasters-in-training, and anyone who's ever said "I bet…" and wanted to back it up.
FREE TO PLAY
Manifold runs entirely on mana, a play-money currency. You start with a free balance and earn more by trading well, creating popular markets, and logging in daily. Mana has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for real money. No gambling, no purchase necessary to play.
Join a community of forecasters who take being right seriously — and have fun doing it.

bluejetty:00186027:ios.name: Bear Games: for Kids
bluejetty:00186027:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00186027:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
SMART BEAR BOO
Enjoy this funny quest with your whole family!
Jump, run and guide the little bear through exiting levels. Collect as much honey as you can and help Boo to find his way home into his cozy cave. Yet, you also have to be careful and watch out for bees. Make sure that they don’t catch you. If they sting, your journey ends quickly.
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00159894:ios.description:
This is a powerful timestamp camera, designed to meet the demands of both work and life in various scenarios. It allows you to add timestamps, including date, time, and location, while taking photos or recording videos, helping you easily document every important moment. Whether it’s for project inspections, attendance tracking, travel check-ins, or sweet memories, this camera offers a convenient and efficient shooting experience.
FEATURES
Add Timestamps
- You can add timestamps like date, time, and location during photos and videos, making your content more authentic and reliable.
Customizable Timestamps
- Map Style: Choose from different map styles to personalize your timestamp content.
- Time Format and Style: Supports various time display formats, allowing you to freely select the way dates and times are shown.
- Layout Styles: Multiple layout styles give you the flexibility to adjust the display position of the timestamp based on your needs.
Shooting Adjustments
- Aspect Ratio Adjustments: Supports various aspect ratios, easily adapting to different shooting needs.
- Guidelines: Built-in reference lines help you compose your shots precisely.
- Flash Toggle: Adjust the flash based on the lighting conditions to ensure every photo is clear and bright.
- Front and Rear Camera Switching: Quickly switch between the front and rear cameras to capture every important moment.
From professional engineering records to personal life memories, this timestamp camera can handle it all:
- An essential tool for engineers and project managers
- A useful device for property management, law enforcement, and patrol staff
- A great travel companion for adventure enthusiasts
- A meaningful keepsake for couples and families
Whether you’re a professional needing to document work tasks or a casual user who loves to capture life’s moments, this timestamp camera ensures you can easily capture and mark memorable moments anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00095037:ios.description:

Master the Art of the Screw
Welcome to Spin & Solve Pin Challenge, where every screw you twist matters! Test your precision and patience as you become a true master of mechanical repairs. Each screw is unique and requires your full attention to solve intricate challenges.

Enjoy detailed 3D animations that make every screw feel lifelike. The smooth mechanics and engaging puzzle design provide a satisfying experience that lets you master your craft one twist at a time.
Endless Puzzles to Solve
From simple fixes to complex machinery, this game offers endless puzzles where mastering the screw is the key to success. Each puzzle challenges your patience and logic, helping you grow as a master of this mechanical art.
Relax and Become a Master
Take your time with no pressure or countdowns. Enjoy the calm and focus needed to master each screw and solve every puzzle at your own pace. Perfect for players who love to become true masters in a rewarding and relaxing game.
Ready to prove your skills? Download Spin & Solve Pin Challenge and start your journey to becoming the ultimate master of screws and puzzles!

bluejetty:00043980:ios.description:

bluejetty:00119506:ios.description:
Save time by managing your reimbursement accounts with this app anywhere 24/7! The Reimburse Me App goes where you go, whether to simply check your balance at work, submit your claim at the doctor’s office, or much more.
Accounts
Tap into any of these accounts on your mobile device:
• Health Care Spending Account
• Health Savings Account
• Dependent Care Spending Account
• Health Reimbursement Account
• Retiree Medical Account
Information at your Fingertips
Access your account in the palm of your hand and you can quickly check your:
• Current balances
• Alerts that need timely action
• Claims and payments from the past 30 days
Manage Your Accounts
The app also allows you to take important actions while on the go, such as:
• Submit claims to get reimbursed
• Take a photo of your receipt and submit it with the claim
• Pay bills
• Contribute to your account
• Recover overpayments
• Add and manage direct deposit
• Get a dependent care provider’s signature on your device for paperless processing
Note: The Reimburse Me app will work for you only if Your Spending Account administers your employer-sponsored accounts and you’re enrolled in the account.

Stay in charge of your money with a secure, easy-to-use self-custodial wallet.
PROTECT YOUR PAYMENTS WITH ENCRYPTION
Keep your payments safe with encryption that protects your transactions from the public.
SAVE ON EXCHANGE FEES WITH COMPETITIVE RATES
Payments cost just $0.00256 and get competitive exchange rates when converting between fiat and stablecoins.⁵
TRANSACT AND SAVE IN A STABLE CURRENCY
Deposits and withdrawals are automatically converted to eUSD, an encrypted stablecoin backed by a basket of stablecoins to minimize the risk of depegging.⁶
DEPOSIT AND WITHDRAW WITH FIAT OR STABLECOINS
Top up or cash out using USDT/USDC or your local bank — all converted automatically to eUSD.
CREATE AND SEND INVOICES IN A FEW TAPS
Send invoice links to global clients directly from the app, and let them pay online with a card.
REQUEST PAYMENTS WITH A LINK
Send payment requests as links, even to people who don’t use Sentz.
GET SUPPORT ANYTIME
Reach our support team 24/7 whenever you need help.
