bluejetty:00154070:ios.description:
Find your perfect hairstyle – powered by AI, inspired by Asian style.
hano.ai helps you instantly visualize how modern Asian-inspired hairstyles will look on you. Whether you're exploring a bold new look or refining your personal style, our advanced AI generates high-quality previews based on haircuts popular in Asian trends and tailored to suit straight and wavy hair types.
***
Personalized Recommendations
We personalize hairstyle suggestions through a short consultation covering your preferences, lifestyle, and grooming habits. Our curated styles reflect modern Asian aesthetics and global trends — from K-drama layers to clean Western tapers.
AI-Powered Hairstyle Previews
Snap a photo and let our AI apply curated hairstyles directly to your image with salon-quality realism. Each preview preserves your facial features and proportions, giving you trustworthy and natural-looking results.
Credits
Each image generation costs 1 credit. Credits can be purchased securely through the app.
No Storage, No Stress
Your photos and hairstyle results remain local to your device — we don’t store or upload anything. Because of this, please note: deleting and reinstalling the app may erase your hairstyle history and any unused credits.
Disclaimer: hano.ai uses AI to simulate hairstyles. Results are for visual reference only and may differ from real-world outcomes. For best accuracy, use a well-lit, front-facing photo.

bluejetty:00157596:ios.description:
Daily Heart Instant - Your Exclusive Health Companion
Daily Heart Instant is an outstanding health management application. Its core functions lie in the recording of measurement results of blood pressure, blood glucose, and heart rate, as well as the innovative way of calculating heart rate by collecting finger images through the camera.
In terms of blood pressure recording, Daily Heart Instant is convenient and precise. The systolic and diastolic blood pressure values obtained each time using the blood pressure measurement device can be easily entered. It not only accurately records each measurement data but also intelligently arranges them in chronological order and presents them in an intuitive chart to show the trend of blood pressure changes. This enables users to clearly understand the fluctuations of blood pressure and promptly discover potential abnormalities, and optimize their lifestyles or seek medical assistance based on professional advice.
In terms of blood glucose management, Daily Heart Instant is equally excellent. Whether it's self-testing with a home blood glucose meter or test results from medical institutions, they can be conveniently entered. It records in detail the time, value of each measurement, and relevant remarks, such as diet and exercise conditions before the measurement. This helps to comprehensively understand the law of blood glucose and formulate personalized control strategies.
Heart rate monitoring is a highlight of Daily Heart Instant. In addition to the common measurement methods using smart wearable devices or mobile phone sensors, it innovatively uses the mobile phone camera to collect finger images to analyze and calculate the heart rate. Users only need to gently cover the camera with their fingers, and the application can quickly obtain accurate heart rate data with the help of image analysis technology. This non-contact measurement allows users to know their heart rate status anytime and anywhere. Moreover, each measurement result is recorded in detail and displayed in a chart to show the changing trend, helping users assess their cardiac function and physical stress ability, and providing a basis for adjusting exercise and life.
Daily Heart Instant also has a simple, intuitive, and easy-to-use user interface. The data input process is efficient, and the chart display is clear. Both novice and experienced users can easily get started. It also supports synchronizing health data to the cloud, ensuring data security and facilitating access from different devices at any time, truly achieving the convenience of monitoring health at any time.
In conclusion, with its comprehensive and powerful functions, innovative technology, and excellent experience, Daily Heart Instant has become a powerful helper for users' health management, accompanying users in taking care of their health and moving towards a better life.

bluejetty:00166269:ios.description:
WATER IN YOUR SPEAKER? NO PROBLEM!
Safe, fast, and effective. Use Water Eject to clear trapped liquid, fix muffled audio, and restore your phone’s speaker quality in just a few seconds.
[ WHY CHOOSE WATER EJECT? ]
We’ve all been there: an accidental splash in the sink, a drop in the pool, or moisture from the rain. When water gets into your speaker, the sound becomes distorted and quiet. Water Eject is the professional-grade speaker cleaner and water remover solution designed to fix your audio instantly.
[ HOW IT WORKS ]
Using advanced Hz sound frequencies and sonic wave technology, Water Eject creates high-speed vibrations that safely push water and moisture out of the speaker grills. It is a scientific alternative to the "rice" method, providing immediate results without the wait.
[ CORE FEATURES ]
• INSTANT WATER EJECT: Clear speakers and remove liquid with one tap.
• FIX MUFFLED AUDIO: Restore crisp, clear sound quality after water exposure.
• SONIC CLEANER: Advanced frequency generator expels water and dust.
• SPEAKER DRYER: Prevent long-term hardware damage and moisture corrosion.
• DUST REMOVAL: Shake loose trapped debris to improve volume and clarity.
[ SIMPLE 3-STEP PROCESS ]
1. Increase your device volume to the maximum setting.
2. Face the speaker grills downward toward the ground.
3. Tap the "Eject" button to start the sonic cleaning cycle.
[ DEVICE COMPATIBILITY ]
Designed for all iPhone and iPad models. Whether you have a spill, a splash, or high humidity, Water Eject is the ultimate utility tool to keep your hardware protected and your audio sounding its best.
Don't let a splash ruin your day. Download Water Eject—the most reliable speaker cleaner and water remover app on the App Store.

bluejetty:00064861:ios.description:
Finnomena - ลงทุนอย่างมั่นใจ
Finnomena คือผู้นำด้านแพลตฟอร์มเวลธ์เทค (WealthTech Platform) ชั้นนำของประเทศไทย ที่เติบโตอย่างต่อเนื่องมากว่า 10 ปี ด้วยมูลค่าสินทรัพย์ภายใต้คำแนะนำ (AuA) 72,385.60 ล้านบาท (ข้อมูล ณ วันที่ 31 มีนาคม 2569) และทีมงานมืออาชีพกว่า 3,367 คนทั่วประเทศ เราพร้อมขับเคลื่อนความมั่งคั่งให้ทุกคนอย่างมั่นใจ ผ่านคำแนะนำที่มีคุณภาพ แพลตฟอร์มที่เข้าถึงง่าย และกลยุทธ์ที่เข้มข้นจากผู้เชี่ยวชาญ เพื่อตอบโจทย์เป้าหมายสำคัญในการสร้างความมั่นคงทางการเงินตลอดชีวิต
— ลงทุนครบจบในแอปเดียว
Finnomena ให้คุณเลือกลงทุนในสินทรัพย์ทางการเงินที่หลากหลาย ไม่ว่าจะเป็นกองทุนรวม พอร์ตหุ้นไทยและ DR ภายใต้การบริหารจัดการ (Managed Portfolio) ตราสารหนี้ (Bonds) e-Savings และอื่นๆ อีกมากมาย
— คำแนะนำจากผู้เชี่ยวชาญที่คุณไว้วางใจได้
รับคำแนะนำการลงทุนที่เป็นกลาง พร้อมกลยุทธ์การลงทุนหลากสไตล์ ครอบคลุมทุกระดับความเสี่ยง เพื่อตอบโจทย์ทุกเป้าหมายชีวิตที่คุณวางไว้
— พันธมิตรทางการเงินชั้นนำ
Finnomena ร่วมมือกับพันธมิตรทางการเงินที่แข็งแกร่ง อาทิ บริษัทหลักทรัพย์จัดการกองทุนชั้นนำกว่า 21 แห่งในประเทศไทย, พันธมิตรระดับโลกอย่าง Franklin Templeton, A. Stotz Investment Research, Yuanta, CIMB Thailand, KKP และ AsiaPlus เพื่อมอบทางเลือกการลงทุนที่ครอบคลุมและตอบโจทย์นักลงทุนทุกระดับ
— เครื่องมือวางแผนการลงทุนที่ครอบคลุม ทุกเป้าหมายสำคัญของชีวิต
วางแผนการลงทุนตามเป้าหมายด้วย Goals Navigator นวัตกรรมการวางแผนการลงทุนที่ช่วยให้คุณลงทุนอย่างมีทิศทาง พร้อมคลังความรู้ด้านการลงทุนที่ครอบคลุมในที่เดียว
— ดูแลใกล้ชิด ปลอดภัย มั่นใจทุกการตัดสินใจ
สื่อสารกับผู้แนะนำการลงทุนได้อย่างสะดวกและปลอดภัย ทั้งแชท ส่งไฟล์ และโทรหาผู้แนะนำโดยตรง เพื่อให้ทุกการตัดสินใจลงทุนเป็นไปบนข้อมูลที่ดีที่สุด
Finnomena พร้อมพัฒนาและสร้างสรรค์นวัตกรรมใหม่อย่างต่อเนื่อง เพื่อเป้าหมายสำคัญที่จะช่วยให้ทุกคนมีโอกาสสร้างความมั่งคั่งได้อย่างมั่นใจในทุกช่วงเวลา และมีความมั่นคงทางการเงินตลอดชีวิต ทางบริษัทได้รับรางวัลด้านนวัตกรรมและการส่งเสริมความรู้ทางการเงินมากมาย รวมถึงรางวัลจากสำนักงานคณะกรรมการกำกับหลักทรัพย์และตลาดหลักทรัพย์ (ก.ล.ต.) ในวันที่ 15 ธันวาคม 2568 รวมทั้งสิ้น 4 รางวัล ได้แก่ รางวัลขวัญใจมหาชน (Public Favorite Award) , รางวัลการสร้างองค์ความรู้อย่างยั่งยืน (Sustainability Award) , รางวัลความคิดสร้างสรรค์ยอดเยี่ยม (Creativity Awards) , รางวัลผู้สร้างพลังความรู้ทางการเงินและการลงทุน (The Financial Empowerment Award) และรางวัล Startup of the Year จากงาน Prime Minister Award 2025 จัดโดยสำนักงานนวัตกรรมแห่งชาติ (NIA) 
เว็บไซต์: https://www.finnomena.com

ข้อกำหนดและเงื่อนไข: https://www.finnomena.com/terms/
เวลาทำการ: จันทร์-ศุกร์ 9:00 - 17:00 น.
Call Center: 02-026-5100

bluejetty:00200118:ios.summary: Imagine getting a cheat sheet that adjusts to fit your league settings, allows you to mark off players during your draft AND provides up-to-date player news. That’s exactly what the 2026 RotoWire Fantasy Basketball Draft Kit can do for you.
bluejetty:00200118:ios.description:
Imagine getting a cheat sheet that adjusts to fit your league settings, allows you to mark off players during your draft AND provides up-to-date player news. That’s exactly what the 2026 RotoWire Fantasy Basketball Draft Kit can do for you. It’s a one-stop shop for everything you need to dominate during your draft. 
► THOUSANDS OF PEOPLE TRUST ROTOWIRE’S FANTASY BASKETBALL COVERAGE 
RotoWire.com has been the leading source of premium fantasy sports information on the internet for over 25 years. Our writers have won three times as many awards as the next closest fantasy pros competitor. We talk fantasy sports daily on our Sirius-XM radio show and also provide fantasy news to many top sports sites.
► ABOUT THE 2026-27 FANTASY BASKETBALL DRAFT KIT 
Simply enter your league's scoring and roster settings and the app creates rankings from a value-based calculation that uses RotoWire's 2026-27 stat projections. Here are few of the features: 
- A cheat sheet that ranks players based on projected stats for 2026-27 using your league's settings. 
- The cheat sheet is a Value Based Drafting method that accounts for your league's categories, roster, etc. 
- Ability to manually rank players to your preference. 
- RotoWire.com player outlooks for the 2026-27 season. You can't get that in ANY other app. 
- Recent news and analysis for players. 
- We offer the ability to tier players or mark them as sleepers or busts.
- Team depth charts. 
- Projected stats for the 2026-27 season. 
- Player stats from the last three seasons. 
- The ability to download updated news and stat projections until the start of the 2026-27 season. 
- A player search that allows you to quickly find players. 
- The cheat sheet isn't ordered just by projected point totals, we calculate player rankings based on your league's settings. 
► PLUS, YOU CAN CUSTOMIZE ALL THESE SETTINGS! 
- Number of teams in the draft 
- Roster spots including: C, G, PG, SG, F, PF, SF, F/C, PF/C, G/F, SG/SF, Utility, Reserves 
- Scoring including: Points, Assists, Steals, Blocks, Rebounds, Turnovers, Free Throw %, Field Goal %, 3 Pointers Made, Offensive Rebounds, Defensive Rebounds, Field Goals Made, Field Goal Attempts, Free Throws Made, Free Throw Attempts, Double Doubles, Triple Doubles, Quadruple Doubles, 3 Point %, 3 Point Attempts, 2 Point Attempts, 2 Pointers Made, Assists/Turnovers, Points Per Game, Rebounds Per Game, Assists Per Game, Blocks Per Game, Steals Per Game, Personal Fouls, Technical Fouls, Ejections, and Flagrant Fouls
► DON’T WAIT. GET THE 2026-27 DRAFT KIT NOW. 
We stand behind the quality of our apps with email support (support@rotowire.com). Buy the app now and you’ll have your draft preparation squared away for the 2026-27 season.

bluejetty:00097997:ios.description:
THE PROFESSIONAL IPAD GAME ENGINE
Make real games with visual Behaviors. Design, build, test, and publish complete 2D games with a game development environment built specifically for iPad.
Build and own your games, share them with players, and export to Xcode when you're ready to publish on the App Store.
BUILD WITH VISUAL BEHAVIORS
Create gameplay using hyperPad’s visual Behavior system. Connect events, actions, conditions, variables, arrays, loops, timers, physics, UI, audio, and reusable logic without writing traditional code.
Build enemy AI, inventory systems, menus, animations, scoring systems, save data, camera controls, object spawning, and more.
A COMPLETE 2D GAME STUDIO
Build your game from idea to playable project directly on iPad:
• Visual Behavior-based game logic
• Scene and level design
• Real-time playtesting
• Physics and collision systems
• Particle effects and shaders
• Animation, UI, and audio tools
• Multiplayer and networking
• Prefabs and reusable systems
• Import graphics, animations, audio, music, and fonts
• Ad monetization support
• Xcode export for App Store publishing
• Community sharing and player feedback
BUILT FOR IPAD
hyperPad is a native iPad game development experience. Not a desktop game engine adapted for mobile.
Create with touch, Apple Pencil, keyboard, trackpad, and gestures. Build and test on the same device so you can quickly move from an idea to a playable game.
BUILD MORE THAN SIMPLE GAMES
Create platformers, RPGs, arcade games, adventures, physics games, rhythm games, simulations, educational experiences, interactive stories, prototypes, and original 2D games.
Combine variables, arrays, loops, physics, prefabs, shaders, networking, and reusable Behavior systems to build increasingly sophisticated projects.
LEARN GAME DEVELOPMENT BY MAKING GAMES
New to game development? Learn programming and game design concepts visually through hands-on creation.
Work with events, conditions, variables, loops, object systems, physics, debugging, and problem-solving while seeing the results directly in your game.
Experienced creators can use the same visual systems to prototype ideas, create reusable systems, and build complete game projects.
CREATE. TEST. SHARE. PUBLISH.
Design your game on iPad.
Build gameplay with visual Behaviors.
Test instantly.
Share to the hyperPad Hub for playtesting and feedback.
Improve your project.
Export to Xcode when you're ready to prepare it for the App Store.
From your first prototype to a complete game, hyperPad gives you a visual game development workflow built around iPad.
Tutorials & inspiration: YouTube @hyperPad
Privacy: https://www.hyperpad.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://www.hyperpad.com/terms-of-use
License Agreement: https://www.hyperpad.com/license

bluejetty:00022472:ios.name: Drummer ITP - Rudiment Trainer
bluejetty:00022472:ios.summary:
Learn to play 'In The Pocket' with Drummer ITP: The World's only intelligent metronome and rudiment training tool! *Worldwide Number 1 iPhone Music App in over 70 countries!*
Drummer ITP can help you to learn exceptionally accurate timing
bluejetty:00022472:ios.description:
Learn to play 'In The Pocket' with Drummer ITP: The World's only intelligent metronome and rudiment training tool! *Worldwide Number 1 iPhone Music App in over 70 countries!*
Drummer ITP can help you to learn exceptionally accurate timing with your drum performances and become a true 'In The Pocket' player. The app is designed for practicing rudiment patterns with a drum practice pad - incorporating an intelligent listening feature, which allows your performance against a metronome click to be measured and given as feedback scores. You can therefore track your progress and identify what rudiment patterns and tempos cause you most trouble with staying in time. 
*Please note: as with all professional audio and recording systems, Drummer ITP requires you to use wired headphones to enable zero latency analysis and measurements. Bluetooth headphones do not allow zero latency data exchange.
Drummer ITP helps to identify the key tempos where your technique changes from wrist-action stick hits to faster speeds which require you to control the bounce of the drumsticks. Finding your breaking points with different stick pad rudiments and practice exercises will enable you to focus on the most challenging aspects of your personal stick technique and will underpin your development in all areas of drumming.
The main display shows both the rolling click waveform and the microphone readings from your performance on the practice pad, so you can easily see if you are playing ahead or behind the beat. There is also a unique accuracy indicator which shows how far ahead or behind the beat each of your hits is. Whilst performing rudiments and exercises on a practice pad, the app records an ongoing measurement of accuracy and consistency of the performance, so you can practice to keep the timing indicator right in the middle of the screen and achieve the highest possible scores. When playing an accented pattern, or an exercise with rests incorporated, the intelligent algorithm checks that the correct type of hits are performed at the right time. If you want to check how accurate the app is, just turn up the loudspeaker volume and you'll see it measure its own sounds to 100% accuracy - so you can see how close your own performance scores are to that of an electronic drum machine!
Drummer ITP can be used in Manual Mode or Rudiment Mode. In Manual Mode the metronome runs freely, as a standard metronome whilst also keeping a measurement of the recent performance scores. With a rudiment pattern active (i.e. using the app's Rudiment Mode), a count in starts a 30, 60, 120 or 300 second rudiment test, the results of which become a benchmark for evaluating your performance progress over time, with all your best high scores being recorded. The app can also be used purely as a standalone high-precision metronome with advanced settings allowing you to choose different pitches, volumes and intervals for the click.
Includes a total of 68 practice patterns and rudiment exercises for combinations of:
- standard timing exercises (quarters, eighths, sixteenths)
- triplet timing exercises
- single, double and triple paradiddles (including inverted, reverse and offset)
- single and double paradiddle-diddle patterns
- rudimental drum rolls
- accented patterns
Additional features:
- notation of all included rudiments and exercise patterns 
- real-time left/right hand pattern indicator 
- accent indicator and moving notation counter 
- tempo adjustment from 30-240 bpm
- beat time intervals 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8
- optional beat one accent for practicing specific time signatures
- click designer with settings for pitch, tonality, click duration and volume
- separate click design for the main beat and interval sounds
- stick pad performance player, to hear what you are attempting to play
- high scores chart for completed rudiments and exercises
- preset click sounds
- microphone sensitivity adjustment
- intelligent 'learn latency' feature to ensure 100% accurate analysis

bluejetty:00069778:ios.description:
The easiest, fastest and most convenient way to make reposts on Instagram!
Application features:
• Repost photos, videos and Reels without watermark, in the highest possible quality
• The app does not contain ads or trackers
• No need to enter your Instagram account username/password
• Ability to make reposts from private accounts you follow
• When reposting, the caption of the post is automatically copied (optional)
• When reposting, the Instagram app opens automatically (optional)
The app supports 3 ways to make reposts
1st way, via the app:
1. Copy the link to the Instagram post
2. Open the «Repo» app and click the «Repost» button
2nd way, via the extension:
1. Open the post in the Instagram app
2. Click the «Share» button
3. Select the «Repo» extension
3rd way, via the Safari browser (works even with private accounts you follow)
1. Open an Instagram post in Safari browser
2. Click the «Share» button
3. Select the «Repo» extension
Subscription pricing and terms
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Terms of use: https://iosapp.pages.dev/repost/terms/
Privacy policy: https://iosapp.pages.dev/repost/privacy/
Disclaimer
The app is not sponsored, endorsed by or affiliated in any way with Instagram, Inc. App doesn't make any changes to the original Instagram app. Before making repost, You must get permission from the respective content owner.

WeddingWire for Guests is the free app that easily collects all of your wedding guest photos and videos in one place so all of your guests can like, comment on, and save memories from your big day. 
With WeddingWire for Guests, you and your guests can:
- Capture and share unlimited photos from all of your events
- Like and comment on photos and videos
- Customize photos with filters, text, and stickers
- Download all of the album’s photos and videos at once 
Plus, you can:
- Manage privacy settings to control who can add and view your wedding photo album
- Easily share your wedding details by connecting your WeddingWire Wedding Website
Getting started is simple, just create your album on the app, invite your friends via phone or email, and start collecting photos and videos from all of your wedding events. 
Download WeddingWire for Guests to start collecting your wedding photos and videos.
Already have WeddingWire for Guests? Leave a review of your experience or checkout the WeddingWire Planning app for more wedding planning help!
CA Privacy:

bluejetty:00033936:ios.description:
Discover the world of entertainment with RAVE TV : Movies & Shows ! Our app is your go-to destination, providing you with the latest cinematic releases and theater hits, all conveniently accessible.
Whether you're in the mood for a cozy movie night or a laid-back viewing session, RAVE TV : Movies & Shows provides you with daily updates on the latest trending movies. Say farewell to the overwhelming selection, and allow RAVE TV : Movies & Shows to lead you on your next thrilling cinematic journey.
Features :
1. Effortlessly Organize Your Favorite Movies: Keep your cherished films neatly organized and readily accessible.
2. Stay in the Loop with Trending Movies & TV Shows: Keep up-to-date with the latest in the world of cinema and television.
3. Locate Nearby Cinemas with Ease: Find cinemas in your vicinity effortlessly, making movie outings a breeze.
4. Discover Movies reviews: Explore concise critiques and evaluations of Films and Tv Shows.
5. Swift One-Tap Movie Search: Easily find specific movies with a single tap, saving you time and effort.
6. Sneak Peek with Trailers & Overviews: Preview movies and shows before deciding to watch, ensuring you make the right choice.
7. Access Essential Movie Info: Learn about movie length, ratings, and all the details you need to make an informed selection.
8. Explore a Variety of Genres & Categories: Dive into a plethora of genres and categories to find the perfect film for your mood.
9. Get Random Movie and TV Show Recommendations: Discover new content based on various criteria, ensuring a fresh viewing experience.
And Much More: Explore additional features designed to enhance your movie and TV show experience!

bluejetty:00131870:ios.description:
The weather routing app trusted by the world's top offshore sailors. 
Squid is the mobile version of SquidX — the routing solution used by elite teams in the Vendée Globe, Route du Rhum, Transat Jacques Vabre, The Ocean Race, and more. 
Now that same professional-grade power is in your pocket. From solo ocean racers to weekend cruisers, Squid gives every sailor access to accurate multi-model weather data and smart routing tools — rebuilt for speed, simplicity, and offshore use. 
A brand-new version has just launched: completely redesigned interface, major performance upgrades, and new features continuously in development.
Key Features
• Smart routing engine with roadbook tool
• Cloud routing with multi-route comparison
• Multi-model GRIB viewer: GFS, ECMWF, AROME, ARPEGE, GEM, NAM and more
• Forecasts up to 10 days, 1–3 hour time steps
• Meteograms for multi-model comparison (wind & pressure)
• Extensive polar database (racing & cruising yachts)
• Lightweight GRIBs optimized for offline use
• Iridium GO!® compatible — built for low-bandwidth environments
• Custom map visualizations: isolines, wind barbs, arrows, particles
Weather Coverage
Wind, gusts, MSLP, rainfall, cloud cover, CAPE, humidity, temperature, surface currents, swell & wind waves.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00034865:ios.summary:
MAKE AND REMEMBER THE CIRCLE OF FIFTHS EASILY
Unlock the full potential of your musical journey with our interactive “Make and Remember the Circle of Fifths” feature. Master the Circle of Fifths effortlessly using engaging mnemonics and vi
bluejetty:00034865:ios.description:
MAKE AND REMEMBER THE CIRCLE OF FIFTHS EASILY
Unlock the full potential of your musical journey with our interactive “Make and Remember the Circle of Fifths” feature. Master the Circle of Fifths effortlessly using engaging mnemonics and visual aids that make memorization fun.
Progress through 11 intuitive steps at your own pace. Use the Next and Previous buttons to navigate, and reset anytime to reinforce your learning. Memorize sharp keys with the phrase: “Caroline Gets Drunk And Eats Butterflies” and remember flat keys with: “Caroline Finds BEADs”.
Whether you're a beginner or an experienced musician, this feature simplifies the Circle of Fifths, making it accessible and enjoyable for everyone. Start mastering the Circle of Fifths today and elevate your understanding of music theory.
KEY SIGNATURES MADE SIMPLE
Discover key signatures effortlessly with our interactive Circle of Fifths tool. Select any key from the dynamic Circle of Fifths diagram to instantly view its major and minor scales, including enharmonic equivalents. See at a glance the number of sharps or flats and the specific notes involved.
The intuitive design highlights your chosen key, providing both visual and textual information to deepen your understanding of music theory. Perfect for musicians at any level, this feature makes learning key signatures engaging and straightforward.
Enhance your music theory knowledge by exploring the Circle of Fifths in a whole new way. Dive into key signatures and unlock the secrets of harmony with ease.
CHORDS IN KEY SIMPLIFIED
Effortlessly explore all the chords within any key using our interactive “Chords in Key” feature, seamlessly integrated with the Circle of Fifths. Select a key to instantly view its related major and minor chords displayed in an intuitive layout.
Tap on any chord to hear it played, connecting visual patterns with actual sounds. The interactive Circle of Fifths adapts to your selection, making it easy to understand chord relationships and progressions. Perfect for musicians and songwriters looking to deepen their harmonic knowledge and enhance their musical creativity.
Experience the Circle of Fifths like never before, and simplify your understanding of chords in any key.
VISUALIZE CHORD SHAPES INSTANTLY
Unlock a deeper understanding of chords with our interactive “Chord Shapes” feature, powered by the Circle of Fifths. Select any root note and chord type to see its shape displayed on the Circle of Fifths.
The app highlights chord tones on both the Circle of Fifths and a virtual piano keyboard, bridging the gap between music theory and practical application. Listen to each chord with the built-in playback feature, connecting visual patterns with actual sounds.
Perfect for musicians at any level, this feature makes exploring chord shapes engaging and straightforward. Unlock advanced chords by upgrading to the full version and support further app development by an indie developer.
Dive into the Circle of Fifths and visualize chord shapes like never before.
Embark on a musical journey with the Circle of Fifths as your guide. Download the app now and transform the way you learn and play music!

bluejetty:00039829:ios.description:
Cyclemeter is the ultimate cycling app for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch. Transform your iPhone into a powerful cycling tracker and training tool, designed specifically for cyclists and individual sports enthusiasts. With advanced tracking, customizable stats, training plans, and live biking metrics, Cyclemeter is your companion for cycling, running, hiking, and more.
Top Features for Cyclists
- Cycling-Specific Tracking: Record cycling speed, distance, cadence, power, heart rate, and elevation with unmatched accuracy, using compatible fitness sensors
- Barometric Altimeter: Use your iPhone to precisely measure ascent and descent
- Maps & Navigation: View terrain and traffic maps powered by Google Maps, essential for cycling route safety
- Live Tracking for Safety: Share your real-time location, path and stats with friends and family for safety and encouragement
- Bike Radar: Show relative distances and speeds of oncoming vehicles with Garmin Varia and Bryton Gardia bike radar tail lights
Built for Individual Sports Enthusiasts
- Tracks cycling, running, walking, hiking, skiing, and more
- Configurable workout pages with maps, graphs, stats, and lap data
- Securely store years of cycling, biking and workout data on your iPhone
Training & Performance Analysis
- Analyze splits, intervals, and zones to enhance your biking performance
- Compete against past rides on your favorite cycling routes
- Keep on track with configurable interval training, zones, and targets
- Create custom cycling, biking and running training plans or use built-in 5K, 10K, half, and marathon plans
- Share an online Workout Explorer for analyzing workouts
Voice-Enabled Cycling Experience
- Use Siri for hands-free control on your ride: start, stop, lap, and request stats by simply asking
- Select from more than hundreds of configurable announcements to get real-time audio feedback on distance, time, speed, elevation, and heart rate
- Configurable announcements tailored for cyclists
- Messages are automatically spoken to you with text-to-speech
Private, Secure, & Connected
- Workout & cycling data is securely stored on your iPhone, ensuring privacy
- Optional live tracking and messaging for added safety during rides
- Optional iCloud backup is encrypted
- No user names or passwords are required
“Obsessively complete” — Wired
“Records a wealth of data” — Macworld
“Clean, easy-to-use” — New York Times
Apple Watch Integration
- Start, stop, lap and finish a workout all from the Apple Watch
- Beautiful cycling gauges and zone tracking optimized for cyclists
Share Your Rides & Fitness Data
- Share by email, Strava, or MyFitnessPal
- Use HealthKit to export or import your workouts in the Health app and to read heart rate and biometric data
- Share to your iPhone calendar and your online calendars
- Imports and exports GPX, TCX, FIT, KML, and CSV
Upgrade to Elite for Advanced Cyclist Features
- Includes a 7-day free trial with advanced metrics and tools.
- Subscription options for enhanced cycling analysis and training.

Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable.
With Cyclemeter, every cyclist can achieve their fitness goals while enjoying the most advanced cycling app available. Whether you're a road cyclist, mountain biker, or casual rider, Cyclemeter delivers the tools and insights to elevate your cycling experience.
Download Cyclemeter now and unlock the ultimate app for cyclists!

bluejetty:00043490:ios.summary: Introducing upay app which provides easy, secured and innovative Digital Financial Solutions, and helps you elevate lifestyle in just a few simple taps. The state of the art upay app ensures ease for your most frequent transactions like sen
bluejetty:00043490:ios.description:
Introducing upay app which provides easy, secured and innovative Digital Financial Solutions, and helps you elevate lifestyle in just a few simple taps. The state of the art upay app ensures ease for your most frequent transactions like send money to others, add money from all major banks, cash out with lowest charge from agents and ATMs, pay all your utility bill payments, recharge your mobile phone from all operators and also make instant payments at your favorite stores- both online and offline. 
As a subsidiary of United Commercial Bank (UCB), upay app also ensures the highest possible security through block-chain based technology and widespread availability all across Bangladesh. 
Things you can do in upay app:
Instant Registration
You can easily register for a new upay account in just about a few minutes right from upay app. All you require is your National ID card and you are ready to go.
Add Money from Bank Account or Debit/Credit Card
Transfer money instantly to your upay account through any banks or Debit/Credit Card. Add money easily to your upay account within seconds using an eligible debit / credit card or bank account.
Mobile recharge to any number
Recharge your mobile or any other number from all major operations in Bangladesh, including Grameenphone, Robi, Airtel, Banglalink and Teletalk. You can also find latest prepaid and postpaid recharge plans and best recharge based Internet, Voice and bundle offers only on upay app.
Bill Payments – Electricity, Water, Gas, Telephone, Internet, Credit Card and others
Pay your utility bills such as Electricity, Water, Gas etc. for all major providers like DESCO, NESCO, Titas, WASA etc. right from the comfort of your own home. You can also pay your credit card bill, internet bill, telephone bill and many more. 
Safe, Secure & Contactless Payments at Offline Stores
Easily pay at your nearby grocery stores, pharmacies, restaurants, retail stores and thousands more across the country by scanning QR code or through mobile number. 
Secured Mobile Banking
Security is of utmost importance to us and we prioritize making you feel safe and secured by taking necessary measures to protect your account. Through our modern blockchain based technology, you can rest assured that all of your transactions are highly secured. In addition, to give you greater control, you only can access your upay account only through your registered device. Hence, no need to worry about losing your PIN as no one can access your upay account from other mobile devices. 
Online Payments
You can order groceries, medicines, food, gadgets online and pay via upay with ease. You can make quick online payments at your favorite shopping, food delivery, travel and gaming brands including Daraz, Evaly, Chaldal, Shohoz, just to name a few.
Your Own Wallet
For the first time in Bangladesh, you will have your own wallet which will give you a liberty of checking where your money is coming from, including Salary, Disbursement and Remittance. With such a personalized wallet, you can enjoy exclusive upay reward.
Ease of Access
upay is always looking out for you to give convenience and ease in your life. Keeping that at the core, upay app has certain features that can ease some of your pains.
You can now avoid the hassle of constantly calculating the charge on cash out and simply add the Cash Out charge, to give more ease for the receiver. Through a simple tap, Cash Out charge will be automatically calculated whenever you are sending money to another upay account.
Use the app in either Bangla or English, and change between the two whenever you want.
Much Better Transparency
No need to take the hassle of sending screenshots to affirm a successful transaction. Now you can simply share the successful confirmation report in pdf format through any file sharing platforms. 
For further details, please visit our website at https://www.upaybd.com.

Meditation has an important role in your life now that you have so many characters to play. We believe that willingness is the most important fuel for you to accomplish your goals and it gets spend it in the first hours of your day.
Taking 10 minutes to meditate with Beatfulness will improve your willingness by reminding yourself your purpose for the role you are acting now.
How can we do this? Meditation is straightforward but some of us just connected with ourselves in a different way, that's when binaural beats and sacred geometry come handy.
In each session you'll have a specific binaural beat with a specific purpose as well as a specific universe and sacred geometry visual.

Welcome to Match Triple 3D: Matching Game! This brand-new puzzle game is designed to train your brain with its unique and engaging gameplay .
The rules are simple: as a player, your goal is to find and tap three identical 3D objects on the table to clear the level . You can use boosters to complete levels even faster! Each level has a time limit, so you need to clear all objects before time runs out to win .
FEATURES:
A New Brain-Training Puzzle: Entertain and challenge your mind for minutes or hours. The game is designed to help improve your memory, attention, and logical thinking skills .
Endless Fun with Diverse Objects: Discover a huge variety of fun and cute 3D items inspired by daily life, including animals, food, cars, toys, and emojis .
Challenging Levels: Experience well-designed levels that are easy to start but offer increasing challenges to keep you engaged .
Rewards and Progression: Earn stars and rewards after completing levels to help you progress further .
Flexible Gameplay: You can pause the game whenever you want, making it a perfect time-killer for your busy schedule .
What are you waiting for? Warm up your fingers and start playing Match Triple 3D: Matching Game today.

bluejetty:00175893:ios.name: Wild West Sniper: Cowboy War
bluejetty:00175893:ios.summary:
Welcome to the world of Wild West Sniper, an FPS game equipped with great graphics and realistic sound effects!
Wild West Sniper game offers you to be the hero of the west world, where you can shoot in the world of westland, save the town
bluejetty:00175893:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Wild West Sniper, an FPS game equipped with great graphics and realistic sound effects!
Wild West Sniper game offers you to be the hero of the west world, where you can shoot in the world of westland, save the town from militants. As the town's sheriff, you must protect the town from enemies, and complete missions that get harder as you level up.
In this game, you will experience various conflict areas and scenarios, such as the capture of a military base by militants, and the liberation of the base from militants. Can you hit all the targets as a first person shooter, fps of shooting games?
Wild West Sniper is a kind of battlefield game where you can destroy enemy targets with a bunch of sniper 3D assassin guns and rifles. Are you ready for this action to become the master of shooter games and the westland world?
Sometimes it will be enough to just hit the target they are standing in front of, not the enemy soldiers. Helicopters, vehicles, gas tankers, ammunition depots will be targets in the game and these targets will be marked with red. You have to hit the targets and play the legend of the shooter games to continue to the next level and rank up!
Feature of the game: 
- Addictive gameplay
- Challenging scenarios 
- Lots of different sniper guns
- Training that develops aiming skills!
- Aim the target and take your best shot!
- Unique quality graphics and realistic sound effects!
As you level up, you will rank up and you will be able to get different weapons. So remember to play the game regularly and strive to pass the challenging levels. In this action and adventure sniper game you will crawl on the ground, run, find the target, hold your breath and release the trigger. Congratulations, you took your best shot and saved the town!
Start playing this action-packed war game to become a western sniper and hero now and explore the challenging world of Wild West Sniper.
Enjoy Wild West Sniper committed to the action!

bluejetty:00091184:ios.description:
Veriswap is the safest way to trade sports cards and TCG slabs online.
Say goodbye to sketchy forum deals, dangerous local meetups, and the anxiety of shipping first. Veriswap acts as a secure middleman for every deal—authenticating both sides, insuring shipments from end to end, and letting you swap cards with total peace of mind.
HOW IT WORKS
1. UPLOAD YOUR COLLECTION
• Add raw or graded cards in seconds by typing in the cert number.
• Automatically populates data for PSA, BGS (Beckett), SGC, CGC, and CSG slabs.
• Show off your personal collection and set cards available for trade.
2. NEGOTIATE & DEAL
• Propose trades with a single tap.
• Add cash to either side to balance out high-value deals.
• Trade rare 1-for-1, package multi-card bundles, or trade up for your grail.
• Counteroffer seamlessly until both sides agree.
3. SECURE SHIP & SWAP
• Ship your cards directly to the Veriswap Authentication Hub.
• Our expert team verifies card authenticity and certs on both ends.
• Once verified, we dispatch the items to their new owners—or send them directly to your Veriswap Vault.
• Fully insured protection from the moment you ship until arrival.
THE VERISWAP VAULT
• Instant Trading: Store your high-value slabs in our secure, climate-controlled vault to trade instantly without waiting for shipping.
• Zero Friction: Trade vaulted cards back and forth without having to ship them home between deals.
• On-Demand Delivery: Keep your slabs safely stored with us and request home delivery whenever you're ready.
WHAT YOU CAN TRADE
• Sports Cards: Baseball, Basketball, Football, Hockey, Soccer, F1 & more.
• TCG & Anime: Pokémon, One Piece, Magic: The Gathering (MTG), Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana & more.
• Card Types: Autographs, Patch Booklets, Serial-Numbered Parallels, Rookie Cards, Vintage Slabs, and Modern Gems.
WHY COLLECTORS TRUST VERISWAP
• Zero "Ship First" Risk: A true escrow middleman system for every single transaction.
• Full Insurance Coverage: Both sides protected against loss, damage, or postal issues.
• Built for the Hobby: Designed specifically for collectors trading high-value PSA , BGS , and SGC slabs.
• Secure Vault Storage: Skip repetitive shipping times and trade at the speed of the market.
Whether you're consolidating your collection into a grail piece, finishing a set, or moving duplicate slabs, Veriswap gives you the security of a card show trade right from your phone.
Download Veriswap today and start swapping with confidence!

bluejetty:00092014:ios.description:
Hit music + great coaches + gift card rewards = fitness results
Take a screen break with CardioCast’s music-driven audio classes. Easy-to-follow coaching and perfectly curated playlists will keep you fully connected with your workout while you disconnect from everything else!
Cycling, running, walking, jogging, elliptical, rowing, yoga, bodyweight boot camp, even dog-walking! CardioCast has a workout for everyone at every fitness level.
"Forget that pricey studio class—for the SoulCycle or Flywheel experience, all you need is a gym bike, an iPhone, and this workout app." -SHAPE
Subscriptions start at just $7.50 per month - far less than you’d pay at a studio or other popular streaming services. Also, we know it can be tough to show up every day to work out. That’s why our unique Burn & Earn incentive program rewards you with Amazon.com Gift Cards for staying consistent.*
Try it free for 7 days and see why thousands of people love getting fit with CardioCast’s audio workout classes!
WHY CARDIOCAST?
1. Music from your favorite artists; the latest pop & EDM hits to legendary rock classics.
2. Real coaches who listen to your feedback and inspire you to give it your all.
3. Earn Amazon.com Gift Cards* every month if you work out regularly.**
4. 20, 30, 45, or 60-minute workouts to fit your schedule.
5. Work out anywhere without fancy equipment.
6. Track your progress and sync your results with the Health app.
7. Join a supportive community!
WHAT OUR COMMUNITY SAYS:
"CardioCast is more than an app. It’s a community that keeps one accountable. The coaches ask for input from the community and are very approachable themselves. The music playlist is fantastic! Invest in yourself and this app. You won’t regret it!"
"Who even needs a Peloton? You don’t with this app. Any bike will do. Save some cash and crush just as many calories!"
"This app just keeps getting better! Even more workout options and the customer service is great."
"This is the best cycling app I’ve tried. Got a Peloton but returned it because this app is better! The beats rides are motivating and a great workout!"
"Great app and love the running classes! Not having a bike around, I started running again instead and enjoyed the running classes. They are tough but can always adjust according to the level I need."
"This app has been so motivating! The audio is absolutely great. I love how you can adjust the instructor's voice and music separately. I’m just getting back into running and this is a great way to jump back in."
"As much as I love a good indoor cycling class, finding the time to get one can be difficult. I have my own bike but needed something to push me through a good workout. The variety of workout lengths is great!"
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
CardioCast is the best kept secret in fitness. Get the same fitness benefits you'd expect from brands like Spinning®, Peloton®, SoulCycle®, Flywheel Sports®, Barry’s Bootcamp®, or Orange Theory® without breaking the bank. You can work out at home or at the gym at a time that is right for YOUR schedule.
• 7-day free trial
• $9.99 for one month
• $89.99 for 1 year (~$7.50 per month) - plus earn up to 50% back with Burn & Earn!
Subscription automatically renews and account will be charged unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Auto-renewal may be turned off in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
*Restrictions apply, see amazon.com/gc-legal
**Rules & restrictions apply, see site for details

bluejetty:00014742:ios.summary: Introducing Snowbunny: The NEWEST, FASTEST mobile browser for your iPhone and iPad! Spend more time browsing and less time waiting! Also featuring FULL SCREEN BROWSING and PRIVATE BROWSING functionality! Get this essential web browser for y
bluejetty:00014742:ios.description:
Introducing Snowbunny: The NEWEST, FASTEST mobile browser for your iPhone and iPad! Spend more time browsing and less time waiting! Also featuring FULL SCREEN BROWSING and PRIVATE BROWSING functionality! Get this essential web browser for you iPhone and iPad today! + it is COMPLETELY FREE!
KEY FEATURES:
1. SUPER FAST (even faster loading and displaying than Safari*)
2. FULL SCREEN (beautiful full screen, up to 35% more viewable area^)
3. PRIVATE MODE (leave no history, cookies, or anything behind)
4. COMPLETELY FREE (no ad bars, other than what's already on the web)
HOW IT WORKS:
1. SPEED
Snowbunny is a highly speed optimised browser using same backend as mobile safari but with code extensively optimized for performance. non-essential features like multi tabs, loading bars have all stripped out to provide an ultra clean, ultra fast, yet fully HTML 5 compliant browser to your mobile device! Our tests show that loading, start up, shutdown, search, and navigation speeds all exceed Safari and other popular browsers by a noticeable margin.
2. FULL SCREEN
We've consolidated the top and bottom tool bars as seen in Safari into one context sensitive navigation bar saving plenty of space. In addition this toolbar can be hidden simply by browsing down a web page. As well as this, we've removed the annoying status bar at the top of the screen to gain 100% pixel usage when displaying any web page. You can view web pages beautifully using the maximum screen real-estate.
3. PRIVATE MODE
Private mode can be enabled via settings. In private browsing mode all history, cookies, login details are completely cleared when you exit or swap between apps. No one will know where you've been!
OTHER FEATURES
- Portrait & Landscape support
- Scrolling, zooming
- Bookmarks
- HTML 5 Web videos, audio streaming
- Full screen video playback
- Context sensitive menus
- iPhone, iPod, iPad, iPhone 4 support
- Similar UI to Safari.
- No autosuggest or auto fill in.
- Tiny download so you can get it quickly.
More Apps:
http://www.savysoda.com
* Based on our in-house testing. Not independently verified.
^ 35% more viewable area on iPhone Landscape Mode. 20%+ in iPhone Portrait Mode.

bluejetty:00175457:ios.description:
Good health comes first!
RENPHO Health is the best helper in your journey to becoming fitter. The app can track multiple body composition metrics (BMI, Body Fat %, Body Water, Bone Mass, Basal Metabolism Body Age, Muscle Mass, etc). The cloud-based App’s intelligent data analysis and tracking abilities makes it your perfect digital personal helper. It can even convert your data stored over time into charts and reports that can easily be shared by e-mail and multiple social media channels. On top of all that, your entire family can use the App! RENPHO Health allows the user to create multiple personal profiles to keep your data separated.
When you use our smart body scales measuring body composition , weight, percentage of body fat , fat weight, height, body mass index (BMI), height and resting calorie consumption data will be synchronized to HealthKit in.
How to connect to Apple Health:
1. After install the Renpho Health App and log in successfully for the first time, a pop-up will prompt to ask whether to allow Renpho Health to access all your health data, please tap Allow in the upper right corner;
2. Open Apple Health, enter your profile, tap Apps> Renpho Health, tap Turn All Categories On;
3. After authorization, your Body Fat Percentage, Body Mass Index, and Lean Body Mass will be synchronized to Apple Health.
PLEASE note:
1.When you have purchased one of our medical products (such as a blood pressure monitor), please consult your doctor if you experience any discomfort during use, and the data is for reference only.
2.Medical devices are only available in the USA and UK

bluejetty:00099800:ios.description:
Dive into a mesmerizing world of hexagonal puzzles where gravity is your ally! HexaDrop revolutionizes match-3 gameplay with its innovative rotating grid system and physics-based mechanics.
 **UNIQUE FEATURES:**
• **Gravity Rotation**: Tap to rotate the entire hex grid and change gravity direction
• **Strategic Dropping**: Watch hexagons fall and stack in stunning formations 
• **Match & Clear**: Connect 3 or more identical hexagons to clear them
• **Vibrant Elements**: 7 different hex types with beautiful orange and purple backgrounds
• **Mind-Bending Physics**: Master the art of gravity manipulation
 **GAMEPLAY:**
Start your journey by tapping to drop the first hexagon, then rotate the grid to control where new pieces fall. Plan your moves carefully as gravity pulls hexagons toward the bottom of the rotated grid. Match identical colors and types to clear the board and score big!
 **PERFECT FOR:**
• Puzzle game enthusiasts
• Fans of innovative mechanics
• Players who love strategic thinking
• Anyone seeking a fresh take on match-3 games
 **WHY HEXADROP STANDS OUT:**
Unlike traditional match-3 games, HexaDrop combines hexagonal geometry with dynamic gravity physics. Every tap changes the game board orientation, creating endless strategic possibilities and addictive gameplay that will keep you coming back for more.
Download HexaDrop now and experience the future of puzzle gaming!

bluejetty:00128538:ios.description:
Countdown Time tracks upcoming events in beauty and elegance.
Have your most anticipated events right at your fingertips with Countdown Time. Events are tracked to the second in real-time with razor accuracy. Feel the excitement as the day draws closer and share it with friends and family. Pick from hundreds of beautiful backgrounds to truly bring your event to life and make the day uniquely yours.
Features
- Track as many events as you want
- Fully customizable widget
- Beautiful, sleek and elegant design
- Multiple themes
- Pick from hundreds of HD backgrounds or use your own
- Daily notifications
- Personalize your event with display modes and headings
- Built-in event sharing
Start the countdown!
Events are what make life shine. They are the moments we will forever be looking back on; and the moments we can't wait for. Whether it's your sister's wedding, your son's graduation or your own birthday, you know that it will be a day to remember.
Use it for a holiday trip, vacation travel abroad or an anniversary that you can't forget. Keep track of big days like Christmas or New Years eve. Daily notifications will keep you up to date with your events and milestones while the widget gives you an instant glance at your date.
Forgo a clunky calendar for a sleek and beautiful countdown timer: It's your big day and you need it to be as magnificent as it can. A simple calendar won't do it justice. The count down starts today - set your clock.
More than just Christmas, weddings and birthdays
Use Countdown Time for tracking any event. Any event at all! Set up a countdown app to a big presentation, track the seconds until a family dinner, set the widget to count down to your birthday or measure the amount of breaths until a romantic date.
No day is too big or too small to be tracked in the app. It's completely up to you and what you want your milestones to be. Set your date and let Countdown Time and its widget take care of your vacation, holiday or wedding day.
Your day, your way
It's your event and you get to choose how you want the clock to count down to it. Choose the full-on experience by opening the app or an at-a-glance look with the widget.
Count down in days, heartbeats, years and more - just pick the display mode that fits your big day. The app comes with breathtaking backgrounds that go with any occasion: from wedding days and to travel.
Your clock is what you want it to be and your date is when you want it to be. Choose from 15 app themes to personalize your count down clock.
Build the excitement. Share the moment.
Your excited about the big day - that's why they are called big days after all! You go to bed every night with dreams of your vacation in Paris or your wedding date. Or both - perhaps your wedding is in Paris while you're on vacation! Up the anticipation by adding a daily reminder of these big days to your life.
Count down the days to your next big holiday and share it with your friends and family. The built-in sharing lets you instantly share a beautiful snapshot of your clock with friends and family. Use the gentle daily notifications as a reminder to get Christmas presents.
Show your loved ones how many days until your birthday to hint for that "surprise" birthday party. Count the days until your graduation and freedom. 
Get Countdown Time now to bring excitement and anticipation to your big events!

bluejetty:00038500:ios.name: Rankers Camping NZ
bluejetty:00038500:ios.summary:
Kia ora, we’re Rankers, a small 100% NZ-owned crew, collecting camping and travel knowledge since 2007. We’ve spent 20 years in our campervan, have stayed in these places and share the truth with you about what's good.
Rankers Camping NZ s
bluejetty:00038500:ios.description:
Kia ora, we’re Rankers, a small 100% NZ-owned crew, collecting camping and travel knowledge since 2007. We’ve spent 20 years in our campervan, have stayed in these places and share the truth with you about what's good.
Rankers Camping NZ shows over 1500 places you can stay, including those where the local community has said you’re welcome. Add over 108k traveller reviews (every single one read by a real person) and a fair whack of hard-won local knowledge, and you can set off with confidence. It’s free, the campsite info works offline from day one, and we don’t sell your data to anyone. We explain how we pay for this below.
• If it shows on this app, you’re welcome to stay
We show camping spots where the local community has officially said yes to overnight stays - free ones and paid ones. No sneaking around at dusk trying to find somewhere, no looking over your shoulder in the morning. It’s all about respect, and the good things that brings to all of us. Put your feet up and relax.
• Local knowledge you can’t google
Our co-owner Cymen has spent twenty years leaving on-the-ground campsite notes: which end of the campground is quietest, where the hidden toilet is, when to arrive so you actually get a spot. None of it scraped, none of it crowd-guessed. Someone went there.
• We don’t sell it, we don’t trade it, we don’t give it to anyone
That’s our whole data policy, more or less. We collect the bare minimum to get the job done, and almost everything in the app works without you telling us anything at all. No creepy tracking, no ads following you around the internet afterwards. Our business isn’t harvesting data - it’s camping.
• Save 10-15% and keep a local app alive
Over 150 activity deals at 10-15% off with the code RANKERS. Plus around 500 bookable campground options - and every booking helps keep a local app free. If you appreciate how we go about things, this is how you can support us.
• Every review read by a real person
Over 108,000 traveller reviews, and every single one has been read and checked by a human on our crew - not a computer. Nobody gets to be anonymous, every reviewer verifies their email, and if an operator disputes the facts we suspend the review while we sort out what’s true. We spent years collecting reviews face-to-face with a clipboard, on the road - the habit of checking never left. Untrusted reviews are a complete waste of time.
• Made by a few humans, not a platform
Camping NZ is run by a handful of Kiwis working around our families, kids and the vege patch. No investors, no head office, nobody to keep happy except you. Which is why this app is allowed to have actual opinions - like which end of a campground has the quiet toilet, or whether anyone’s honestly going to use that portable loo stored under the bed. The big apps can’t talk like that. We can, so we do.
• Works offline straight out of the box
Every campsite, all the info is built right into the app. No signal, no setup - day one, well out of range, it’s in your pocket. Detailed maps are a download while you’ve got wifi. The difference is you’re never left staring at a blank app. Not too shabby.
• All of NZ camping, one free app
Over 1,500 campsites and over 6,600 places all up - dump stations, water refills, LPG, playgrounds, free wifi that doesn’t do silly nonsense to your privacy, i-SITEs and the folks in green at DOC visitor centres. From a full-facility holiday park to an isolated hideaway with one long-drop and a view. Free to download, free to use.
Plus:
• Filter for Top Ranked holiday parks, DOC and free sites
• Full details, photos, rules and pricing for every location
• All public and holiday park dump stations
• Travellers' essentials - fuel, supermarkets, playgrounds, free water, LPG
• Local goodies - markets, roadside stalls, farm gate produce
• Save your favourites to the map
• Improve the app with your own photos and reviews
• Proudly designed and developed in Aotearoa NZ by the Rankers crew

The result: a training system that comprehensively improves brain performance, from the most basic elements of perception through the most complex elements of memory, attention, and cognitive function.

• cognitive improvements, such as better memory and faster processing speed
• real-world improvements, including safer driving and improved quality of life

bluejetty:00148263:ios.description:
Plan your next Southern California fishing trip with Captain Dave Hansen. Get weekly fishing game plans, explore SoCal hot spots and learn alongside a community of anglers.
WEEKLY FISHING GAME PLANS
Head into the weekend with a plan. New game plans every Thursday cover coastal, offshore and island fishing, with seasonal guidance for species such as bluefin tuna and lobster. Learn where to focus, what to bring and how to approach your next trip.
SOCAL FISHING HOT SPOTS
Explore fishing locations around Catalina Island, San Clemente Island, the Coronado Islands, the Channel Islands and the Southern California coast. Watch Captain Dave explain spots with GPS coordinates shown in the lessons, plus practical advice on bait, anchoring and current. Learn how to fish a location, not just where it is.
A COMMUNITY THAT GETS IT
Ask questions, share fishing reports and trade local knowledge with Captain Dave and fellow members. Post photos and videos from your trips, learn from other anglers and stay connected between days on the water.
400+ FISHING VIDEOS
Build your skills with lessons on knots, rigging, bait, tackle and fishing techniques. Whether you are getting started or refining your approach, find practical guidance you can take on your next trip.
YOUR GUIDE, WHEREVER YOU GO
Watch on your phone or tablet and access your membership on the Your Saltwater Guide website. Keep your fishing lessons and weekly plans close at hand.
Join the gang and start planning your next day on the water.

bluejetty:00097932:ios.summary: Twisted knots, tangled threads, and colorful chaos await! Thread Joy 3D challenges you to transform messy rope tangles into beautiful, organized art. This satisfying 3D puzzle game combines the relaxation of untangling with the joy of creat
bluejetty:00097932:ios.description:
Twisted knots, tangled threads, and colorful chaos await! Thread Joy 3D challenges you to transform messy rope tangles into beautiful, organized art. This satisfying 3D puzzle game combines the relaxation of untangling with the joy of creating stunning rope designs.
Untangle Your Way to Victory
Face increasingly complex tangles as you progress through hundreds of challenging levels. Use your spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills to identify key knots and strategically unravel each puzzle. Watch with satisfaction as chaotic jumbles transform into elegant, organized patterns with each thoughtful move.
Vibrant 3D Visuals
Immerse yourself in a colorful 3D world where threads come alive! Experience realistic rope physics and watch as your untangled creations twist, turn, and settle into place. The stunning visual feedback makes every successful untangle deeply satisfying.
Exercise Your Mind
What looks simple at first glance quickly becomes a brain-teasing challenge! Thread Joy 3D exercises your spatial reasoning, pattern recognition, and problem-solving skills. Feel your mind engage as you analyze each tangle and devise the perfect untangling strategy.
Play Your Way
With no timers or pressure, untangle at your own pace. Whether you have five minutes or an hour, Thread Joy 3D adapts to your schedule. Perfect for relaxing breaks or deep puzzle sessions that exercise your brain while melting away stress.
Features That Stand Out
- Realistic 3D rope physics and animations
- Hundreds of unique puzzles with increasing complexity
- Relaxing soundtrack to enhance your untangling experience
- Special power-ups to help with particularly challenging knots
- Daily challenges with exclusive rewards
Unwind, Untangle, Unwind
Download Thread Joy 3D now and discover why millions are finding peace in the art of untangling! Transform chaos into order one thread at a time and experience the unique satisfaction that only perfectly untangled ropes can provide.

bluejetty:00179705:ios.name: Ball Sort Master
bluejetty:00179705:ios.summary:
Sort balls into tubes with HINTS. It is a smooth, fast, relaxing, and free ball puzzle game.
Here are the most important features of the Ball Sort Master with Hints:
*** HINTS ***
Do you have doubts about what move you should make? Use h
bluejetty:00179705:ios.description:
Sort balls into tubes with HINTS. It is a smooth, fast, relaxing, and free ball puzzle game.
Here are the most important features of the Ball Sort Master with Hints:
*** HINTS ***
Do you have doubts about what move you should make? Use hints! This is the most unique feature of Ball Sort Master, which you don’t find in most logical sorting games.
Or… If you are brave enough to do it without hints, you can sort the color balls on your own. Try to solve all the logical puzzles and grab the prizes.
*** UNDO ***
We sometimes make mistakes, don’t we? Now, you don’t have to worry about that! Undo your move!
*** SAFE STATE ***
If there are no more moves, you will be directed to the place in the board where sorting balls is still possible.
*** STEPS ***
 The fewer steps you make, the higher score you get!
*** EXTRA TUBE ***
 This is the super-helpful feature for sorting! Use an extra tube and make ball sort levels easier.
*** SAVING ***
Your puzzle game is saved automatically. There is no need to be afraid of losing your progress. Close the game any moment, and next time you can start it from the same balls sorting position.
*** CUSTOMIZATION ***
Click the shopping cart and tailor your profile to suit you. You can customize anything you want. Choose between the great variety of theme colors, shapes of tubes, or the color of your sorting balls. Don’t forget to pick your own favorite avatar!
*** STATISTICS ***
Tap your avatar and get transferred to the statistics. There’s a place where you can check your data, e.g., your rank, the stars you have earned, the number of hints you have used, and much more.
*** HOW TO PLAY ***
- Tap a tube to select a ball.
- Tap another tube to move the selected ball...
...and that’s all! Isn’t it easy?
*** RULES ***
You can only place balls of the same color on top of each other. Try to find empty tubes first, and then move balls there. The best solution to solve the puzzle doesn't exist. Every single way that leads to a win is perfect, so you can apply your own style of sorting balls.
Wanna go back to previous levels and fix your steps record? Just select the levels icon!
Another option is to restart any of the sorting balls levels.
Few more things about Ball Sort Master with Hints:
- No time limit or lives limit.
- Lots of levels to solve, and each one is diverse.
- The Internet or WiFi is not required to sort balls!
- Free and easy to play.
- This game will become your guilty pleasure!
Any questions or suggestions? Write to us!
Enjoy, and... May the balls be with you!

Tap your avatar and get transferred to the statistics. There’s a place where you can check your data, e.g., your rank, the stars you have earned, the number of hints you have used, and much more.

*** HOW TO PLAY ***

- Tap a tube to select a ball.
- Tap another tube to move the selected ball...

...and that’s all! Isn’t it easy?

*** RULES ***

You can only place balls of the same color on top of each other. Try to find empty tubes first, and then move balls there. The best solution to solve the puzzle doesn't exist. Every single way that leads to a win is perfect, so you can apply your own style of sorting balls.

Wanna go back to previous levels and fix your steps record? Just select the levels icon!

Another option is to restart any of the sorting balls levels.

Few more things about Ball Sort Master with Hints:
- No time limit or lives limit.
- Lots of levels to solve, and each one is diverse.
- The Internet or WiFi is not required to sort balls!
- Free and easy to play.
- This game will become your guilty pleasure!

Any questions or suggestions? Write to us!

Enjoy, and... May the balls be with you!

bluejetty:00142608:ios.description:
Seep King, the online Seep card game played by 700,000+ players and rated 4.6 out of 5
Welcome to Seep King, the online multiplayer Seep card game (also known as Sweep, Siv or Shiv), built for fans of classic Indian Taash. Match cards from the floor, capture big points, score a clean Seep and outplay real opponents in fast, competitive matches. Bid your coins, play the table and win big.
Whether you grew up playing Seep with friends and family or you're learning the rules for the first time, Seep King makes it free and easy to play anytime, anywhere.
Love Indian card games like Teen Patti, Rummy or Callbreak? You'll feel right at home. Seep brings the same desi taash thrill with a strategy all its own.
PLAY ONLINE WITH REAL PLAYERS
Jump into a quick match against competitive Seep players from India and around the world. Choose 1v1 head-to-head or 2v2 team partnership (the classic Seep modes), and climb from beginner to Seep King.
CLASSIC SEEP / SWEEP RULES, DONE RIGHT
Authentic Seep gameplay: bid, build houses, capture the floor and race to a 100-point baazi. Beautiful tables, smooth animations and balanced, fair card mechanics make every hand a true test of skill.
COMPETITIVE COIN STAKES
Pick your table, bid your coins and win big. Higher stakes, bigger rewards, weekly leaderboards. Prove you're the best Seep player around.
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Create a private room or send a challenge to your friends and play your own way. Invite your group and start a match in seconds.
LEADERBOARDS, REWARDS & MORE
Top the weekly leaderboards, win coins, level up to unlock new features and show off your title. Come back every day for free rewards.
CHAT & EMOJIS
Connect with players in-game, send animated emojis and gifts, and shout "Seep!" with your buddies. Low on coins? Ask a friend for help.
WHY PLAYERS LOVE SEEP KING
- 1v1 and 2v2 online multiplayer Taash
- Authentic, classic Seep / Sweep card game rules
- Smart, challenging opponents and fair matchmaking
- Competitive coin stakes, weekly leaderboards and big rewards
- Beautiful design, smooth gameplay, free to play
Download Seep King now, deal the cards and become the ultimate Seep King!
PLEASE NOTE: Seep King is free to download and play. Some optional in-game items can be purchased with real money, and a network connection is required.
Love Seep King? Rate us and tell your friends, and stay tuned for new features and game modes!

bluejetty:00084054:ios.description:
MONOPOLY: Bingo!
Roll the dice, daub your cards, and step into the world of MONOPOLY: Bingo! It’s not just bingo—it’s the iconic MONOPOLY game brought to life with a fun bingo twist. Join Mr. MONOPOLY on an exciting journey to collect properties, travel the world, and compete with players in a race to build your empire!
NOT JUST BINGO – IT’S MONOPOLY!
Play bingo like never before with a MONOPOLY twist! Roll the dice, acquire properties, build houses and hotels, and collect rent. Close deeds and create your ultimate MONOPOLY empire—all while enjoying thrilling bingo gameplay.
ICONIC MONOPOLY BOARDS WITH ROTATING FUN THEMES 
Immerse yourself in the classic MONOPOLY experience with boards inspired by the original game and enhanced with festive rotating themes! Daub and win to collect dice, then roll them to move around the MONOPOLY board. Explore properties, earn rewards, and enjoy the thrill of classic MONOPOLY gameplay with every roll!
UNLOCK EXCITING BONUS WHEEL
Daub special bonus cards and unlock the Bonus Wheel for huge payouts! Spin the wheel to land on property spaces, jackpots, or special tiles like railroads and utilities. You can unlock fun minigames for even more rewards! The higher your boost level, the bigger the payouts—get ready to win big!
MR. MONOPOLY’S CARD COLLECTION
Dive into the excitement of building your very own Mr. MONOPOLY card collection! Open card packs filled with surprises, uncover rare and unique cards and work to complete entire sets. Trade with friends to find those hard-to-get cards and build the ultimate collection. Each set captures the charm and personality of Mr. MONOPOLY in fun and creative ways.
COMPETE IN TOURNAMENTS WITH OTHER PLAYERS
Join the competition and climb the ranks in thrilling! Show off your skills as you daub, roll, and strategize your way to the top. Can you become the ultimate MONOPOLY: Bingo! champion?
TRAVEL THE WORLD AND UNLOCK NEW LOCATIONS
Pack your bags and explore the globe! Travel to stunning cities as you unlock new locations on the MONOPOLY map. Each city comes with its own unique challenges and rewards!
BUILD AND EXPAND YOUR MONOPOLY EMPIRE
Unlock properties, earn rewards, and daub your way to completing your MONOPOLY map. With each new achievement, you’ll grow closer to owning it all!
* INCLUDES RANDOM-ITEMS PURCHASES (Such as Card Packs & Power-ups purchases).
MONOPOLY: Bingo! is intended for those 18 and older for amusement purposes only and does not offer 'real money' gambling, or an opportunity to win real money or real prizes based on game play. Playing or success in this game does not imply future success at 'real money' gambling.
________________________________________
If you love MONOPOLY, bingo, or strategic games, MONOPOLY: Bingo! has it all! Join Mr. MONOPOLY and start your journey to become a real estate tycoon while enjoying the classic thrill of bingo.

bluejetty:00143725:ios.description:
Your AI diet coach - not just another food log.
Snap a photo of your meal. Pillyze counts the calories and macros, then your coach tells you how you did and what to eat next. Food, workouts, weight, water, fasting, supplements, and steps, all in one app.
Most apps stop at logging. Pillyze reads your data every day and answers back - in plain language, tailored to you.
[ AI DIET COACH: FOOD, WORKOUTS, WEIGHT ]
1. Photo calorie counting
Point your camera at your plate. AI identifies the food and calculates calories, protein, carbs, and fat, and flags the nutrients you are watching like added sugar and sodium. No photo? Search the database or log it by hand.
2. Feedback after every meal
Your coach scores your day, tells you how you did, and suggests what to eat next. Calorie and macro targets are built from your height, weight, activity level, and health data - not a one-size-fits-all formula.
3. A mission every morning
Based on yesterday's log and how you are feeling today. Small, specific, and doable - the kind of change that survives a busy week.
4. Everything syncs
Apple Health, InBody, and your smartwatch connect automatically, so workouts and weight log themselves. Fasting, water, cycle, steps, and how you are feeling live in the same place.
5. Ask your coach anything
Advice, a check-in, or a push when motivation runs out.
[ SUGARCARE: REAL-TIME GLUCOSE COACHING ]
Connect a FreeStyle Libre 2 sensor and watch your glucose update in real time. See your daily glucose score, peak and average readings, and variability at a glance, then get coaching that responds to how your body handled each meal. Food, exercise, and sleep, analyzed together.
[ SUPPLEMENT ANALYSIS BY PANACEA ]
Panacea, our nutrition AI, reviews your supplement stack for gaps, overlaps, and ingredients worth a second look. Recommendations are drawn from more than 30,000 supplements from the US and abroad, matched to your health profile, age, allergies, and current medications. Read real reviews and rankings from other users, and set reminders so you actually take them.
[ QUESTIONS? ]
Email support@pillyze.com or message us in the app.
[ IMPORTANT ]
Pillyze provides general wellness and nutrition information. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease, and it is not a substitute for advice from your doctor or pharmacist. Results vary from person to person. Talk to a healthcare professional before changing your diet, supplements, or medication.

bluejetty:00038103:ios.description:
GET HELP FINDING CARE YOU NEED
Doctr’s team of services coordinators will find and book an appointment for you in clinics near you. 
You can use Doctr to book an appointment in a walk-in clinic, with your family doctor and for various blood samples and imaging tests. 
You can also use Doctr to book an appointment with healthcare specialists such as Dermatologist, Gastroenterology, Gynecologist, Cardiologist, ENTs and more. 
CONSULT A DOCTOR ONLINE TODAY 
Consult a doctor or a nurse practitioner online today 
FOR YOU AND YOUR LOVED ONES 
Book medical appointment for family members and loved ones within a few minutes. Ideal for busy parents and caregivers.
ACCESS ER WAIT TIMES 
Can’t wait to consult a doctor? Doctr publishes the ER wait times of over 200 emergency rooms across Canada so that you can find the one nearest you. For life threatening emergencies, please call 9-1-1. 
IS DOCTR PRIVATE AND SECURE? 
Your safety and security are our top priorities. We protect your health data through robust encryption, account security features, and other policies and processes that meet the industry’s highest standards.
For more information about consultations and data, you can find our complete Privacy Policy online at doctr.ca/privacy-policy
By clicking on “INSTALL”, you agree to the installation of Doctr™ as well as any update or upgrade on your phone. 
Downloading this application implies acceptance of our "Terms and conditions of use" that can be found on www.doctr.ca /terms-and-conditions 
Please note that for all services rendered by Doctr involving the use of the client’s Quebec Health Insurance Plan card (RAMQ), Doctr acts independently and is not affiliated with any scheduling systems, clinics or any other establishment offering medical services. Doctr is not given priority for appointments before, during or after the execution of its mandate for the client during these services.

==K MANGA-Manga & Comics==
Welcome to K MANGA - the official Kodansha manga app where you can dive into your favorite Kodansha titles every day. With K MANGA, you can immerse yourself in renowned titles such as 'Attack on Titan', 'Ghost in the Shell', 'Fairy Tail', 'Hajime no Ippo: The Fighting Spirits', 'Tokyo Revengers', and many more.
Enjoy reading popular manga, ongoing series available simultaneously in Japan and the US, or explore new original series on K MANGA right from your phone or tablet. Dive into a new story whenever you like. Show your support for your favorite authors by reading the titles through official releases.
Why K MANGA?
- Access to a vast collection of over 500 titles from Kodansha’s Manga Catalog
- More than 60 original manga series available the moment they are published in Japan
- Discover fresh stories from your favorite titles, original series, and continuously added new titles
- Read a new chapter for free every day
- Encompasses a wide range of genres from Action, Romance, Sports, Isekai, Suspense, Drama, Fantasy, and more
- Official service that supports your favorite authors
Explore Famous Kodansha Manga:
- 'Attack on Titan'
- 'Ghost in the Shell'
- 'Fairy Tail'
- 'Hajime no Ippo: The Fighting Spirits'
- 'Tokyo Revengers'
- 'Initial D'
Discover K MANGA Original Series Simulpubbed with Japan:
- 'Don’t Toy With Me, Miss Nagatoro'
- 'The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity'
- 'WIND BREAKER'
- 'As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World'
- 'Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian'
Explore a diverse array of genres including Action, Romance, Sports, Isekai, Suspense, Outlaws, Drama, Fantasy, Slice of Life, Shojo, and more.
If you're a fan of K MANGA or curious about our latest titles, follow us on X: [https://twitter.com/KMANGA_KODANSHA] - Stay updated on our releases and exciting news!
