bluejetty:00119687:ios.description:
When your office is behind the wheel of a truck, finding your next load should be easy and convenient. Why? Because your time is money and hauling loads is your business.
Choose to rely on a provider that lets you focus on the road and manage your business, all through a free trucking app. Access the loads you want through a free load board, all with the touch of a button. Rest easier knowing you can always depend on live support from a team of TQL experts – 24/7/365.
As one of the largest freight brokerages in North America, TQL has invested heavily in technology designed for today’s professional truck driver. TQL Carrier Dashboard is available to all TQL-approved contract carriers to search, quote, and instantly book loads, plus submit check calls and paperwork on every load. Streamlining daily tasks from your phone has never been easier.
The benefits to your business include:
• Access to TQL’s free load board with 65,000+ available loads every week
• Unlimited load board searches and the ability to submit quotes on the loads you want
• Instant load booking on select load postings with Book it Now
• Ability to dispatch yourself, no phone call required
• View booked shipment details, including addresses, directions, and load numbers
• Reduced check calls by submitting location and status updates
• Faster payment processing with uploaded documents using your phone’s camera
• View payment history for completed loads
• The option to post your truck and let the right load find you
• Custom filters to set your load and lane search preferences
• Conveniently find loads back home from your current location
• Bilingual customer service
When it comes to hauling and managing your freight, trust the technology and industry-leading customer support from TQL.
We want to be your first choice when it comes to booking your next full truckload.
If you are new to TQL, begin the process of becoming a carrier today. Access our carrier registration at www.tqlcarriers.com or call 800.580.3101 to get started.
Stay in touch. Follow us on Facebook at https://business.facebook.com/TotalQualityLogistics/ to get the latest updates on TQL technology, services and news.

bluejetty:00024001:ios.description:
Welcome to Old Friends Dog Game, where love never grows old! 
You have just opened a sanctuary to rescue and care for senior dogs. Now the fun begins! Play out your dream of becoming an animal rescue worker, and help loveable dogs live their best lives at your sanctuary.
This heartwarming game is inspired by the rescue stories, antics, and quirks of the real-life residents at Old Friends Senior Dog Sanctuary. That’s right! Each adorable character is based on a real-life dog. Get to know their unique stories, personalities, special requirements, and favorite things.
Awarded Gold at the 2022 NYX Awards, Pocket Gamer ‘Game of the year’ finalist, and Webby honouree for Social Impact in Games. 
Gameplay
◆ Rescue and care for senior dogs - show them all your love and affection and grow their loyalty towards you. 
◆ Choose how the narrative unfolds - pick the path for each character’s story and unlock new chapters!
◆ Customize your sanctuary - decorate indoors and outdoors with furniture and decor that your dogs will love.
◆ Broadcast live streams and raise donations - use the funds to buy ingredients for the kitchen or new toys from the ‘barket’.
◆ Bake delicious treats - your sanctuary is equipped with a kitchen so you can feed hungry doggos!
◆ Dress up your residents in cute outfits - each dog has adorable accessories that you can earn throughout the game.
◆ Document your journey - make your very own sanctuary profile, complete with your custom avatar and full of cute snaps of your best doggo friends.
***By award-winning studio Runaway Play, with over 10 million downloads of wholesome games, including Furistas Cat Cafe, Splash: Ocean Sanctuary, Flutter: Butterfly Sanctuary and Flutter: Starlight***
This game is free to play but does contain some items to purchase for real money. If you run into any issues while playing or you have any suggestions, please reach out to us at support@runaway.zendesk.com. OLD FRIENDS DOG SANCTUARY™ is made by Runaway Play.

bluejetty:00038724:ios.name: Left: Widgets for Time Left
bluejetty:00038724:ios.summary: Left is a time-awareness app built on one idea: your time is limited, and seeing it changes how you use it. Left turns time into something you can see, then helps you act on it with habits, streaks, countdowns, and a planner for your day.
bluejetty:00038724:ios.description:
Left is a time-awareness app built on one idea: your time is limited, and seeing it changes how you use it. Left turns time into something you can see, then helps you act on it with habits, streaks, countdowns, and a planner for your day.
TIME LEFT
See where you are in the year, month, week, day, hour, and your life. Each unit is a symbol; the past dims, what remains stays in view. Your life in weeks, year progress, and life progress, made tangible. Choose dots, symbols, colors, and layouts. A quiet, honest way to face limited time without it becoming morbid.
HABITS, STREAKS & AIMS
Left is a habit tracker for the person you are trying to become. Build habits on any schedule: daily, several times a day, weekly, monthly, or custom. Track streaks and protect them, count the days since anything that matters, and set reminders so nothing slips. And you don't have to do it alone: share a habit or streak with a friend, keep each other accountable, and send kudos, cheers, and encouragement when it counts. With aims, you have a flexible goal tracker for anything you can count, helping you build up or cut down. Stay on track and see your progress every day.
AHEAD - COUNTDOWNS & DATES
Add the dates that pull you forward: trips, birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, weddings, deadlines, retirement, and personal milestones. Count down to each one, import from Apple Calendar, and track both the days until and the days since. New: every Ahead date now has its own to-do list, so you can plan the small tasks that make the date happen and check them off as it approaches. Share an Ahead date with a friend, follow it side by side, comment, and add to-dos together on joint dates.
PLANNER
Planner pulls everything that matters into one beautiful, time-first view: your habits, streaks, Ahead dates, Apple Calendar events, Apple Reminders, weather, sleep, and workouts, together at last. Not another calendar, but a clear, calm picture of what the day is actually asking of you. Because everything lives in one place instead of five apps, Planner is a quiet ally for ADHD minds: see the whole day at a glance and miss nothing. Two new widgets come with it: a Planner widget and a Calendar widget for your Home Screen.
FASTING TOOL
A simple yet beautiful fasting tool inside Left. Pick a fasting window, start it in a tap, and follow every fast live from your Lock Screen, widgets and the Dynamic Island. Your history and stats are all there too.
WHY LEFT
Other apps give you habits without design, or aesthetics without depth. Left combines both: the widget range, the design quality, and the full set of time tools, in one app made with restraint and taste.
Left requires a Premium plan to use its features. Choose a weekly, yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase to unlock everything.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00069999:ios.description:
*** THE #1 APP FOR SLEEP TRACKING ***
Sleep is a sequence of several cycles, each lasting 1.5 hours. A good night sleep consists of 5-6 complete cycles. If you wake up in the middle of the cycle, you feel groggy and exhausted. Therefore, to feel refreshed and alert, it is important to wake up between cycles. 
Sleep Timer counts sleep cycles, taking into account the average time needed for a person to fall asleep (it is 14 minutes). With this app, you can find out when to go to bed, if you need to wake up at a certain time or when to wake up if you go to sleep right now. Then, in just one click, you can set up an alarm to wake up at the right time.
---

Ninja’s Creed is definitely the first-person bow and arrow shooting game that you have been expected. As a ninja shooter, you not only need shooting skills, but also get powerful weapons to improve your strength. We choose different weapon this time except for gun, you will get a special game experience. Selecting the right weapon in different tasks will help you complete the task faster! Aim your target, be the area king!

bluejetty:00037923:ios.description:
"Find the Difference" is an engaging puzzle game that challenges players to spot discrepancies between two seemingly identical images. With its medium-sized description, imagine a captivating experience where players immerse themselves in meticulously crafted scenes, each bursting with vibrant colors and intricate details. From serene landscapes to bustling cityscapes, the game presents a diverse array of environments to explore.
Players must sharpen their observational skills as they meticulously scan each image, searching for subtle variations that distinguish one from the other. Whether it's a missing object, a shifted element, or a changed color, every dissimilarity holds the key to progressing to the next level.
With intuitive controls and a user-friendly interface, players of all ages can easily dive into the challenge. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a relaxing pastime or a seasoned puzzle enthusiast seeking a brain-teasing adventure, "Find the Difference" offers hours of immersive entertainment.
Embark on a visual journey filled with delightful surprises and hidden treasures waiting to be discovered. Are you ready to put your keen eye to the test and uncover the discrepancies that lie beneath the surface? Let the hunt for differences begin!

bluejetty:00068858:ios.description:
Nursing Dictionary by Farlex is a medical dictionary app specifically for nurses. Get free, instant access to more than 56,000 medical terms, 4,000 entries on medications, and 9,000 images, all from authoritative sources, including McGraw-Hill, Houghton Mifflin, Gale, Elsevier, and more.
Whether you're a nurse, nursing student, or looking to learn more about healthcare and treatment, this free nursing dictionary app can help you find clear, in-depth definitions of medical terminology right on your iPhone or iPad. Search across multiple disciplines in more than a dozen medical dictionary and encyclopedia sources, including entries on: 
Drug facts and interactions
Patient monitoring
Anatomy
Diseases 
Treatments 
Tests and procedures
The five-step nursing process
Nursing intervention
Nursing specializations 
Medical research topics
+ much more…
FEATURES:
* Search 56,000+ medical terms and definitions from multiple authoritative sources you won't find anywhere else—all in one app.
* Get in-depth info on more than 4,000 prescription medications and over-the-counter medicines in the comprehensive drug guide.
* Browse thousands of medical abbreviations and acronyms. 
* Save unlimited bookmarks and quickly view the terms you need to access fast. 
* Use native voice search to look up a word just by saying it. (With supported devices)
* See search suggestions as you type and always find what you're looking for.
* View your recent searches.
* Perform advanced searches, including "Starts with," "Ends with," "Contains," and "Wildcard."
* Listen to 27,000+ audio pronunciations for both American and British speakers.
* Share definitions via social networks, email, and text. (With supported devices)
User-friendly, comprehensive, and authoritative: Nursing Dictionary by Farlex is the perfect free nursing app for nurses, nursing students, and anyone curious about the medical field. This is NOT a preview or a trial version, and there is no "locked" content. Open the app on your iPhone or iPad and immediately access all content — no subscriptions required!
How do we do it?
TheFreeDictionary.com - Farlex apps have been downloaded tens of millions times across multiple platforms, with top ratings after hundreds of thousands of reviews. We work with the best publishers to bring together trusted content in the most comprehensive, authoritative dictionary apps on the market. Our flagship app is The Free Dictionary (TFD), powered by TheFreeDictionary.com. Find our other apps by searching "Dictionary by Farlex" in the App Store.

bluejetty:00115155:ios.description:
This thrilling Collectible Action MMORPG offers the duality of turn-based strategy & real-time action.
Experience exciting cross-platform play and embark on an epic quest where numerous stories are waiting to be discovered alongside your five member team. Unite your heroes!
The Story
Journey along with lead character Yusol as she strives to rebuild her clan and enact justice against those who destroyed it. Follow her as she pursues the evil Yi Chun and unravels the mysteries of the Heaven's Fall Cult. Throughout the adventure, she’ll encounter an expansive cast of heroes, each with their own skills and story, who will join her resurgent clan and unite in the fight to defeat Yi Chun and Heaven’s Fall.
Dual Combat System
Seamlessly switch between real-time action and turn-based strategy.
In turn-based mode, all five team members take the battle field to unite for victory.
For real-time action, one designated lead hero fights the various enemies supported by four skill-linked allies
Character Collection
Build & grow your 5-hero team to begin your journey. With over 40 heroes to unlock, each with their unique skills & stories, a variety of legendary characters awaits you to join your clan.
Visual Style
Immerse yourself in this anime-inspired world with majestic vistas, eerie forests, ancient deserts, and mythical dungeons of the Earthen Realm. Each hero models a distinctive look and feel evocative of the elements.
Deep Tactical Combat
To defeat your foes, master your fighting abilities with a wide array of combinations and skills. With each battle, tailor your team strategically in order to achieve victory across different opponents and environments.

bluejetty:00197367:android.name: World Flags: Guess the Country
bluejetty:00197367:android.summary:
This quiz game will help you to improve your knowledge about countries, their flags, emblems and capitals. And all this in one application!
The mechanics of the game are simple and interesting, it will be understood by both adults and child
bluejetty:00197367:android.description:
This quiz game will help you to improve your knowledge about countries, their flags, emblems and capitals. And all this in one application!
The mechanics of the game are simple and interesting, it will be understood by both adults and children. You need to look at the flag or coat of arms and write the correct name of the country or capital. Difficult to answer? Always there are hints to help you! Thus, this mobile quiz will help you not only to have a good time, but also to learn something new.
The application contains all 194 independent countries of the world from Europe, Asia, North America, South America, Australia and Africa. Each country has its own emblem and flag. Guess them all!
🏆 Game modes 🏆
In total, the game has 3 fascinating modes with 13 levels in each. These are almost 600 questions!
🗺️ «Guess the country by the flag». This is the mode in which you need to guess the country by the national flag and write its name.
🗺️ «Guess the country by the coat of arms». Countries have not only flags, but also coats of arms. It is no less interesting to study them. Try to understand which country has the emblem presented on the screen.
🗺️ «Guess the capital of the country by the flag». This is the more difficult game mode. Do you know countries and their flags well? And can you guess by the flag not just a country, but its capital? Challenge yourself and try to complete this mode!
🌍 Features of the geographical quiz 🌍
📍 3 game modes which will help you to learn the flags, emblems and capitals of countries.
📍 Almost 600 questions. Answer all of them and complete the game 100%!
📍 Go through the levels, answer questions and earn coins! You can spend them on hints.
📍 Turn on the game every day and get bonuses!
📍 Do you want to know more about the selected country or capital? In the game there is a special button that will open the page on Wikipedia. Easy and convenient!
📍 There are game statistics for each mode and for the whole game. Find out your strengths and weaknesses in knowledge. Train and learn new things right in the game.
📍 Need a better look at the image? Just click on it and the image will open in high resolution. This is especially useful and interesting when you guessing coats of arms of countries.
📍 The game is suitable for all ages: children, students and adults.
📍 Simple and intuitive application interface. There is nothing unnecessary here.
📍 Quiz does not need Internet access. Play wherever you want and when you want.
📍 The application has been translated into 15 languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Dutch, Czech, Polish, Romanian, Hungarian, Swedish, Finnish and Indonesian.

bluejetty:00172223:ios.description:
Test your driving skill in this realistic parking simulator taking place around a lifelike Shopping Mall environment! Learn to drive all of 12 awesome cars, varying in size, performance and handling!
FEATURES:
▶ REALISTIC SHOPPING MALL: Drive and park around an authentic looking environment
▶ 12 CARS TO CHOOSE FROM: Sports cars, sedans, delivery vans and more!
▶ 60 CHALLENGING MISSIONS: Show your driving skill, pass all challenges with flying colours!
▶ FUN, RESPONSIVE DRIVING MODEL: Driving never felt this good!
▶ REAL TRAFFIC: Avoid crashing with other cars on the road!
Shopping Mall Parking Lot offers an opportunity to drive multiple vehicles of all shapes and sizes around authentic looking, immersive environment! Select from a wide variety of cars, covering all popular types. From an awesome American muscle car, through a sports car, a truck, a delivery van to even a long bus.
Each mission is a different test of your driving skills, reflexes and coordination. Each track is full of obstacles and surprises. You will drive around a shopping mall and in an underground parking lot, exploring all of its nooks and crannies.
Driving the bigger vehicles is more challenging but also immensely rewarding. Get to know the area driving the more practical cars and you’ll be ready to complete all the challenges in the more demanding ones!
You will be rewarded for your performance in each mission. The faster you complete it, the more you will earn. You can then use your in-game fortune to unlock additional vehicles that unlock subsequent trials.
In addition to the normal game mode the game also features and additional unlockable gameplay variants for easier driving.

bluejetty:00084330:ios.name: FitBudd Client
bluejetty:00084330:ios.summary:
FitBudd is an online platform for fitness professionals to coach their clients with ease - be it online or in person.
With its intuitive interface and sleek UI, FitBudd gives coaches the power to provide an incredibly crisp and immaculate
bluejetty:00084330:ios.description:
FitBudd is an online platform for fitness professionals to coach their clients with ease - be it online or in person.
With its intuitive interface and sleek UI, FitBudd gives coaches the power to provide an incredibly crisp and immaculate experience to their clients, all in one place. The platform offers 100+ useful features for fitness professionals to help them achieve their fitness goals.
This app is meant for the clients working with coaches on the FitBudd platform.
Essential Features:
* Personalized Workout Plan: Get a fully personalized fitness plan tailored to your goals, whether it is to gain weight, lose weight, gain muscles, or simply wish to work on your general fitness.
* Nutrition, Hydration & Habits: Access meal plans assigned by your coach and log your food intake to keep a close track of your calorie intake and macros. You can also track your hydration, steps, and calories burnt on the app.
* Instant messaging & video calls - Message your coach in real-time and schedule video sessions directly from the app. Stay connected with your coach to improve compliance and get better results.
* Check-ins: Gain complete insight into your overall performance with easy check-ins and real-time updates.
* Progress: Stay on top of your progress with powerful analytics.
* Wearable integration: Get the bigger picture of your progress by connecting your fitness band & health kit thereby enabling real-time updates.
Note regarding Apple Health:
The app integrates with Apple Health to show your daily activity - distance, steps, active energy, and flights to help you better achieve your goals.
App also uses Apple Health to track energy burned and heart rate during a workout session, if an Apple Watch is used.
Workout metrics are shared with the coach to better design your workout schedule.
DISCLAIMER:
Users should seek a doctor’s advice before using this app and making any medical decisions.
App Access:
This app is the associate app for Fitbudd users. Ask your coach for your account information if you're a customer and want to use this app.

bluejetty:00114710:ios.name: TELUS Secure Business
bluejetty:00114710:ios.summary: TELUS Secure Business is your complete all-in-one security, safety and smart business solution. Protect, automate and control your business in real-time from anywhere in the world, from any current mobile device. All you need is Internet
bluejetty:00114710:ios.description:
TELUS Secure Business is your complete all-in-one security, safety and smart business solution. Protect, automate and control your business in real-time from anywhere in the world, from any current mobile device. All you need is Internet or mobile service, a Secure Business service plan and the smart devices you wish to install in your business.
The TELUS Secure Business app offers solutions for:
- Security and safety alerts
- Interactive video monitoring
- Remote awareness (knowing when your business has opened and closed)
- Business automation
Optimize your business from wherever you are. Just tap your app, and you'll have real time access to what's happening at your business. View your video screens or clips, change and control settings and make your business the safest and smartest it can be.
Whether you're at a customer meeting or halfway around the world, TELUS Secure Business has you covered. The app can send you notifications, you can instantly view your front door or back office, make and change rules to maximize energy efficiency, and have direct access to every security and smart device you've installed.
Simple icons and easy-to-follow screens give you remote access and control. Tap a button to view your cameras, pre-program your system to arm and disarm automatically, get reporting to provide you with graphs of volume and timing of traffic into your business.
Have an Apple watch? Keep your business running smart with a flick of the wrist. Arm and disarm your system, check notifications, and control all of your installed devices right from your watch.
Note: This TELUS Secure Business app requires a compatible system, internet access and a Secure Business service plan. The app features and their usage varies based on the solution chosen, equipment and service plan. Visit our website for more information.
With the TELUS Secure Business app, you can:
- Receive real-time emails, text messages, and push notifications for unexpected activity and events that matter to you
- View your business and property from your installed video cameras
- Pre-program or turn lights on or off
- Set the ideal temperature on your smart thermostat
- Receive reports of traffic volumes broken down by days and times
- Search your complete event history
- Provide, remove, or limit access to employees based on days and times
How the TELUS Secure Business app helps you stay connected to your business:
- Know instantly when your business has been opened or closed
- Arm and disarm your system from anywhere, or automatically as you leave the business
- Know when people access restricted areas
- Be alerted when certain doors are left open
- Know if someone changes any of your system settings
- Limit false alarms by remotely viewing your cameras, disarming, then re-arming your system without having to drive to your business.

bluejetty:00183705:ios.name: Pioneer Mobile App
bluejetty:00183705:ios.summary: The Pioneer Mobile App App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can
bluejetty:00183705:ios.description:
The Pioneer Mobile App App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Pioneer Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Pioneer Mobile App App, you must be enrolled as an Pioneer Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

listings.description:
永安旅遊 App 提供一站式旅遊預訂服務，涵蓋機票、酒店、套票、旅行團、郵輪及車船票等。無論預訂機票、酒店或當地玩樂，都可快速完成，並享最新優惠及會員專屬折扣，出發更輕鬆、更抵玩。

預訂旅遊產品
● 機票 Flights
覆蓋全球200+城市、80+ 航空公司(包括廉航)，預訂即時確認。支援App內自助退改及隨時查看航班資訊。
● 酒店 Hotels
全球超過100萬間酒店，輕鬆格價，提供住客評價參考、免費取消及精選優惠，住宿更靈活。
● 機票+酒店套票 Travel Package
自由配搭航班與酒店，一次預訂，價格更優惠。
● 旅行團 Tours
700+ 精選旅行團，涵蓋主題遊、親子遊、米芝蓮美食團及季節限定深度遊，行程持續更新。產品分不同鑽級，選擇豐富，價格透明。
● 郵輪 Cruises
搜羅全球郵輪產品，提供豪華及高性價比選擇，可預訂郵輪套票或郵輪團。
● 高鐵 / 火車票 Train
香港西九龍高鐵車票直達100多個內地車站，即訂即出票，免排隊更方便。
● 船票
提供香港往來澳門、珠海、深圳機場、中山、佛山等航線，即訂即用，憑QR Code直接入閘。
● 當地體驗
全球2000+旅遊體驗，包括景點及樂園門票、一日遊行程，豐富您的旅程。
● 當地參團
全新靈活行程，自訂機票後即可參團，毋須等成團，人數不限，輕鬆深度遊。2天以上行程已包酒店及交通，免服務費更抵玩。
● 訂制遊
按預算及喜好安排機票、酒店、租車、交通及餐廳，專人幫你plan行程，旅程更省心。
● 一站式預訂
自由行、旅行團、郵輪、船票、特色體驗、景點門票、美食餐券、交通接送及外遊數據卡，一個永安App全部搞掂。

● 即時確認及QR Code電子票，快速入場
● 實時搜尋及清晰價格顯示

● 多種付款方式：Apple Pay、AlipayHK、Visa、Mastercard、UnionPay、PayMe、BoC Pay、WeChat Pay HK、AMEX

bluejetty:00063809:ios.summary: Nonogram.com is an addictive logic game with a vast collection of picture cross puzzles. Due to their simple yet challenging gameplay, nonograms have become popular with people of all different ages. Join players all around the world, solve
bluejetty:00063809:ios.description:
Nonogram.com is an addictive logic game with a vast collection of picture cross puzzles. Due to their simple yet challenging gameplay, nonograms have become popular with people of all different ages. Join players all around the world, solve puzzles based on numerical clues and uncover the hidden picture!
Nonogram.com features thousands of puzzles with different levels of difficulty and in various categories, which are regularly updated to make sure the game never gets boring. Whether you just started playing nonograms or are already an experienced player, this game can definitely provide you with lots of fun and a pleasant pastime. Challenge your mind while solving nonogram puzzles and become a real Nonogram.com master!
Playing nonograms is also a good way to relax after a busy day and calm your mind. Escape from your daily routine and dive into a world of captivating puzzles! Enjoy the process of creating a picture from scratch based on numerical clues.
Let's start with the basic rules and logic behind picture cross puzzles:
• Color the squares and reveal the hidden picture.
• Use clues and numbers to solve the puzzles.
• Numbers above the columns are read from top to bottom.
• Numbers to the left of the rows are read from left to right.
• If you figure out that a square should not be shaded, mark it with an X.
• Get extra lives if you make a mistake.
Nonogram.com features:
• Plenty of nonogram puzzles with non-repeating images to color.
• Seasonal Events: complete time-limited events by solving nonograms of several difficulty levels. Reveal and collect all the unique postcards. Follow our updates to never miss a single event!
• Daily Challenges: solve puzzles every day and get a special monthly trophy!
• Tournaments: compete with other players and color as many nonogram pictures as you can. Choose a more difficult puzzle to practice your skills, earn more points, and win the top prize!
• Use hints if you get stuck while solving nonograms.
• Auto-crosses help you fill the grid on the lines where the squares are already correctly colored.
Nonograms are easy to learn and quite addictive once you start playing. Challenge yourself and enjoy hours of fun with Nonogram.com!

bluejetty:00147278:ios.description:
BeMe: Teen Mental Health 12+
Start Becoming Mentally Healthy™
TRY THE MENTAL HEALTH EXPERIENCE GEN Z NEEDED, BUT NOBODY EVER BUILT
Transform your life and become mentally healthy by tracking your moods every day. We’ll show you personalized content, insights, and patterns to help you manage stress, cope with intense feelings, make better decisions, set & achieve your goals, and be your best.
Sharing your feelings can lead to better decision-making, problem-solving, and resilience. It reduces stress, boosts confidence, and contributes to a healthier, happier life.
YOUR MOODS, SAFELY SHARED ONLY WITH THE PEOPLE YOU TRUST
-Boost your emotional intelligence and strengthen your relationships by sharing your Mood Ball with your Mood Crew on BeMe. Build a supportive community to manage your well-being safely.
-A little bit of support goes a long way. Support your Mood Crew by responding to their Mood Ball check-ins with emoji reactions, calls, or texts.
YOUR PERSONALIZED WELLNESS HOME
-BeMe provides personalized supportive media that's tailored to your needs, helping you feel better in every moment. Just update your Mood Ball and reason, and we take it from there.
- Your life can be tough at times. Whether you're dealing with a breakup, feeling overwhelmed by school, frustrated with your parents, self-conscious about your body, or struggling with social anxiety, the BeMe app is here to help.
LIVE COACHING - BECAUSE EVERYBODY NEEDS HELP WITH THE ANSWERS
-You can access free and live coaching through the BeMe app.
-BeMe coaches offer 1:1 text-based support to guide you through challenges, teach you skills, help you set goals, and direct you to the resources and content that help you thrive.
-There’s no judgment here. Whatever’s on your mind – school stress, relationship drama, social troubles, low self-esteem, setting and achieving your goals, motivation, life advice, adulting, really anything – BeMe Coaches can guide you through it.
THE RIGHT CONTENT AND CARE ACTIVITIES FOR HOW YOU ARE FEELING
-Your life can get crazy, and your brain deserves a break! Practice mindfulness with guided breathing, distract your mind with puzzles, discover more about yourself through simple quizzes, and destress by doodling on our sketchpad – all clinically informed activities in the BeMe app to reduce stress and boost your mood.
-BeMe has tens of thousands of pieces of clinically validated and curated content to help you tackle hard problems or just make you feel better.
-Browse and discover content that matches your interests and needs, and save and share what you need for yourself or the people in your life.
SAFETY KIT
-Build a network of emergency support with our BeMe Safety Kit
-Feel prepared for life’s tougher moments by building a Safety Plan
-Learn about available and free crisis or therapy resources
Your data security is critical and we securely store and manage all data. Please be sure to read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
- https://beme.com/privacy-policy
-https://beme.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00083531:ios.summary: IronVest is your all-in-one, security and privacy wallet that goes beyond any existing solutions to protect access to your accounts, secure your credit cards, and protect your privacy online with masked email addresses, single-use virtual c
bluejetty:00083531:ios.description:
IronVest is your all-in-one, security and privacy wallet that goes beyond any existing solutions to protect access to your accounts, secure your credit cards, and protect your privacy online with masked email addresses, single-use virtual cards, and masked mobile numbers. Create, protect, and autofill passwords with face biometrics right from your browser. 
How IronVest is different 
IronVest takes passwords and account logins to another level of security. With easy to use, face biometrics right from your browser, we ensure only you can access your most sensitive accounts like your bank account, email, investments, health records, and more. 
Next-gen password manager. 
A next-gen password manager that protects all your account login information
- Truly seamless creation of strong, encrypted passwords on any site or service across all of your devices
- Autofill your user name and password to login to your accounts on web browsers, iPhone, iPad devices 
- Protect your passwords with our patented biometric protection for account logins and account resets 
- 2FA code protection! 2FA codes sent to your mobile are vulnerable. IronVest is the only solution that only you can access your 2FA codes and autofills them for you. 
The ultimate in Privacy Protection 
Protecting your digital identity goes hand in hand with protecting your online security by keeping your personal information out of the hands of fraudsters and hackers. So we created a comprehensive set of privacy features that includes: 
- Masked (private) email addresses - Keep your private email private. Get access to your masked email inbox or have them forwarded to your real email. 
- Masked mobile number - Don’t give away your personal mobile number anymore. 
- Virtual credit cards - Create 1-time use virtual cards on the fly with one-click
- Site tracker. Know which companies are tracking you and block them with ease. 
How we protect your data 
IronVest is built on a decentralized infrastructure, which means there is no single source of data to steal. 
- Zero-knowledge infrastructure - we can’t access your passwords
- Passwords and key data are secured with AES-256 encryption
- Separate keys are used for authentication/authorization and data encryption
- Encryption keys are stored using host-proof hosting
- Encrypted data is stored using optional personal storage accounts
- Key JavaScript functions run in protected contexts, not in the page
Secure, private and convenient online shopping and payments 
Even the most reputable sites and brands you trust get hacked. Keep your credit cards safe from data breaches 
- Pay on any site without giving away your credit card info by using virtual credit cards
- What you buy is your business. Keep what you buy private with virtual cards
- Prefer using your real credit card? Protect it on our decentralized network and autofill when you need it. 
- Autofill info by just looking at the browser camera. We take care of the biometric authentication. 
Autofill your personal info on any site with identity management profiles
- The safest and most convenient way to autofill your info on travel, shopping, utilities or any online site. 
- Create multiple profiles with real info, masked info or any combination
- Autofill for fast and easy online form filling and checkout experiences
- Have your masked emails and masked phone forwarded to you if you wish
SUPPORT
We have a full-time support team that can help at support@ironvest.com as well as live chat for premium users.
If you loved the Abine Blur digital wallet and passwords manager, you will love IronVest even more. 
IronVest - the most secure and user-friendly way to protect access to your accounts, login seamlessly, shop privately, and protect your digital identity. 
Secure your accounts. Protect your privacy. 
Privacy Policy: https://ironvest.com/legal/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://ironvest.com/legal/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00073274:ios.description:
Looking to stay up to date with valuable and truthful content? Join the ZINIO Unlimited world.
The app for those who love reading. ZINIO Unlimited is an all you can read model that will provide full access to 5,000+ magazines for only $9.99 a month. Ready to get started? Try it now and enjoy the first month for FREE! No commitment, you can cancel it at any time, during the free trial, or during the paid subscription. 
Entering the world of unlimited content means discovering publications in more than 15 languages and being able to access a variety of titles covering every interest you can imagine. Sports, fashion, food, culture, cars, technology and many more will make you feel THE POWER OF READING.
How can ZINIO Unlimited be your best ally in your daily life?
> If you want to impress your guests with tasty recipes: Delicious, Gourmet Traveller and Better Homes & Gardens will always be at your fingertips with the latest culinary novelties.
> If you want to keep up with the latest updates and technological innovations: T3, Macworld and Stereophile will be your guide. 
> If you like to keep up to date with what is going on in the world of fashion trends: Elle, Marie Claire, Glamour and Grazia will help you to keep your style always fresh and ultra-modern.
> If you want to maintain a healthy lifestyle – body and mind - and you need some help with your diet, fitness plan, or mental health: Mindfulness, Health & Fitness, Being Vegan and Best Health will be the perfect option to learn and achieve your goals.
> If you are an adventure lover and want to know the world: Australian Photography, Condé Nast Traveller and Lonely Planet will help you to prepare your trips in the best possible way or, if not, to keep dreaming about them.
And you know what the best part is? You will be able to do everything in a simple and fast way. With just one click. Select your favorite magazines, search for articles – read them right away or save for later - and create your desired library. Furthermore, you can choose the reading experience that best suits you - PDF or text version - and synchronize it across all your devices. 
Sounds good, doesn't it? Download the app now and always be informed. Read trustworthy stories, online and offline. Anytime, anywhere.
Are you still not convinced? We have more benefits for you:
• You will be the first to know what is happening around the world.
• You will help the planet by reading the digital version.
• You will receive your content immediately, no unnecessary waiting time.
• You will see that reading has never been so easy and comfortable.
We want you to have the best experience using ZINIO Unlimited. That is why you will not need to keep track of renewing your subscription. We will extend your ZINIO Unlimited service automatically every month unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period from your account settings. Please note you will be charged after the free month trial ends.
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://www.zinio.com/www/legal/terms.jsp#terms

Harney & Son
bluejetty:00065599:ios.description:
Enjoy quick, convenient access to over 300 varieties of the world’s finest teas with the Harney & Sons app! Shop from your mobile device and enjoy free shipping on every order of your favorite teas, created by master blenders.
Harney & Sons was founded in 1983 by John Harney and today is recognized as a leading, world-class tea sourcer and blender. Our app allows you to easily order popular teas like Hot Cinnamon Spice, Earl Grey Supreme, Paris, English Breakfast, Matcha, Chai, oolong, green teas, wellness teas, decaf and herbal teas and hundreds more! Whether you enjoy hot teas or cold teas, or if you prefer to use loose tea, sachets or teabags, we’ve got you covered!
Harney & Sons app user benefits include:
Instant access to world-class teas anytime, anywhere
Convenient shopping and ordering
Free shipping on orders $59+
Exclusive deals and benefits 
We know every customer has their favorite types of teas, which is why we offer not only traditional teas packaged in our famous tins but also carry a line of iced teas and bottled teas. Looking for a little extra fun? Try our bubble tea! Looking to keep the calories at bay? The vast majority of our teas do not have any added sugars, making them naturally calorie- and sugar-free. We also offer teas that are kosher, as well as several that are certified fair trade.
You’ll also have access to tea wares including teapots, teacup sets, kettles, informal tea mugs, fine china and more. Enjoy our selection of shortbreads, cookies, scone mixes, jams and everything you need to create the perfect morning or afternoon tea.
When you join our rewards program, your purchases allow you to earn points you can redeem toward more tea and wares! Looking for that special gift but just can’t choose? That’s why we carry gift cards to make gift-giving that much easier.
At Harney, we believe that you should only drink teas that make you smile, so that’s the only kind we make! We also believe that any time is tea time – with this app, you can turn any time into tea shopping and ordering time!

bluejetty:00088063:ios.summary: Akiflow is an AI daily planner and calendar built around time blocking. Collect every task in one to-do list, then schedule it on your calendar to block time for it. Tasks and meetings sit side by side, so your daily plan stays realistic.
bluejetty:00088063:ios.description:
Akiflow is an AI daily planner and calendar built around time blocking. Collect every task in one to-do list, then schedule it on your calendar to block time for it. Tasks and meetings sit side by side, so your daily plan stays realistic.
Available on all your devices – iPhone, Apple Watch, web, and desktop. Stay in sync anywhere.
Key Features:
- Powerful Daily Planner & Organizer: Schedule your day effortlessly with an integrated calendar and task manager. Manage your agenda, meetings, and priorities in one place.
- To-Do List & Task Management: Create, organize, and track your tasks. Set deadlines, reminders, and priorities to stay productive.
- Unified Calendar & Schedule: Sync seamlessly with Google Calendar, Outlook, and more. See all your tasks and events in a single daily agenda.
- All-in-One Productivity Solution: Unify to-do lists, scheduling, and calendar planning with AI-powered insights to optimize your workflow.
- Connect 3,000+ Tools & Apps: Import tasks automatically from Trello, Slack, Gmail, and other productivity tools. No more switching between apps.
- Smart Reminders & Alerts: Get notified about upcoming tasks, meetings, and deadlines—so you never miss a thing.
- Sync Across All Your Devices: Use Akiflow on iPhone, Apple Watch, web and desktop with real-time syncing. Your schedule follows you everywhere.
Akiflow on Apple Watch:
Your tasks and schedule, right on your wrist. The Apple Watch app works together with Akiflow on your iPhone.
- Quick Capture: Tap + and dictate or type a task. It lands in your Inbox, ready to plan later.
- Your Lists at a Glance: Inbox, Today, Week, Month, and All Tasks, organized just like on your iPhone.
- Check Off Tasks as You Go: Complete or undo a task right from the list.
- Complications: See what's happening now or next (a task, event, or time slot) with a live countdown on your watch face.
- Keeps Working Away from Your iPhone: Browse your lists and capture tasks when your iPhone is out of reach. Everything syncs as soon as you reconnect.
Requires the Akiflow iPhone app and watchOS 10 or later.
Why Akiflow?
- AI-Powered Task Management – Smart organization for your day-to-day planning.
- All-in-One Planner – Manage tasks, calendar, and to-do lists in one app.
- Ultimate Productivity – Designed for efficiency, focus, and stress-free scheduling.
- Seamless Integrations – Connect your favorite apps and manage everything from one dashboard.
Terms of service: https://akiflow.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00061554:ios.summary:
Create, edit, save and share your files with the best office app of iOS, used by 100 million users all over the world.
Experience New All-in-One Complete Office Suite compatible with Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Adobe PDF "Best App" awarded
bluejetty:00061554:ios.description:
Create, edit, save and share your files with the best office app of iOS, used by 100 million users all over the world.
Experience New All-in-One Complete Office Suite compatible with Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Adobe PDF "Best App" awarded by iTunes App Store.
[ Features ]
• Edit and save documents in various file formats
Under 100 MB size. Just one application enough for all different type of documents.
- Open, edit, save and share all kinds of office documents such as Word, Excel, Power Point, and Google Docs with one iOS app.
- View PDFs right from your iPhone and iPad. Convert PDF into Office documents and edit them.
• Convenient usability
Quick and Easy Access for Anytime, Anywhere and Any device.
- Across all devices like Desktop, iPhone and iPad, Keep your all documents always up-to-date in sync via Polaris Drive, iCloud and other cloud service.
- Edit file easily with Split View.
- Powerful search function will save your time to expand your search terms not just filename.
- Save frequent template in My Template folder. You can make your own template anytime.
- Without extracting zip files on iPhone and iPad, you can easily open and read all type of documents.
• Share documents quickly, easily
Share documents easily and invite others quickly to edit or view documents.
- Just simply sharing the link of documents with our cloud storage via SMS, email, Facebook and other channels.
• Other support available
- Supported File Formats : DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, PPS, PPSX, TXT, HWP, HWPX, ODT and PDF.
(NEW) Now we support CSV format.
- Free Available for 33 templates, 20 various 2D/3D charts, 37 slide transition effects, 173 different shapes and 300 formulas for spreadsheet.
- Supporting 18 global languages including English, French, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, German, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese (Europe, Brazil), etc.
- Polaris Drive is a default cloud but also available other cloud service such as iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, WebDAV, FTP for 24 hours, 365 days.
- Polaris Office has earned ISO 27001 certification for International Cloud Privacy Standard.
[Payment plan and auto-subscription]
• Polaris Office is free all-in-one office suite but some features can be limited by your cloud usage or your subscription option. 
• Smart Plan : $3.99/month & $39.99/year
• Pro Plan : $5.99/month & $59.99/year
• AI Plan ($12.99/month & $129.99/year) 
• AI-Plus Plan ($20.99/month & $209.99/year)
• Remove Ads : $10.99
• Recurring payment and plan subscriptions are charged to Apple Store account. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Subscriptions can be managed at App Store account setting. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to user’s Account Settings.
[Note]
• Support : [Application] -[Settings] - [Customer Support] or [Official Site] – [Support]
• Customer Support : support@polarisoffice.com
• Terms of Service : https://www.polarisoffice.com/en/terms
• Privacy Policy : https://www.polarisoffice.com/en/privacy
* How to change sharing option
Settings > Privacy > Allow additional permissions
Select category > Revoke access to Polaris Office

bluejetty:00127655:ios.description:
Investment Calculator helps you estimate how your investments may grow over a selected period. Enter a starting amount, rate of return, investment length, and recurring contributions to calculate projected balance, total contributions, and interest.

bluejetty:00085917:ios.description:
1. 서비스
- 민원신청은 행정기관 방문 없이 언제, 어디서나 인터넷을 통해 필요한 민원을 안내받고 열람·신청·발급하는 서비스입니다.
- 민원인은 5,000여종 민원사무에 대해 처리기관, 구비서류, 수수료, 처리기한, 관련법제도 등의 정보를 안내받을 수 있으며, 이중 자주 이용되는 민원서비스에 대해 모바일 서비스가 제공됩니다. 또한 대한민국 중앙행정기관, 공공기관, 지방자치단체가 제공하는 서비스를 12개로 분류하여, 개인의 생활에 필요한 맞춤형 서비스를 다양한 방법으로 제공합니다. 
- 매일 업데이트되고 있으며, 총 9만여 건의 서비스를 분야별 및 맞춤형으로 제공하고 있습니다.
2. 보조금24
- 보조금24는 여러 행정기관의 웹사이트나 창구를 방문할 필요없이 정부에서 제공하는 각종 수혜서비스(현금·현물 등)를 개인맞춤형으로 안내하는 서비스입니다. 
- 일부 서비스는 바로 신청이 가능하며, 바로 신청 가능 서비스는 계속 추가될 예정입니다. 
3. 정책정보
- 정책정보는 중앙행정기관, 지방자치단체, 공공기관 등 정부기관들의 주요 소식 및 정책정보, 운영 시스템 등을 제공하는 서비스입니다. 
 - 이번 개편으로 정부의 정책자료를 한 곳에서 확인할 수 있습니다. 소식·보도자료 위주의 자료를 정책뉴스, 연구보고서, 간행물로 구분하여 제공합니다.
 - 이용 편의성 제고를 위해 콘텐츠를 18개로 분류하였으며 정책정보 검색 기능으로 쉽고 편리하게 자료를 찾을 수 있습니다. 
 - 또한 중앙행정기관과 지방자치단체의 조직도, 기관 소개, 예산 등의 기본 정보를 제공하고, 중앙행정기관에서 하고 있는 업무 및 부서 연락처 등도 함께 제공하고 있습니다.
※ 접근 권한 안내
[선택 접근 권한]
- 마이크 : 음성 검색 기능을 위해 사용
- 위치 : 돌봄시설 위치 서비스 안내를 위해 사용
- 카메라 : 전자증명, 문서확인 등 QR코드 스캔 및 바코드 스캔을 위해 사용
- FaceID : 생체인식 로그인을 위해 사용
- 알림 : 서비스 이용 시 알림 수신을 위해 사용 
* 선택 접근 권한은 동의하지 않아도 앱을 사용하실 수 있습니다.
* 선택 접근 권한 미동의시 서비스 일부 기능의 정상적인 실행이 어려울 수 있습니다.
* 휴대폰 설정 > 정부24 > 권한 메뉴에서 권한 설정 및 해지 하실 수 있습니다.

bluejetty:00040295:ios.description:
Screw Blast - Solve the mystery of 3D objects and have fun decorating!
In this fun product, you will play as a screw master and challenge your mind and hand speed to correctly classify different colors of screws into boxes. Unlock beautiful decorations and decorate your pet's room with your harvest to create a welcoming home.
Faced with a series of 3D objects, each of which is inlaid with multi-colored screws, these screws are carefully removed and placed in the corresponding box according to their color. Each time you complete a special level, you will receive a reward that will unlock various decorations, such as carpets, tables or murals, to decorate your pet's room.
Features:
-Colorful 3D objects, each level is full of challenges and fun
-Simple and intuitive operation interface, easy to use, suitable for all ages
-A variety of screw and object color combinations to test your powers of observation and reaction speed
-The unlocked decorations are rich and varied to make your pet room more and more beautiful
-Special level design, bring unexpected surprises and challenges
-Achievement system and leaderboard, compete with friends, share the fun of the level
Don't hesitate to download now to start your screw sorting journey, enjoy the fun of decorating, and help create a cozy pet home. Unlock all the special levels, challenge your limits, and become the real Screw King!

Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.Users can self-manage subscriptions or turn off auto-sub at iTunes Account settings. All unused periods of free trial shall be forfeited upon purchasement of subscription.

bluejetty:00175486:ios.description:
YOU NEED THE HITSTER CARD GAME TO USE THIS APP.
Create an instant party with HITSTER, the music card game of the century!
Listen to over 100 years of amazing hits, take turns arranging them in chronological order on your music timeline and create your trip down memory lane. The first player to collect 10 hits is the winner.
With more than 300 of the greatest hits from the last 100 years, HITSTER is the perfect game for an evening with lots of laughing, singing, dancing and sharing memories. Simply open the box, scan a song card with this HITSTER app and let the music do the rest to create an instant party. So what are you waiting for? Invite your friends to have fun together and see who is crowned the HITSTER.
Game characteristics:
- Everybody is invited for the HITSTER party! Super easy rules and no game set-up gets the party started in no-time. Simply scan a card with the free Hitster app and the music starts playing automatically in Spotify, isn't that cool?
- HITSTER is the music game in which you don’t have to be a music expert. Simply guess if a song was released before or after other songs in your music timeline. The futher you are in building your timeline the more challenging it becomes. Your chances of winning increases if you can also name the artists and song titles.
- Are you craving to show of your music knowledge? Play HITSTER with the Pro rules or even Expert rules in which you have to know the exact year, artist and song title.
- Fancy a less competitive trip down memory lane? Then HITSTER can also be played as one team or by yourself.
GET THE PARTY STARTED!
HITSTER requires a mobile phone with an internet connection. For the best experience, use the free HITSTER app and Spotify. Visit www.hitstergame.com for device compatibility.
For the latest Hitster news, updates, and competitions, follow us on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook @hitsterparty.

bluejetty:00033512:ios.description:
Our app is a powerful tool designed to help students learn new concepts, prepare for exams, and master subjects like mathematics, chemistry, and physics. Unlike traditional tutoring services, it doesn't just provide answers; it guides students through each problem with detailed, step-by-step explanations and solutions, empowering them to understand and solve similar problems independently.
Here's how our app enhances your learning experience:
Comprehensive Homework Help: Whether you're tackling algebraic equations or balancing chemical reactions, our app offers the support you need to solve even the toughest problems. It's designed to help you manage the most complex tasks with confidence.
Easy Organization: Students can save completed assignments and questions in the app's file directory, making it easy to review their work, share with classmates, or print for future reference.
Cooperative Learning: Need additional assistance? Our app promotes group learning by allowing users to work on math problems collaboratively with friends, classmates, and others, fostering a cooperative learning environment.

bluejetty:00019428:ios.summary:
Welcome to Classic Solitaire, the ultimate card game that never goes out of style! Experience the nostalgia and addictive charm of this timeless classic right on your mobile device.
With its simple and familiar gameplay, Classic Solitaire
bluejetty:00019428:ios.description:
Welcome to Classic Solitaire, the ultimate card game that never goes out of style! Experience the nostalgia and addictive charm of this timeless classic right on your mobile device.
With its simple and familiar gameplay, Classic Solitaire offers endless hours of entertainment for both beginners and seasoned players alike. Dive into the world of solitaire and challenge yourself to clear the deck by strategically arranging the cards in ascending order. Can you conquer all four suits and emerge victorious?
One of the highlights of Classic Solitaire is its offline mode, allowing you to play anytime and anywhere, even when you're in airplane mode. Whether you're travelling, on the go, or simply want to enjoy a moment of solitude, this game will always be by your side.
Get ready to be captivated by the stunning winning animations that accompany each successful move. Celebrate your victories in style as the cards dance and cascade across the screen, creating a satisfying visual spectacle.
Classic Solitaire boasts a sleek and user-friendly interface, making it easy to navigate and play. Enjoy smooth and intuitive controls as you arrange the cards with precision and skill. Immerse yourself in the timeless design and vibrant graphics that add an extra layer of enjoyment to the game.
Don't miss out on the addictive and rewarding experience of Classic Solitaire. Download now and challenge yourself to become the ultimate solitaire champion. Unleash your inner card shark and embark on a journey of strategic thinking and pure entertainment!

- Easy to play.
- Free brain test.
- No WiFi required
- Suitable for all ages.
-Simple and addictive!

- No time limits.
- Brick can be rotated.
- Drag the tetris bricks to move them.

Block Puzzle Classic is a classic simple game but are full of challenges, it has logic skills and placement strategies, whether it is the very first or later move, each step determines whether you can get high scores.
Download this addictive puzzle game, train your brain and test your IQ!

bluejetty:00173922:ios.description:
SketchPro, a professional art app available for iPads and iPhones, crafted with love by the Drawing Desk Team
SketchPro is perfect for creative professional digital artists, including graphic designers, illustrators, comic, anime & manga book artists with a range of Drawing & painting tools to upgrade their creative workflow
SketchPro now supports iPhone Duo, bringing your creative workflow to Apple’s foldable iPhone experience
SketchPro tools and features:
Powerful Custom Brushes
-A range of free specialized brush sets for sketching, painting, doodling, drawing and more.
-Customisable brushes with adjustable radius, opacity, texture and more
-Create brush sets
-Maintain a list of your favorite brushes
-Free Roller Brush with 100+ patterns
Animation Assist
-Powerful interface and essential tools for creating impressive animations (Only for iPads).
-Wide range of tools, including onion-skinning, instant playback, a visual timeline, and more.
Essentials to accelerate the Creative Process
-Smart Shapes feature for instant shape drawing
-Free Symmetry Tool for easier drawing
-Powerful Gradient tool with Linear and Radial options
-Layer Transform Tool with Freeform, Uniform, Distort and Warp options
-Magic Eraser
-Assisted Drawing
-Synchronization between iPad and iPhone
Advanced Layer System
-Free unlimited layers
-Rasterize, Duplicate and Merge layers
-Fill, Color Invert, Lock Alpha and Lock Layer options
Advance Text Tool
-Select from a full list of fonts or import your own
-Customize fonts
-Apply solid and gradient colors to text
-A range colored font patterns, textures and designs
Complete Color Palette
-Full Color Wheel with adjustable color values and shades
-Create unique themed color palettes for your drawing
-Import colors from photos and images
Extensive Shapes Library
-15+ categories of free shapes, signs, and symbols
-Favorites section for keeping track of frequently used shapes
Other Essential Tools
-Smudge Tool
-Fill Bucket with solid colors
-Filter options including Gaussian Blur, Motion Blur, Perspective Blur and more.
-Convenient Cutter Tool
-Import and Export functions
-Custom Canvas option
-AR Facepaint
Organize and Save Your Work
-Save every drawing automatically
-Rename each saved artwork
-Create folders for storing drawings methodically
-Cloud syncing to secure and access artworks anywhere
-Duplicate and Delete projects at any time
-Time Lapse Playback
-Dark Mode
Designed for iPhone Duo
-Enjoy a larger, more immersive canvas on iPhone Duo’s foldable display.
-Seamlessly continue creating across the outer and inner displays.
-Experience an adaptive workspace that adjusts to different orientations and folding positions.
Unlimited access to all premium features & daily content updates during the subscription period
Premium subscriptions with 1 week trial
-Annual for 39.99/year
You may cancel a subscription or free-trial anytime via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SketchPro Unlimited subscription.

bluejetty:00016899:ios.summary:
ORF ON ist die Streamingplattform Österreichs: Wann immer Ihnen danach ist, können Sie eine Fülle von Filmen, Serien, Comedy und Dokus, die gesamte aktuelle Berichterstattung des ORF und bewegende Events aus Sport und Kultur sehen.
Genießen
bluejetty:00016899:ios.description:
ORF ON ist die Streamingplattform Österreichs: Wann immer Ihnen danach ist, können Sie eine Fülle von Filmen, Serien, Comedy und Dokus, die gesamte aktuelle Berichterstattung des ORF und bewegende Events aus Sport und Kultur sehen.
Genießen Sie alle Livestreaming- und On-demand-Angebote des ORF auf Ihrem großen Bildschirm.
Videos für jeden Geschmack
In ORF ON stellt der ORF tausende Videos für Sie bereit. Gustieren Sie in den Empfehlungen der Redaktion auf der Startseite, stöbern Sie im Sendungen A-Z oder rufen Sie das Angebot nach Kategorien auf, um Angebote nach Ihrem Geschmack zu finden.
Immer live dabei
Das Livestreamingangebot von ORF Live, das in der App inkludiert ist, streamt die vier ORF-TV-Channels fast durchgehend. Sollten Sie den Anfang oder gar die ganze Sendung verpasst haben, können Sie den Livestream in ORF Live bis zu 24 Stunden später anschauen und so das Livefeeling nachholen.
Qualitätsfernsehen für die Kleinen
Exklusiv digital läuft der Livestream „ORF Kids“ in ORF ON, der hochqualitatives, spannendes Programm für Kinder aller Altersstufen bietet. Und das 24/7. Im eigenen Kids-Bereich können die Kinder unter hunderten altersgerechten On-demand-Videos spielerisch Lieblingssendungen und neue Interessensgebiete entdecken. Das ist sicher!
Features für ein besonderes Streamingvergnügen
Abgesehen davon, dass Sie in ORF ON bequem Verpasstes nachholen oder TV-Highlights erneut genießen können, bietet das Streamingangebot des ORF viele Features, die das Streamen zu einem besonderen Erlebnis machen.

bluejetty:00088529:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00088529:ios.description:
Howdy! You like poker and turn based strategy games. You love spaghetti westerns and the wild wild west. You’ll love POKER SHOWDOWN! Play the game for free!
This game combines 5 card poker rules with turn based tactics rpg in a western setting to create a new game that involves building strong poker hands, cowboys with special abilities, collecting bounties, upgrading your card deck...
Download POKER SHOWDOWN now and try the game for free!
◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆
How to play:
► Place bets using bullets.
► Build strong poker hands to build up power.
► Shoot and defeat the bandits before they take you down.
► Collect bounties and upgrade your strength for the next battle.
Up to the challenge? Load your revolvers, draw your cards and begin your adventure.
◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆
What you’ll love:
► POKER with a twist
We simplified the rules of poker. Learn the basic strategies for building the best poker hands.
► WESTERN setting
The game is inspired by classic spaghetti westerns and the american wild west. Meet iconic gunslingers. Face a diverse cast of outlaws. Participate in intense shootouts and mexican standoffs.
► FREE to play
Download the game and play it for free. The game is supported by optional in-game purchases and ads.
► OFFLINE play
Play anywhere, while commuting or when waiting in line. No internet connection is required to play the game.
► RPG progression
Choose your bounty hunter, chase and take down the outlaws, collect rewards, improve your strength and face stronger enemies until you reach the final boss.
► SPECIAL cards
Collect cards with unique abilities. Upgrade them to make them more powerful. Create your own deck of cards.
► MULTIPLAYER battle
Challenge your friends and other players in asynchronous multiplayer battles. Compete with them on the leaderboard.
► DAILY rewards
Play the game every day to earn a free reward. The more you comeback, the bigger the reward. On top of that, you’ll get a free spin at the slot machine!
◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆
Any questions or comments? We’d love to hear from you.
Contact us at: pokershowdown@tinkertroupe.com
Want to learn more about the game? Please visit:
https://www.pokershowdowngame.com
Follow us on social media:
Facebook: https://fb.me/pokershowdowngame
Twitter: https://twitter.com/PokerShowdownGG
Big thanks to all of you, gunslingers and high rollers, who are showing interest in our game.
Play POKER SHOWDOWN for free and try your luck against the most dangerous bandits in the wild frontier.
See you soon in the game!

bluejetty:00175682:ios.description:
Discover the power of visual search with the innovative Finder - Reverse Image Search app for iOS. This app allows you to dive deep into the digital world by utilising the power of the leading search engines - Google Image Search (Google Lens), Yandex, TinEye and Bing Image Search.
FEATURES:
- All search engines in one app.
- Directly search for photos from your device's camera, photo library, clipboard and files.
- Search images by URL.
- Use words to search for photos.
- Previous image searches. 
- Using a web browser to save photos to your devices.
- Rotating and cropping images.
In-app purchases:
You can become a premium user by auto-renewing your subscription.
- Payment will be deducted from your iTunes account when you confirm your purchase.
- Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the expiry date.
- Subscription length: one week, one month, one year.
- If you renew your subscription within 24 hours before the end of the current period, your account will be charged the amount corresponding to the renewal price.
- Subscription cost: one week - $2.99, one month - $5.99, one year - $9.99.
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and auto-renewal can be disabled by going to User Account Settings after purchase.
- Cancellation of the current subscription during the active subscription period is not allowed
This application uses Google, Bing, Yandex in the web browser application. However, the app is not supported or associated with any of these search engines.
Privacy policy: https://webrain.ltd/uv/privacy-policy.html
Terms of service: https://webrain.ltd/uv/terms-conditions.html

bluejetty:00062968:ios.description:
Natal Chart, Signs & Palmistry is a #1 professional astrology and Tarot cards reading app that understands and tells who you are and how you are connected to others.
Knowing your zodiac sign is not enough anymore. The app uses advanced mathematical algorithms and up-to-date astronomical data to create your personalized birth report. It combines the ancient wisdom of astrology, numerology, and palm reading to give you 100% actionable advice on how to improve all spheres of your life!
Backed by leading professional astrologers, the app calculates the exact positions of the stars based on the time and place you were born. Going further, the app provides you with powerful insights on your personality features, life path challenges, and suggestions on how to improve your life in the most efficient way. You can also consult the Tarot and Palmistry sections to get a better understanding of your true self.
 What you get:
• Personality analysis customized to your entire chart
• Detailed compatibility reports for you and your partner
• Actionable horoscope for a day, week, or month
• Lunar calendar to track moon phases
• Tarot cards to gain insight into the past, present, and future
• Palm readings with a detailed analysis of your palm prints
• Real-time updates as the planets move
Typical horoscopes are written only for a person’s sun sign. But that’s only one part of your astrological chart. It doesn’t take into account the moon, other planets in the solar system, or the 12 houses of the zodiac—each of which represents a different part of your life, like relationships, work, and home.
The app uses your time and place of birth to create a map of the sky. Our advanced algorithms then track the movements of the planets in real time, providing you with hyper-personalized horoscopes and insights into your life's journey like never before.
With Natal Chart, Signs & Palmistry, you'll gain a deeper understanding of yourself and those around you, unlocking new possibilities and embracing your mindful life. So why wait? Download the app now and discover the ancient wisdom of astrology!

bluejetty:00124054:ios.summary:

Race to the finish line over a multitu
bluejetty:00124054:ios.description:
MMX Hill Dash 2 is a FREE all terrain, off-road monster truck racing game with 100s of race challenges – get behind the wheel and buckle up for the most addictive & FUN physics based PVP driving game!
Race to the finish line over a multitude of racing tracks with hazards, hill climbs, jumps, loops, bridges and ramps. Go turbo with awesome truck upgrades and try to climb to the top of the leaderboard in this crazy MMX racing game that will test your driving skills to the limit!
MMX Hill Dash 2 has the biggest trucks and the roughest all terrain tracks like Tropical, Canyon, and Arctic for you to prove yourself as the ultimate hot wheeled driver. With ultra-realistic physics, fun crash scenarios and challenging off-road gameplay, you won’t be able to stop playing MMX Hill Dash 2.
Get both hands on the wheel and your big foot on the gas, download MMX Hill Dash 2 today and start racing.
Features:
 • Complete challenging off-road racing trials
 • Upgrade your trucks, go big on tires, boost your speed and get more grip
 • Strap in for some fast PVP action, take on your friends in 4WD race offs
 • Climb to the top and be the best MMX driver ever
 • Crank up the action with custom upgrades, tracks and hard courses
 • Loads of awesome monster trucks to race
Become a legendary driver, take to the road driving hugely powerful vehicles and race hard or go home. Compete on challenging interesting off-road tracks with many different obstacles. Punch that throttle, speed straight ahead and win white knuckle ride PVP races on racing tracks that take real driving skills to finish. Jump over ramps, fly over a variety of obstacles and take the chequered flag.
Create a monster truck to crush your opponents and improve them with different boosted systems. Upgrade your truck and improve Speed, Grip, Stability and Air Tilt! Transform your truck into a unique vehicle for some furiously fast fun.
Get airborne with spectacular jumps and loops that test you as a driver. Control your gas pedal to tilt forward or hit the brakes to tilt backwards, it’s up to you to nail your start before launching your truck over huge jumps. Time your throttle action to perfection to stop things getting seriously out-of-control.
Defeat all your rivals and become a champion driver! Climb the leaderboard by burning some serious rubber in a choice of epic, boosted vehicles: The Micro, The Monster, The Tank, The Buggy, The Quad Bike, The Amphibian, The Supercar and the Snow Mobile
MMX Hill Dash 2 is the explosive follow up to the massively successful MMX Hill Dash - Off Road Racing, it’s high octane, adrenaline fuelled, PVP driving action from start to finish. Can’t drive 55? Good, put your pedal to the metal, download MMX Hill Dash 2 for FREE
PLEASE NOTE! Hill Dash 2 is free to download and play, however, some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. Hill Dash 2 includes loot boxes that drop the available items in randomised order in line with the odds shown in the Help & Support article entitled "What are the odds of winning?", and can be purchased using in-game currency (Gems), these can be won, earned through gameplay, or purchased from the store.

bluejetty:00150001:ios.description:
FivePointFive: Breathwork for Athletes
What is FivePointFive
The world’s first breathwork app built for athletes—used by Elite Athletes and a fast-growing community of Everyday Athletes. We turn cutting-edge breathing science into short, coached sessions that strengthen performance and recovery, improve focus and stress resilience, and deepen restorative sleep.
Built on science. Made measurable.
Peer-reviewed research links structured breathwork with higher VO₂-max, improved HRV, lower resting heart rate, and better sleep quality. FivePointFive translates that science into sessions you can see working:
- Live heart-rate in class to watch your autonomic nervous shift in real time
- AI Performance Coach with post-session insights and coach tips
- Trends over time across HR, HRV, resting HR, and sleep
Train the full system: Mind • Body • Sleep
- Mind: Downshift stress fast, sharpen focus, and rebalance the nervous system—in as little as 90 seconds.
- Body: Build breathing mechanics and CO₂ tolerance to increase endurance, boost stamina, and speed recovery.
- Sleep: Lower nighttime cortisol and deepen restorative sleep so you wake recovered and ready to go.
Backed by the best
- Patrick McKeown -#1 functional breathwork expert globally and best-selling author, scientist and founder of ‘Oxygen Advantage’.
- Jay T. Wiles - Global authority in HRV biofeedback, applied psychophysiology, and performance psychology. Founder of Thrive Wellness & Performance, working with elite athletes across the NFL, NBA, MLB, PGA, ATP, and MLS.
- Marco Altini - World leader in HRV, Human Movement and High performance coaching. Founder of HRV4Training & Data Science Advisor to Oura. Editor of the Wearable Department of IEEE Pervasive Computing Magazine.
Privacy
Your health data stays with you. We read/write to Apple Health with your permission and never sell personal data.
Subscriptions
Quarterly and Yearly plans with a free trial. Auto-renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage in your Apple Account Settings.
FivePointFive® — Breathwork for Athletes
Not medical advice. Individual results vary.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00125881:ios.description:
The official iPhone version of the card game Wizard.
Meet the card game that's challenging, habit-forming and loads of fun! It's Wizard: a unique game with a 60 card deck!
The rules are simple and easy to learn... mastering the strategy is the real challenge. One card is dealt to each player on the first round, two cards on the second, and so on. Players bid the number of tricks they think they will win. Make the exact number of tricks bid and you win points; too many or too few and you lose points. The Wizard and Jester cards add a "wild card" element to the strategy.
Play against the sophisticated built-in AI players, or choose a network game of up to 4 friends playing over the internet.
Wizard® is a registered trademark of Wizard Cards International , Inc.
© K. Fisher Enterprises, Ltd.

bluejetty:00066202:ios.summary:
WHO PAYS? WHO GOES FIRST? LET THE FINGER DECIDE.

bluejetty:00066202:ios.description:
WHO PAYS? WHO GOES FIRST? LET THE FINGER DECIDE.
Someone has to pay the bill, go first, or do the dishes. Nobody wants to choose, and nobody wants the blame.
Let the app choose. Everyone puts a finger on the screen, and a few seconds later it picks one person. Everyone sees it happen, so nobody can argue.
No sign-up. No setup. Just fingers.
HOW TO PLAY
1. Everyone puts one finger on the screen.
2. Keep your fingers there. A short countdown starts.
3. A light moves from finger to finger, slows down, and stops.
4. That finger wins the crown. Done!
Again? Tap Play Again, or everyone puts a finger back down.
USE IT TO DECIDE
• Who pays the bill
• Who goes first in a game
• Who does the dishes or takes out the trash
• Who gets the front seat, the last slice, or the remote
• Who picks the movie or the restaurant
• Any tie-break, any time
TWO WAYS TO PLAY
PICK — The app picks a winner in a few seconds. Need more than one? Choose up to 4 winners. You always need one more finger than winners, so 2 winners need at least 3 fingers.
ELIMINATE — Fingers are eliminated one at a time. The last finger left wins. It takes longer, so the suspense builds.
WHY NOBODY CAN ARGUE
• Every finger gets its own color.
• Before it picks, the app shows how many players it counted. Nobody is left out by mistake.
• Once the light starts moving, no new fingers can join.
• The light slows down like a roulette wheel, so everyone sees where it stops.
• The winner stays on screen, even after everyone lifts their fingers. No more "wait, who won?"
• If a finger gets lost, or there are too many fingers, the app tells you.
GOOD TO KNOW
• If someone adds or lifts a finger during the countdown, it starts over.
• An iPhone can follow up to 5 fingers at once. Bigger group? Use an iPad: it follows up to 11.
• To change the mode or the number of winners, the screen must be empty: lift all fingers, and after a round, tap Play Again.
• The app remembers your mode and number of winners.
• Silent Mode turns the sound off, and there is a mute button. Your music keeps playing.
• On iPhone, you also feel a buzz with each tick, so it works in a loud room.
• Ask Siri: "Start Pick Finger Game".
PRIVATE
No internet needed. No ads. No account. No in-app purchases. Nothing about you leaves your device.
ACCESSIBILITY
VoiceOver announces who won: the winner's color and roughly where they are on the screen. Reduce Motion is supported. The screen stays on while you play.
Fair. Random. Instant. Let the finger decide.

bluejetty:00178638:ios.description:
Help your child build strong early math skills through joyful play!
This fun-packed app includes fully-voiced activities that teach counting, numbers, addition, subtraction, shapes, and more—designed especially for toddlers and preschoolers.
Kids will laugh and learn as they:
• Sing songs and burst balloons
• Play hide and seek in magical places
• Cook cakes and go shopping
• Feed silly monsters and hungry bunnies
• Grow carrots, draw numbers, solve puzzles, race cars—and so much more!

• Counting 1–10, 1–20, and up to 100
• Understanding quantity and number order (cardinality)
