bluejetty:00039885:ios.description:
Tribe is your Destination for Sport. We wanted to design something that represented sport how PEOPLE think, not organisations. This is our attempt at that. We still consider things to be in its infancy, and we're constantly looking to add new content, features, and ways to make following sport better.
Ultimately we'll cover everything, but here are some of the key things we cover right now:
RUBGY:
+ International Rugby
+ Men's Rugby World Cup, Women's Rugby World Cup, Men's U20 World Cup
+ Nations Championship, The Rugby Championship, Tri Nations, Bledisloe Cup, Six Nations, Lions Tours
+ Super Rugby, Super Rugby Pacific, Super Rugby Aupiki
+ Bunnings NPC / Mitre 10 Cup, Farah Palmer Cup, Currie Cup
+ Premiership Rugby, United Rugby Championship, Top 14, Pro D2
+ Major League Rugby (MLR)
+ Japan Rugby League One
+ SVNS / HSBC Sevens World Series (Men's & Women's)
+ Sevens World Cup (Men & Women)
+ Olympic 7s (Men & Women)
+ NZ Club Rugby
+ NZ 1st XV High School Rugby
RUGBY LEAGUE:
+ International League
+ Rugby League World Cup (RLWC)
+ Super League, RFL Championship, RFL League 1, Challenge Cup
+ NRL, NRLW
+ State of Origin
FOOTBALL (SOCCER):
+ FIFA World Cup, World Cup Qualifying
+ UEFA European Championships (Euros)
+ Copa America, Asian Cup, African Cup of Nations
+ UEFA Nations League, CONCACAF Nations League
+ U20 World Cup, U17 World Cup, Women's World Cup
+ English Premier League, English Championship, FA Cup, Carabao Cup
+ La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1
+ UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League
+ Australian A-League, FFA Cup
+ MLS, US Open Cup, Mexican Liga MX
+ Olympic Football (Men & Women)
+ NZ National League, Chatham Cup, Kate Sheppard Cup
+ NZ Club Football
CRICKET:
+ Cricket World Cup (Men & Women)
+ T20 World Cup (Men & Women)
+ World Test Championship
+ International Cricket (Tests, ODIs, T20s, The Ashes)
+ Australian Big Bash (BBL), Women's Big Bash (WBBL)
+ New Zealand Super Smash, Ford Trophy
+ Indian Premier League (IPL)
+ Caribbean Premier League (CPL)
+ Pakistan Super League (PSL)
+ Major League Cricket (MLC)
BASKETBALL:
+ NBA
+ Australian NBL
+ New Zealand NBL
+ Tauihi Basketball Aotearoa
NETBALL:
+ Netball World Cup
+ International Netball (Netball Nations Cup, Quad Series, Constellation Cup, Nations Cup, Taini Jamison Trophy)
+ Suncorp Super Netball
+ ANZ Premiership
+ Netball Superleague
(AMERICAN) FOOTBALL:
+ NFL
(AUSSIE RULES) FOOTBALL:
+ AFL
+ AFL Women's
+ VFL
And so much more...
We provide full play-by-play text commentary for a lot of different sports, leagues and competitions... and live scoring for a whole lot more.
If we don't yet cover your favourite sport, team, league, event or sportsperson, we likely will soon.
If your favourite is missing, do let us know. You can do so directly within the app or via support@tribesportsapp.com.
We hope you enjoy using Tribe as much as we've enjoyed making it for you.
Payments, Subscriptions, and Refunds:
Tribe has ad-free subscriptions. While we make every effort to ensure the continued operation of Tribe, we cannot make any guarantee regarding future access to the App.
Payment will be charged via the iTunes App Store upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the original cost. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings on their phones after purchase.
For more information see our ToS: http://cdn.tribesportsapp.com/static/Tribe_Terms_and_Conditions.pdf
For more information on Privacy: http://cdn.tribesportsapp.com/static/TribePrivacyPolicySupportInfo.pdf

bluejetty:00141206:ios.summary:
INTVL: The World Is the Game.
INTVL turns every walk, run or bike ride into a game played on the real world globe. The idea is simple. When you run or ride in a loop, the ground inside that loop becomes your territory. The bigger, smarter
bluejetty:00141206:ios.description:
INTVL: The World Is the Game.
INTVL turns every walk, run or bike ride into a game played on the real world globe. The idea is simple. When you run or ride in a loop, the ground inside that loop becomes your territory. The bigger, smarter and more tactical your routes, the more of the map you hold.
Claim your territory
Every loop you complete claims real space. Other players are out there doing the same thing, so the map is always moving. You can take a new route to take new ground, or go back over an area to defend what's already yours.
Play it your way
Some people want to be the best in the world, so they chase the global leaderboard. Others care more about home turf and work to become the territory leader of their own suburb or city. Both are worth playing for, and you can switch focus whenever you want.
Hold ground, win real prizes
Every bit of the map you hold earns you entries into our competitions, where the prizes are real. The more territory you hold at the end of the competition, the better your odds.
Run and ride with clubs
Join a club and play as a team. Your territory adds to your club's total, so a good capture from you helps everyone you're playing alongside.
A feed built around the game
INTVL has a social feed where you can follow other players, see their activities, and cheer them on. It's a good way to find people around you and stay connected to other athletes around the world.
Bring your own gear
INTVL works with the devices you already train on, so your activities sync straight into the game:
- Garmin
- Suunto
- Polar
- Coros
- Fitbit
- Hammerhead
- Wahoo
We built INTVL to give a new meaning to fitness. Movement without stakes is just exercise. The world is the game. Take it.
This app integrates with Apple Health (HealthKit) to show insights about your activity, including steps, heart rate, and previous runs.
Privacy Policy: https://www.intvl.com.au/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00015040:ios.description:
Big Ear makes music learning accessible, enjoyable and sustainable for all! 
Learn music, make music and be social!
Learning music was never so easy and fun!
New! Enjoy a magical piano on screen keyboard!
Special options: coloured keys, scale locked and special effects.
Get familiar with the piano keyboard in a fun way!
Recognition: 
Big Ear is the official music learning app of Lang Lang International Music Foundation.
Join Solo, the wannabe musician, to demystify the mystery of how music works. 
Build songs and learn how music works.
Explore melody, chords & rhythm.
Piano, Guitar, Synth, Bass and Drums onboard. 
* Powered by Native Instruments.
FOR WHOM?
- music fans and learners
- piano, guitar, ukulele, bass, drum players and vocalists
- music teachers
- music schools
HOW DOES IT WORK?
1) Build a catchy song in music puzzles.
2) Play the song in an interactive performance mode.
3) Remix (edit) the song in the composer tool (sequencer). 
4) Optional: Save to My Songs and Publish to the community.
Or in reverse:
1) Compose your original song in the composer tool.
2) Play the song in an interactive performance mode.
3) Yes, the game will create automatically puzzles set to build the song!!!
4) Publish your songs, get likes and challenge others building them.
FEATURES:
- Music puzzles with on-screen piano keyboard
- Smart composer (Sequencer) with coloured notes and scales highlight.
- Community Songs library.
- Automatic puzzles generator (for your saved songs).
GAME CHARACTERS (musicians):
- Sticky - Drums
- Bossy - Bass
- Finga - Piano, Keys
- Kitaro - Guitar
- Okto - Marimba... and....
- Solo - Wannabe
PLAY AND LEARN:
- Rhythms
- Bass lines
- Melodies
- Harmonies (chords)
- Songs
SONG GENRES: 
- Pop
- Rock
- Classical
- Universal
- Electronica
COMPOSER TOOL (SEQUENCER):
- Easy and creative sequencer.
- Tap note blocks in.
- Drag note blocks around the sequencer grid.
-Zoon in and out for easier editing.
- Controls: note length (1/4, 1/8, 1/16), tempo, play/pause/stop and loop.

bluejetty:00129375:ios.description:
Discover Flockr, the comprehensive pet care app designed to prioritize your furry friend's well-being. Our app unites pet lovers and enhances their quality of life, catering to all pet types, from dogs and cats to rabbits, birds, and more!
In Flockr, you'll find a user-friendly platform encompassing your pet's entire journey. Manage essential aspects like medication reminders, vaccinations, deworming, flea and tick control, and more. Plus, access valuable insights through our informative blog, ensuring you're always prepared to provide the best care.
Key Features:
Pet Health Records: 
Maintain an all-encompassing record of your pet's health, including weight, illnesses, allergies, grooming, and vet appointments.
Artificial Intelligence:
It allows you to interact with their pets in a conversation, asking about their medical records and life in general.
With all the provided information in the app, we create an impersonation of your pet, to be your assistant, helping to care for the pet's health.
Feeding Assistance: 
Keep track of your pet's food consumption and receive timely notifications.
Simplified Scheduling: 
Add one-time entries for activities like weekly baths, annual vaccinations, or daily medicines, and receive perpetual reminders to ensure you never miss a beat.
Stay Active:
Encourage pet walks with a feature that lets you share your adventures with friends.
Routine Management: 
Streamline your pet's daily schedule, including meals, walks, and personalized routines.
Budget Management:
Effortlessly oversee your pet-related expenses and gain insight into your monthly costs.
Sharing Made Easy:
Need to book an appointment or leave your pet with a sitter? Generate a comprehensive PDF file to share your pet's information with ease.
Join a Pet Parent Community:
Connect with thousands of pet owners, sharing their daily experiences and pet photos, complete with fun filters, on our dedicated social network.
For the Perfect Shot:
Capture stunning photos with a custom camera equipped with pet-friendly sounds and photo enhancement tools.
Follow us on Instagram:
http://instagram.com/flockrapp
Site:
https://flockr.social

Pocket Pitch is the singer's pocket toolkit — a reliable pitch pipe, piano, tuner, and metronome in one simple app. Whether you're a choir member finding your starting note, a soloist checking
bluejetty:00179825:ios.description:
Play or identify any musical note, instantly.
Pocket Pitch is the singer's pocket toolkit — a reliable pitch pipe, piano, tuner, and metronome in one simple app. Whether you're a choir member finding your starting note, a soloist checking your pitch, or a music student learning to read a staff, Pocket Pitch gives you the essentials at your fingertips.
THE TOOLKIT
* Pitch Pipe — professionally recorded reference notes, just like the physical pitch pipe you'd keep in your pocket
* Piano — six octaves for warming up, checking intervals, or plunking out a melody
* Tuner — identify any note you hear, and see whether it's flat or sharp
* Metronome — keep time during practice or rehearsal
PREMIUM FEATURES
While the toolkit is always ready to play or identify notes — the premium features keep your voice and ear ready for performances and practice. Build your voice with guided vocal warmups using staff notation. Train your ear and musical knowledge with practice tests at multiple difficulty levels, covering accidentals, key signatures, harmonies, and sight singing.
Used by singers in choirs, a cappella groups, barbershop quartets, musical theatre casts, and voice students around the world. 800,000+ downloads. Rated 4.6 stars.
Pocket Pitch lives on your phone so you're always ready — for the rehearsal, the audition, the performance, or the practice session at home.

bluejetty:00064580:ios.description:
MobileBanking - mobile services offered by Bank Austria
With Bank Austria’s MobileBanking app, Internetbanking you can now settle your banking business via smartphone whenever you want and wherever you are. Highest security standards and the option of biometric authentication protect your privacy for your daily banking.
Mobile and smart - basic functions at a glance:
• Financial overview: The quick overview of your finances 
• Financial Manager: Get a detailed breakdown and presentation of your income and expenditure.
• Account information and account statements: Request your account information simply and clearly. 
• Bank transfers: Sign domestic and foreign bank transfers, personal transfers, tax office payments and standing orders
• Trading: Buy and sell securities
• Order archive: Find completed orders in the order archive and convert them into a PDF at any time.
• Limits: Manage limits and settings of your debit cards as well as the online card blocking.
• Apple Pay - Pay with your card on your iPhone
Practical and helpful - additional benefits:
• Biometric Login: Log in securely with Face ID/Touch ID
• Photo transfer: Transfer bills simply by taking a photo of your bills - easy and without typing. 
• Personal authorization code: Release orders in the app easily and securely with a personal authorization code or Face ID/Touch ID.
• Personalization: Personalize your app with a profile picture and your own product favorites.
• QR Codes: Scan, create and share QR codes for payment orders.
• ATM locator: Quickly find an ATM in your area.
Notes: 
For the use of the MobileBanking App a Bank Austria Internetbanking access is required. 
You do not have a Bank Austria account yet? Download the app and open your account including 24You Internetbanking directly on your smartphone.
Service & Information:
If you need help while installing or using the app please contact us via our ServiceLine +43 50505-26100 or online.banking@unicreditgroup.at

bluejetty:00017722:ios.description:
It has never been easier to access your commercial accounts on the go.
SECURE ACCESS ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
After downloading the CitiBusiness App from a U.S.-based app store, you can access the app from wherever you may be*. The integrated Mobile Token feature allows you to generate codes on the go for login and transaction approvals on CitiBusiness Online.
EASILY MANAGE YOUR ACCOUNTS
• *NEW* Deposit checks*
• Monitor your balances and recent activity
• Initiate payments and transfers between accounts
• Approve wire transactions
• Provide decisions on your Positive Pay items
You must be specifically entitled for Mobile Token feature access by your business’s System Administrator. 
This application will communicate with Citi’s server automatically in order to relay your consent and to record usage metrics. By consenting to the installation of this application, you are also providing your consent to the future installation of any updates or upgrades to CitiBusiness Mobile that may be required for this application to perform the functions outlined above. 
Citi will not charge you to use and download this application. Please note that standard messaging and data rates from your wireless provider may apply.
* Mobile Remote Check Deposit is available today on a limited basis, and you must be physically located in the U.S. in order to use this feature (including Puerto Rico).

• Remotely start, lock, and unlock your vehicle.
• Check fuel level, tire pressure, oil life, and more.

• Schedule service, find your dealership, and more.

- Play instantly on mobile, tablet, and computer

- Learn to code and turn your ideas into playable games
- Publish your creations and share them with 8M+ players
SAFE, FRIENDLY, AND FUN
- Active moderation and content filtering
- A welcoming community built around creativity and play
- Daily updates and new features inspired by player feedback

bluejetty:00119249:ios.name: BizXpert - Easy invoicing
bluejetty:00119249:ios.summary:
Running a business is already hard enough. Invoicing should not take your time, energy, or focus away from what actually makes you money.
BizXpert is built for freelancers, small business owners, contractors, and self‑employed professional
bluejetty:00119249:ios.description:
Running a business is already hard enough. Invoicing should not take your time, energy, or focus away from what actually makes you money.
BizXpert is built for freelancers, small business owners, contractors, and self‑employed professionals who want invoicing to feel simple, fast, and almost invisible.
Instead of fighting spreadsheets or bloated accounting software, BizXpert gives you exactly what you need to invoice professionally, get paid faster, and stay organized — without unnecessary admin work.
MAJOR UPDATE IN 2025 — SIMPLER THAN EVER
In 2025, BizXpert received a major update focused on one goal: making invoicing even easier.
What’s new:
• A modern, cleaner design that’s easy to understand at first glance 
• Faster workflows with fewer clicks 
• Clearer navigation and smoother performance 
• Built to feel intuitive, even if you’ve never used invoicing software before 
If invoicing has ever felt confusing or frustrating, this update changes that completely.
EFFORTLESS INVOICING — LESS ADMIN, MORE TIME
BizXpert is designed so invoicing takes minutes, not hours.
You can:
• Create and send invoices in under a minute 
• Quickly select existing customers and items 
• Add new customers or items instantly without leaving the invoice 
• Edit quantities, prices, taxes, or notes directly inside the invoice 
• Save invoices for later or send them immediately 
No long setup. No learning curve. No unnecessary steps.
PROFESSIONAL INVOICES THAT MATCH YOUR BRAND
With BizXpert you can:
• Choose from 22 clean, professional invoice templates 
• Upload your logo so every invoice matches your brand 
• Customize invoice language, captions, and layout 
• Decide exactly what appears on the invoice 
• Send invoices without forced BizXpert branding 
GET PAID FASTER & STAY IN CONTROL
BizXpert helps you keep track of your money at all times.
You’ll always know:
• Which invoices are paid 
• Which are unpaid 
• Which are overdue 
No more guessing. No more chasing payments blindly.
SMART TAX & DISCOUNT FEATURES (WITHOUT THE CONFUSION)
• Create unlimited taxes and tax groups 
• Apply different taxes to different items 
• See tax totals and taxable subtotals clearly 
• Add discounts as flat amounts or percentages 
• Set custom discounts for specific clients 
Everything is clear, visible, and easy to manage.
STAY ORGANIZED AS YOUR BUSINESS GROWS
• Manage unlimited customers and products 
• Organize customers and items into categories 
• Quickly search through large lists 
• Copy invoices for recurring work 
• Keep your invoice history accessible anytime 
WORK ANYWHERE, ON ANY DEVICE
• Available on iPhone, iPad, and desktop 
• Secure cloud storage 
• Automatic syncing between devices 
• Your data remains accessible even if you stop subscribing 
Invoice from your desk, on the go, or at a client meeting.
REAL HUMAN SUPPORT
• Fast human support 
• Friendly and responsive 
• No endless bots or unanswered tickets 
You’re never left alone with your invoicing.
BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO VALUE SIMPLICITY
BizXpert is ideal for:
• Freelancers 
• Small business owners 
• Consultants and contractors 
• Entrepreneurs and self‑employed professionals 
Ready to get started? Download the app and start issuing professional invoices immediately with your 14-day free trial.
Need help?
If you have suggestions or problems, please email us at info@bizxpert.com before leaving a negative review; we are here to help you with any problem you may have. Happy Invoicing!

bluejetty:00019535:android:1.summary:
Welcome to Boom Beach: come with a plan or leave in defeat!
Fight the evil Blackguard with brains and brawn in this epic strategy game. Engage in intense war and combat enemy bases to free enslaved islanders and unlock the secrets of this
bluejetty:00019535:android:1.description:
Welcome to Boom Beach: come with a plan or leave in defeat!
Fight the evil Blackguard with brains and brawn in this epic strategy game. Engage in intense war and combat enemy bases to free enslaved islanders and unlock the secrets of this tropical paradise. Create a Task Force with players around the world to take on the enemy together in fierce multiplayer combat. Scout, plan, then BOOM THE BEACH in this action-packed RTS warzone!
Experience the thrill of war and shooting as you engage in RTS combat. Strengthen your army and build a powerful kingdom to dominate the warzone. Utilize strategy and war skills to conquer enemy bases and emerge victorious in this multiplayer RTS war game.
Strengthen your defenses and expand your kingdom as you explore the vast archipelago. Only the bravest will lead their kingdom to ultimate supremacy in Boom Beach's thrilling RTS warzone. With the support of multiplayer alliances and strategies, your kingdom will rise to greatness. Multiplayer strategies and teamwork are key to dominating the warzone and achieving ultimate victory.
Boom Beach is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Multiplayer Mode
Battle and Raid: Play with millions of other players in multiplayer mode, raid hundreds of enemy bases for loot. Engage in epic combat and strategic war to dominate the warzone.
War Battles
Control Precious Resources: Battle for control of precious resources in epic war battles to upgrade your base against enemy attacks in this RTS warzone. Use your strategic skills to strengthen your defenses and army, ensuring victory in every encounter.
Explore the Archipelago
Discover Life Crystals: Explore a huge tropical archipelago and discover the mysterious power of the Life Crystals. These crystals can turn the tide of combat, providing unique advantages in war and strategy.
Combat Blackguard Bosses
Uncover Evil Plans: Face fearsome Blackguard Bosses in intense RTS war and uncover their evil plans. These epic encounters require both brains and brawn, and only the strongest army and best RTS strategies will prevail.
Form a Task Force
Multiplayer Co-op Missions: Join other players to form an unstoppable Task Force for multiplayer co-op missions. Collaborate in RTS war, combining your strategic and war skills to defeat the enemy and control the warzone. Use multiplayer tactics to maximize your success.
Build Your Army
Strategy and Strength: Utilize strategy to build a powerful army and strengthen your kingdom against enemy attacks. Your army's strength and your RTS combat tactics will determine your success in this multiplayer war game.
Experience RTS Combat
Shooting and Strategy: Experience the thrill of shooting and RTS combat as you engage in fierce encounters. From strategic planning to executing war maneuvers, every aspect of war is covered in this RTS warzone.
Join Boom Beach now and become a master of strategy in this epic RTS war game. Build your army, engage in fierce combat, and lead your kingdom to victory in the ultimate warzone. Experience the excitement of multiplayer warfare and the thrill of shooting as you fight for supremacy. Download Boom Beach today and embark on an unforgettable war adventure!
Note: A network connection is required to play
Parent's guide: http://www.supercell.net/parents
Privacy Policy: http://www.supercell.net/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: http://www.supercell.net/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00018415:ios.name: TompkinsBank
bluejetty:00018415:ios.summary: The TompkinsBank is a free mobile banking app that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and
bluejetty:00018415:ios.description:
The TompkinsBank is a free mobile banking app that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, & Images: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Tompkins Community Bank’s Customer Care Center directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Tompkins Digital Banking for desktop. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the TompkinsBank App, you must be enrolled as a Tompkins Bank & Trust Digital Banking user. If you currently are a Digital Banking user, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00088901:ios.name: Wellness Coach - MyHealth
bluejetty:00088901:ios.summary: We know that your biggest source of motivation is visualising your progress. That's why MyHealth makes it easy for you to set your goals, track your measurements effectively and share your data with your friends or doctor. MyHealth from Ter
bluejetty:00088901:ios.description:
We know that your biggest source of motivation is visualising your progress. That's why MyHealth makes it easy for you to set your goals, track your measurements effectively and share your data with your friends or doctor. MyHealth from Terraillon brings together all your health data in one comprehensive ecosystem within one mobile app: weight, nutrition, physical activity, sleep, blood pressure and body temperature..
*MONITOR YOUR WEIGHT AND BODY COMPOSITION*
Sync MyHealth with your Terraillon connected bathroom scale to achieve your weight, muscular mass and body fat goals... 
MyHealth calculates your BMI (body mass index) to identify your excess weight and the potential risks of excess weight to your health. The app then recommends a weight according to your profile based on normal standards. Your results are clearly displayed on your dashboard with colour-coding so that you can analyse them easily. You can also find details of your body composition (weight, BMI, body fat, muscular mass, bone mass or body water mass) in simplified graphs. 
*MANAGE YOUR DIET*
MyHealth helps you adopt a healthy diet with comprehensive and accurate nutritional information (calories, proteins, carbohydrates, fats, fibre, sodium). With the Open Food Facts database, you can scan the barcode of the products you have purchased in-store and add them directly to your dashboard. The app decrypts labels from over 500,000 foods and displays the Nutri-Score as well. Based on your metabolism, MyHealth helps you set your nutritional intake target according to your body's day-to-day needs. You can also improve the experience by using the Terraillon NutriTab nutritional scale with MyHealth. That way, the nutritional information will be automatically adjusted according to the weight being weighed. 
*INCREASE YOUR PHYSICAL ACTIVITY*
Set your daily step goals and… walk! By combining MyHealth with the Terraillon activity wristband, you automatically record the number of steps taken, the number of calories burned and the distance covered on your mobile app!
*IMPROVE YOUR SLEEP*
Use a Terraillon activity wristband to analyse the quality of your nights, your sleep duration, and to set an alarm to wake up. All this information is automatically transmitted to MyHealth.
*MONITOR YOUR BLOOD PRESSURE*
Monitor your blood pressure accurately with MyHealth and connected blood pressure monitors from Terraillon. For long-term monitoring, you can find all your blood pressure and heart rate data on your dashboard. The app displays a colour-coded report for easy interpretation of your blood pressure from the European Society of Hypertension (2018). If in doubt, always consult your doctor or a healthcare professional.
*About TERRAILLON *
The everyday wellness partner 
Terraillon has been taking care of you and your loved ones for over a century with its renowned scales and a range of medical devices that now connect to the MyHealth smartphone app. Now everyone can monitor and improve their health day by day with a healthy and active lifestyle. Developed by our teams of designers, engineers, doctors and healthcare professionals, navigation of the new MyHealth app is more intuitive, the design is more modern, and data readings are even more accurate.

bluejetty:00152233:ios.description:
Field Trips is a flexible way to travel around Springfield. We’re an on-demand shared
ride service that’s easy, affordable, and convenient.
With a few taps, book a ride in the app, and our technology will pair you with other
people headed your way.
HOW IT WORKS:
- When you're ready to go, book a ride in the app by providing your pick-up and drop-off
locations, anywhere in our service area.
- Let us know whether you’re riding alone or with additional passengers.
- You will receive an estimated vehicle-arrival time upon booking your trip and be picked
up where you requested. The driver’s estimated arrival time will automatically update as
your vehicle makes its way to meet you.
- Be ready for your driver outside at the pick-up location.
- When your driver arrives, pay your fare and board the vehicle. Pay on board with exact
cash, or save your credit or debit payment method in the mobile app.
-There may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way.
Track your ride and share your status within the app in real-time.
AFFORDABLE:
The prices are comparable to other transportation services in the area. Your wallet will
thank you.
RELIABLE:
Track your ride as the driver is on their way to you, and while you’re in the vehicle too.
The app will provide real-time information for your pick-up and arrival time.
ACCESSIBLE:
Field Trips is wheelchair accessible! If you require a wheelchair, please call us to
ensure your account is set up correctly. When you request a trip, you will be assigned a
wheelchair accessible vehicle.
SHARING YOUR TRIP:
Our service matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting
the convenience of an on-demand ride with the efficiency and affordability of public
transit.
Questions or comments? Reach out to support-fieldtrips@ridewithvia.com.
Your feedback is important to us. Ride Field Trips and let us know how we did!

24/7 support from our dedicated team, ready to answer any questions or help with any issues to improve your VPN experience.

You
bluejetty:00177896:ios.description:
Bibi.Pet Dinosaurs will take you back in time to discover the prehistoric world.
Together with the T-Rex, the Triceratops and all the others, you will be able to have fun with lots of educational activities designed for pre-schoolers.
You will be able to draw on the rocks, put together dinosaur puzzles, play memory games, develop logical reasoning and fine motor skills with pairing activities.
And as always, Bibi.Pet will accompany you as you discover all the educational activities available.
Suitable for ages 2 to 5 and designed together with experts from the educational field.
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
Features:
- Complete the puzzles
- Have fun coloring
- Educational matching activities 
- Use Logic
- Play Memory Games
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colors and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

bluejetty:00068513:ios.description:
The Spectrum HOA Homeowner and Board App is a mobile-friendly way to interface with your community association. You will be able to make payments, view your account, and access community information all in one place. 
If you already have a login to your association website, you can login to the App using the same email address and password you use for your association website. If you do not have a current login to your association site, simply click the register button and submit your information. Once your registration is approved, you will receive an email with a link to set your password and then you will be able to log into your account directly from this app. 
If you already have a login and do not remember your password, click the Forgot Password link, enter your email address to request a password reset and you will receive an email with a link to set your password. Once set, you can login with your email address and new password. 
Once logged in, Homeowners will have direct access to the following features:
a. Easily switch between accounts if multiple properties are owned
b. Homeowner Dashboard
c. Access association documents
d. Access association directories
e. Access association photos
f. Access Contact Us Page
g. Pay Assessments
h. Access violations – add comments and take pictures from mobile device to add to violation
i. Submit ACC Requests and include pictures and attachments (pictures can be taken from mobile device) 
j. Access homeowner ledger
k. Submit work orders and check on status of their work orders (add comments and take pictures from mobile device)
In addition, Board Members will be able to take advantage of the following features:
a. Board Tasks
b. ACC Review
c. Board documents
d. Violations Review
e. Invoice Approval
f. Work Order Review

Signeasy is the easiest way to sign and send documents for signature from your iPhones, iPads, and Macbooks. All signatures on Signeasy are legally binding and backed by a digital audit trail.
With a 4.9-star App Store rating and 100 million contracts processed, Signeasy is the preferred eSignature app for individuals and businesses. Featured in Apple commercials across the globe, we are loved by over 48,000 businesses, 10 million users, and major press outlets alike: 
“Signeasy is a great tool for those always on the go.” - Forbes
“If you deal with paperwork often, you’ll love this.” - The Next Web
“Perfect for anyone who has a lot of paperwork to sign” - Inc.
Signeasy is free to download and sign up for a 7-days trial. 
● Works everywhere you work
Signeasy works across all your devices — iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and with any document format (PDF, Word, Excel, JPG, PNG, and more).
● Truly global, it speaks your language
Signeasy is used in 180 countries and supports 24 languages, including English, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese, Japanese, Italian, German, French, Finnish, Dutch, and Chinese. 
● Integrates with your favorite cloud storage apps 
Import and save signed documents to your favorite cloud storage apps in Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, OneDrive, and more. 
● Stay on top of your tasks with Signeasy widgets
Get quick access to your Summary, Templates, and Pending document workflows.
● Sign via Shareable links and QR codes
Collect signatures in bulk with a public signing link. Generate and share QR codes for contactless signing. 
**Signeasy supports all your eSignature needs**
● Sign documents
Draw, scan, or import your signature. Upload documents and fill in signatures, initials, date, email, images, or any type of text like address, phone numbers, etc.
● Send documents for signature
Add and assign fields to make it easy for your clients to fill and sign. Fields supported - Signature, Initials, Name, Date, Email, Text, Checkboxes.
● Collect in-person signatures
Sign documents and collect others’ signatures in person on your iPhone or iPad to execute contracts faster.
Security and Compliance
Your data and information are secured with industry-standard SSL encryption. Signeasy is compliant with ESIGN, UETA, eIDAS, HIPAA, and SOC2. All documents are legally binding with a detailed digital audit trail, including the signer’s email address, device IP, and completion time.
Additional features
- Save and share frequently used documents as Templates
- Offline editing and signature capabilities
- Authentication via Face ID/Touch ID
- Customize signature color, font size, and more
- Integrates with your phone, Google, and Outlook contacts
- Send reminders to your signers for faster signatures
Post expiration of the free trial, upgrade in-app to one of the plans below.
● Essential
- Sign unlimited documents
- Send documents for signature (5 free docs per month)
- Use across mobile and web
- $99.99/year or $29.99/quarterly
● Pro
- Sign and send unlimited documents for signature
- Collect in-person signatures
- 3 reusable templates
- $179.99/year or $59.99/quarterly
Experience Signeasy on the web: Powerful features like Usage reports, Admin Dashboard, Integrations, and more help growing businesses like yours simplify and automate the contract journey.
Prices might vary based on your location. Subscriptions are charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off Auto-Renewal in the Account Settings after purchase.
Join 48,000 organizations and 10 million+ users worldwide who trust Signeasy to close deals faster by eliminating paperwork. Download the Signeasy app now.
Say hello: support@signeasy.com

bluejetty:00129331:ios.description:
The Jaguar Remote App keeps you in touch with your Jaguar when you're not in your vehicle, delivering greater control than ever before over security and comfort settings. 
The App's enhanced features, improved functionality and intuitive interface affords peace of mind, more efficient journey planning and greater well-being for you and your passengers.
Use the App to remotely:
- Prepare for a trip by checking fuel range and dashboard alerts
- Locate your vehicle on a map and get walking directions to it
- Check if doors or windows are open
- View journey information
- In the event of a breakdown, request Optimized Jaguar Assistance
- Plan future journeys and sync with your vehicle*
- Connect your favorite music and lifestyle applications to your InControl account for use in vehicle.*
For vehicles with InControl Remote Premium, the following additional features are available:
- Check on your vehicle security status and lock/unlock your vehicle if required
- Cool or heat your vehicle to the desired temperature prior to your journey* 
- Locate your vehicle in a crowded car park with 'beep and flash' functionality.
*Availability and function depending on vehicle capability, software and market.
Download the Jaguar InControl Remote App and then log in using your Jaguar InControl username and password to connect to your vehicle. This App requires subscription to one of the following packages fitted to the vehicle:
- InControl Protect
- InControl Remote
- InControl Remote Premium.
For further information, including which models Jaguar InControl is available for, visit www.jaguarincontrol.com
For technical assistance, visit the owner's section of www.jaguar.com.

Unofficial apps are not endorsed in any way by Jaguar Land Rover Limited. We have no control or responsibility over them. Use of unofficial apps may cause security risks or other harm to the vehicle and its functions. bluejetty:00151914:android.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Compete for a chance to win real money in this live mobile game every weekday. Use your smarts and five clever clues to submit the right answer first.
On "Best Guess Live," anyone can win. You just need one right answer at the right moment to claim your share of a prize money jackpot worth thousands. Get ready to think fast, because you'll be in a nationwide race to be one of the first to figure out the riddle.
A NEW DAILY ROUTINE
The game streams live in the app every weekday (Monday through Friday) at 8 PM ET | 5PM PT. The broadcast is in English, and the game is open to players anywhere in the United States. 
FUN FACTS; REAL MONEY
Got a brain packed with random trivia? Put it to good use: For each round, you'll need to figure out what secret item is hidden inside a misty and mysterious crystal ball. It could be a person, place, or thing — anything!
THINK IN RIDDLES
For each round, you'll get a series of five clues hinting at the answer. Every clue will build on the previous ones, starting out cryptic and gradually getting more obvious. After each clue, you'll have time to submit an answer. But don't risk it until you think you're right, since you only get one chance per round.
BE FAST TO BE FIRST
The sooner you get the answer, the better your odds of winning. Everyone who gets the correct answer on the earliest clue for a round will evenly split the jackpot. For example, if no one gets it after the first clue, and then you're one of three people to get it after the second clue, you'll get 1/3 of the prize.
TWO CHANCES TO WIN
Each livestream includes two rounds, and the second will be harder than the first — with a bigger prize to match. If the first crystal ball mystery stumped you, jump back in and try again!
Participation open to legal residents of the 50 United States and D.C., 18+. Void where prohibited. Access to a Netflix account and a PayPal account required for participation and prize fulfillment. "Best Guess Live" is a skill-based game. Official Terms & Conditions at bit.ly/BestGuessLive. Sponsor: Netflix, Inc. 
- Created by Ex Machina and Apploff Entertainment.

bluejetty:00084917:ios.name: Dinosaur Hunting Jurassic Zone
bluejetty:00084917:ios.summary: Welcome to the Dinosaur Hunting Game it is a thrilling and immersive shooting game, at its core a story-based dinosaur zoo game allows players to assume the role of a hunter that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish.
bluejetty:00084917:ios.description:
Welcome to the Dinosaur Hunting Game it is a thrilling and immersive shooting game, at its core a story-based dinosaur zoo game allows players to assume the role of a hunter that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. With its stunning graphics, challenging gameplay, and heart-pounding action, it is a must-play for any fan of dinosaurs and hunting games. So grab your rifle, gear up, and get ready for the hunt of a lifetime in this amazing game.
What sets Dinosaur Hunting Game apart from other shooting games is its attention to detail and realism the story-based dinosaur zoo game, not only fascinates players with the awe-inspiring world of dinosaurs but also offers a narrative framework that enhances the gaming experience. The dinosaurs in the game aren't just mindless targets; they react to your movements, can sense danger, and will stop at nothing to defend themselves. This adds a whole new level of intensity to the gameplay, making each encounter feel like a life-or-death situation. The sound design further enhances the immersion, with realistic roars, screams, and footsteps that will send shivers down your spine. 
Key Features:
Realistic Dinosaurs: 
Encounter different species of dinosaurs, each with unique behaviors and habitats. From the towering T-Rex to the swift raptor, each dinosaur is brought to life with stunning realism and lifelike animations.
Epic Encounters: 
Prepare for heart-pounding encounters with some of the most iconic dinosaurs. Whether you're observing the gentle giants or escaping the jaws of a predator, every interaction is a pulse-racing experience.
Are you tired of the same old boring shooting games? Are you craving some prehistoric excitement in your life? Look no further, because the dinosaur hunting game is here to take you on a wild adventure through time!
The thrill of the hunt is what really makes this game so captivating. You're not just passively observing these magnificent beasts - you're an active participant, using your wits and survival skills to track them down. 
So if you're the type of person who's always dreamed of experiencing the Dinosaur Hunting Zoo Game is an absolute must. Pack your gear, sharpen your tracking skills, and get ready for the adventure of a lifetime. Just don't forget to keep one eye out for any sneaky raptors lurking in the shadows!

bluejetty:00036104:ios.description:
Teladoc Health is the leader in virtual care. Our doctors diagnose, treat and prescribe when
needed. You can also use our app to help manage weight, diabetes, blood pressure and your
overall health.
Our services include:
24/7 CARE
-On-demand visits with board-certified doctors and nurse practitioners
-Help with time-sensitive concerns like cold and flu
-Prescriptions and limited refills
PRIMARY CARE
-Care provider who gets to know you over time
-Annual checkups and ongoing care
-Prescriptions, lab tests and referrals
CONDITION MANAGEMENT
-Help managing weight, blood sugar and blood pressure
-Connected scale, blood glucose meter or blood pressure monitor
-Tips and tools to help manage your health, including AI-powered food tracking
-Unlimited 1:1 health coaching
-GLP-1 support for those who qualify
MENTAL HEALTH
-Therapists, psychiatrists and coaches
-Personalized digital program
-Help with stress, anxiety, depression, relationships and more
DERMATOLOGY
-Photo review of skin concerns
-Treatment plan delivered by message within 24 hours
-Prescriptions and limited refills
NUTRITION
-Registered dietitians
-Help with your conditions and goals
-Personalized meal plans, grocery guides and more
SEXUAL HEALTH
-Confidential lab testing for STDs through STDcheck.com
-Results in under three days
SECOND OPINIONS
-Expert opinions on diagnoses and care
-Help choosing a treatment
-Many available specialties
***
Care at Teladoc Health is:
COVERED BY MOST MAJOR HEALTH INSURERS
More than 1 in 4 Americans have Teladoc Health coverage through their employer or health
insurance. When you create an account, we’ll help you check if you’re covered. But coverage isn’t
required. Many services are available without it.
PERSONALIZED
Our care providers get to know you and tend to every part of your well-being. We also offer digital
tools and programs designed around your needs. You can even connect Apple Health to sync your
data and get health insights.
CONVENIENT
We can address most common health needs anytime, anywhere. With some programs, you’ll get a
blood pressure monitor, scale or blood glucose meter sent to your home. We also offer in-home
lab services and prescription delivery in some locations. If you need in-person care, we can refer
you to in-network providers.
HIGH-QUALITY
Teladoc Health has been caring for people virtually for more than 20 years. More than 50 million
visits later, we’re the leader in virtual care. Newsweek has recognized us as one of the most
trustworthy companies in America. USA Today has called us one of America’s most trusted brands.
PRIVATE AND SECURE
Teladoc Health takes your privacy seriously. Your health information is protected by federal and
state laws, including HIPAA. View our privacy policies for more information on how Teladoc Health
uses your personal information: https://www.teladochealth.com/legal/privacy-policy.

bluejetty:00081175:ios.description:
AAJ which means TODAY in Hindi, is a new-age online platform to connect the enterprising Jain community from across various metropolitans in Australia. This social community app extends help to individuals following the principles of Jainism to empower themselves and give a boost to economic, emotional and spiritual well-being. 
AAJ is a brainchild of some of the leading Jain entrepreneurs based in Australia, this app brings the best life and business coaching resources on a consolidated online platform. AAJ is an ultimate business training and social community app that helps aspiring entrepreneurs to live in “today” and make their “tomorrow” better. 
Sharing their experiences and knowledge, each member gets a chance to learn, act and motivate other like-minded entrepreneurs, professionals and students to take up the less travelled road and reach greater heights in personal and professional lives. 
If you are new in Australia and wish to get in touch with like-minded people, learn more about the business culture in the country and achieve a vision based business/career growth; this is the perfect app for you! Download it now. 
How to Get Started? 
• Download the AAJ app 
• Move it to your home screen 
• Register yourself, fill up your information and get connected to several enterprising people
• Get access to endless collection of business coaching resources
Download the app to get unlimited access to methodical action classes, internal support groups, speeches by some of the best motivational speakers. 
Features of AAJ App
• Quick and easy access to some of the world's best training resources anywhere and at any time. 
• A large library of motivational and training videos by some of the most successful business leaders in the world. 
• Huge student directory to help employers acquire the best talents from within the community. 
• Individuals who recently moved to Australia can see a list of shared accommodations and find a safe and affordable place to live. 
• Job openings for students and professionals to assist them to find jobs according to their educational qualifications
• Access the knowledge from hundreds of business experts from within the group of business experts. 
Download the app now!!!

bluejetty:00022251:ios.description:

bluejetty:00069842:ios.description:
Vous cherchez leboncoin pour consulter des petites annonces ? Découvrez aussi Le bon coin des petites annonces. 
Le bon coin des petites annonces est une application indépendante de petites annonces entre particuliers. Si vous utilisez leboncoin pour chercher une bonne affaire ou proposer un objet, vous pouvez aussi explorer les annonces disponibles sur Le bon coin des petites annonces. 
Une autre option pour les recherches leboncoin 
Vous tapez « leboncoin » ou « le bon coin » lorsque vous voulez trouver des annonces ? Le bon coin des petites annonces vous permet de découvrir ce que d’autres particuliers proposent et de publier vos propres annonces depuis votre téléphone. 
Un objet que vous n’utilisez plus ? Créez une annonce pour le présenter. Une envie de faire une trouvaille ? Parcourez les petites annonces et repérez ce qui vous intéresse. Si vous connaissez déjà leboncoin, vous retrouverez ici l’idée qui vous plaît : mettre en relation des personnes autour de petites annonces. 
Pourquoi essayer Le bon coin des petites annonces en plus de leboncoin ? 
Parce qu’une recherche sur leboncoin n’est pas la seule façon de découvrir une annonce intéressante. Consultez Le bon coin des petites annonces pour voir d’autres annonces, proposer vos objets et multiplier vos occasions de trouver ce que vous cherchez. 
Que votre premier réflexe soit de rechercher « leboncoin », « le bon coin » ou « petites annonces », Le bon coin des petites annonces vous invite à découvrir une autre application dédiée aux échanges entre particuliers. 
Téléchargez Le bon coin des petites annonces et découvrez les petites annonces autrement. 
Le bon coin des petites annonces est indépendante et n’est pas affiliée à leboncoin.

bluejetty:00149383:ios.summary:
Phyn lets you speak the language of water.

bluejetty:00149383:ios.description:
Phyn lets you speak the language of water. 
From the free Phyn app you can understand how much water your family uses and where they are using it the most. Get alerted the minute a leak issue occurs and run diagnostic "Plumbing Checks" to proactively catch tiny leaks before they become big problems. 
PHYN SMART WATER ASSISTANT
Leak alerts:
SMS and push notifications alert you at the first sign of a possible issue. Take action by connecting to a HomeAdvisor plumber in minutes through the app.
Plumbing Checks:
Turn off your water at the main and run Phyn’s Plumbing Check feature. In minutes Phyn will detect pinhole leaks and poor seals in your water system. 
Water Use Plus: 
Track and view your water use daily and monthly to get ahead of your water costs, and see how your home compares to others. Over time, Phyn learns your system and communicates your water usage down to each fixture. See every water event in your home so you can teach Phyn about your water use. 
Pre-Freeze Warnings: 
Phyn’s patented pressure sensing sees the ice crystals forming in your pipes before they have a chance to freeze and burst, giving you precious time to take action and avoid damage.
Smart Home Integrated: Use voice commands to learn about your water use. Phyn works seamlessly with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant. And with IFTTT you can have Phyn trigger actions with other smart home devices. 
Manage multiple properties
Monitor water use and receive leak alerts for up to 6 properties from one account in the Phyn app. 
PHYN PLUS SMART WATER ASSISTANT + SHUTOFF
Auto and Remote Water Shutoff:
After Phyn learns about your home’s water use, it can turn your water off automatically to prevent damage from leaks. You also have the choice to turn your water off yourself via the app, from anywhere.
Leak alerts:
Phyn constantly monitors your home for leaks and potentially harmful changes in pressure and temperature. As soon as an issue is detected, Phyn sends you SMS and push notifications to tell you what is happening and gives you the power to turn your water off to mitigate water damage.
Water Use:
Stay ahead of your water bill. Graph views of your monthly, daily and even hourly water use. 
Water Use Plus: 
Track and view your water use daily and monthly and see how your home compares to others. Phyn learns about your plumbing system and communicates your water usage to each fixture type (showers, sinks, toilets, etc…). See every water event in your home so you can teach Phyn about your water use. 
Plumbing Checks:
Phyn automatically runs daily diagnostic checks to give you and your plumber insights into your plumbing so that you can ensure that your system is watertight.
Smart Home Integrated: 
Use voice commands to learn about your water use and control your shutoff valve. Phyn works seamlessly with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant. And with IFTTT you can have Phyn trigger actions with other smart home devices. 
Manage multiple properties:
Monitor water use and receive leak alerts for up to 6 properties from one account in the Phyn app.

bluejetty:00037903:ios.description:
Easy Geo Finder: Your Ultimate Real-Time GPS Location Tracker
Easy Geo Finder is a real-time GPS location tracking app designed to ensure you can safely monitor the whereabouts of your loved ones. Whether you're a parent wanting to keep track of your children, a business needing to monitor employees, or an individual interested in your daily movements, Easy Geo Finder is the solution for you.
Comprehensive Tracking and Historical Data
One of the standout features of Easy Geo Finder includes its ability to showcase daily or weekly movements on a map. This visualization not only gives a sense of the user's current location but also chronicles when they visited specific places. This feature is perfect for understanding travel patterns, ensuring the safety of family members, or maintaining records for business purposes.
Versatile and Multi-Purpose
Easy Geo Finder proves its versatility by catering to a range of tracking needs. Parents can maintain a vigilant eye on their children's movements, ensuring their safety. Businesses can benefit by keeping track of their employees' locations, optimizing field operations, and ensuring accountability. For those curious about their own movements, Easy Geo Finder provides detailed logs and insights.
Key Features of Easy Geo Finder:
Real-Time Location Tracking: Get immediate updates on the location of your loved ones or employees.
Location History: View past movements and patterns, gaining valuable insights into travel habits and frequently visited places.
Duration Logs: Understand how much time is spent at particular locations, aiding in productivity assessments and personal tracking.
Battery Status: Receive immediate updates on your contacts' battery levels, ensuring they are reachable when needed.
Sound Profile Checks: Know if a contact’s phone is on silent, especially useful when they’re unreachable.
Battery Efficiency: While continuous GPS usage in the background may impact battery longevity, Easy Geo Finder is optimized to minimize battery drain.
Peace of Mind and Security
With Easy Geo Finder, you're never left in the dark about your family's whereabouts. Families can get alerts when their children depart or arrive home, and companies gain insights into their employees' field activities. Such a feature set ensures peace of mind for families and operational efficiency for businesses.
Remember, with great power comes great responsibility. Use Easy Geo Finder wisely and always respect individual privacy. Our mission with Easy Geo Finder is to offer you peace of mind, ensuring that you always know the real-time location of your loved ones.
User-Friendly and Reliable
Every feature of Easy Geo Finder is meticulously designed to give you the most accurate and timely information. Whether you're tracking a child's journey home from school or checking in on an older family member, Easy Geo Finder is your reliable partner. What sets Easy Geo Finder apart is its precision and user-friendly interface, making location tracking easier than ever.
Why Choose Easy Geo Finder?
When it comes to keeping your family safe and staying informed, choose Easy Geo Finder, the most trusted name in mobile location tracking. Our app not only provides real-time tracking but also offers comprehensive logs and insights, ensuring you have all the information you need at your fingertips.
Privacy Policy: https://mbc-soft.com/support/privacy2.html
Terms of Use: https://mbc-soft.com/support/terms-and-conditions.html

bluejetty:00121087:ios.name: Pic-a-Pix: Nonogram Color
bluejetty:00121087:ios.summary: Paint squares as you solve the puzzle and discover a beautiful pixel-art picture! Each puzzle consists of a blank grid with clues on the left of every row and on the top of every column. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by painting
bluejetty:00121087:ios.description:
Paint squares as you solve the puzzle and discover a beautiful pixel-art picture! Each puzzle consists of a blank grid with clues on the left of every row and on the top of every column. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by painting blocks in each row and column so their length and sequence corresponds to the clues.
Pic-a-Pix are exciting logic puzzles that form whimsical pixel-art pictures when solved. Challenging, deductive and artistic, this original Japanese invention offers the ultimate mix of logic, art and fun while providing solvers with many hours of mentally stimulating entertainment.
The game enables zooming the entire puzzle, or just the grid area while keeping the clue-panes locked. Other features include a unique fingertip cursor for playing large puzzles with ease and precision, and a show/hide/lock rulers option helping focus on one row and column at a time.
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Pic-a-Pix contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 155 free Pic-a-Pix puzzles in color and B&W
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually created by artists, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Grid sizes up to 30x45 (45x60 for iPad)
• Difficulty levels from very easy to super challenging
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Zoom entire puzzle or just the grid area
• Clue-pane locking option for optimal puzzle viewing
• Rulers show, hide or lock option for easier row and column viewing
• Exclusive fingertip cursor design for solving large puzzles
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited hints
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Mark Squares mode for temporary markings on the grid
• Clue auto check-off when row or column is completed
• Automatically mark obvious empty squares with dots
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Error checking option when row or column is completed
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
Pic-a-Pix have also become popular under other names such as Picross, Nanogram, Pictogram, Griddlers, Hanjie and many more. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

bluejetty:00165425:ios.description:
Simple. Private. Yours.
A crypto wallet built for everyday people. Store and manage your crypto privately. No complicated setups, no seed phrases. Just sign in and go.
Managing your crypto has never been easier. Jiggle is a next-generation, self-custody crypto wallet built for simplicity, security, and speed. Store, send, and manage your crypto with ease, and buy or sell in a few taps through our licensed Partners. 
Already using Jiggle on the web? Your account comes with you. Download the app, sign in, and pick up exactly where you left off.
WHY CHOOSE JIGGLE?
One Account, Everywhere: Use the same Jiggle wallet on mobile and web. Switch between devices and your crypto is always in sync, always within reach.
Easy Onboarding: Start with just a social login. No confusing seed phrases or technical barriers, just sign up in seconds.
Self-Custody, Full Control: Your crypto, always.
Get Started Fast with Jiggle Link: Our guided buying flow takes you from sign-up to your first crypto in a few taps.
Effortless Transactions: Store, send, and manage with ease, and buy or sell through our licensed Partners.
Designed for Everyone: Whether you're a crypto newbie or a pro, Jiggle makes crypto feel like a breeze.
MADE FOR EVERYONE
Designed to break down barriers to entry, Jiggle is a fast and simple way to create a crypto wallet and get started buying, selling, and sending crypto. As a self-custody wallet, you stay in full control of your assets and how you manage them. Already on the web? The same account works across both.
BUY & SELL THROUGH OUR PARTNERS
Top up or withdraw through our licensed Partners, with a range of payment options. To buy, sell, or transfer assets, you connect with our trusted, licensed third-party Partners directly from the app. Your assets stay in your control at all times.
REAL HUMANS, REAL HELP, 24/7
Our dedicated support team is available around the clock to help with anything you need. Stay informed with real-time updates via our Service Status page, and find quick answers through our Help Centre. We're always here to support you.
GET SET UP IN MINUTES
Sign up instantly with Google or Apple, or sign in to your existing Jiggle account.
Start buying, sending, and receiving crypto right away.
SUPPORTED ASSETS
Bitcoin (BTC)
Ethereum (ETH)
Bitcoin Cash (BCH)
Litecoin (LTC)
Tether (USDT, ERC20)
USD Coin (USDC, ERC20)
Join a rapidly growing community of 200K+ users enjoying the benefits of Jiggle.

bluejetty:00022224:ios.summary:
Thinkable Health: Your Companion for Coping with Medical and Mental Conditions
Can better thinking patterns help you cope with chronic pain, migraines, tinnitus, and other medical conditions?
The answer is YES!
Research shows Thinkable he
bluejetty:00022224:ios.description:
Thinkable Health: Your Companion for Coping with Medical and Mental Conditions
Can better thinking patterns help you cope with chronic pain, migraines, tinnitus, and other medical conditions?
The answer is YES!
Research shows Thinkable helps users improve their mental health and coping skills by training daily for just 14 days. Created by Dr. Guy Doron, clinical therapist and mobile health expert, Thinkable is backed by research and designed to enhance your thought processes, boost confidence, and improve mood—all without typing a single line.
Thinkable is a smart, personalized tool to help you face the challenges of chronic conditions, improve your mental well-being, and foster personal growth.
HOW IT WORKS
- Learn to embrace positive thinking and develop resilience in the face of chronic symptoms
- Track your mood and pain levels to see how your inner dialogue transforms
- View a visual journal of your progress and symptom management
- Train daily for 14 days to make self-talk your most powerful coping tool
IS IT LIKE THERAPY?
Thinkable incorporates key elements of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), transforming them into an accessible, engaging app. While not a replacement for person-to-person therapy, it empowers you to practice self-care by engaging with your thoughts and developing healthy thinking patterns—all while tracking your mood and symptoms.
WHAT DO I NEED TO DO TO COPE BETTER?
- Use the mood and symptom tracker to monitor changes
- Discard unhelpful thoughts about your condition
- Embrace supportive thinking and pain management strategies
- Practice relaxation techniques to calm both mind and body
- Engage in daily exercises for maximum benefit
THE THINKABLE MENTAL MAP FOR CHRONIC CONDITIONS
Living with chronic medical conditions can be challenging. Thinkable helps you improve both your mental health and your ability to cope with daily symptoms. By tracking your mood, pain levels, and confidence, you can see tangible progress in managing your condition.
WHO IS IT FOR?
- Individuals living with chronic pain, migraines, or tinnitus
- Those experiencing anxiety or depression related to their medical condition
- People seeking better balance and a calmer mind while managing symptoms
- Caregivers and family members supporting loved ones with chronic conditions
- Anyone looking to develop resilience and positive coping strategies
MODULES WE COVER
- Chronic pain management
- Migraine coping strategies
- Tinnitus acceptance and adaptation
- Health anxiety and worry
- Mood and motivation in chronic illness
- Body image and chronic conditions
- Relationships and chronic illness
- Trauma related to medical experiences
- Caregiver support and self-care
PRIVACY AND DATA PROTECTION
We prioritize your privacy and personal data security. To enhance the app's effectiveness, we collect data such as mood tracking and your responses to different thoughts. This data is anonymized before being sent to our servers for app improvement. Personal data is saved locally on your device and is not accessible to our system.
THE SUBSCRIPTION
Thinkable offers all GGtude's modules in one seamless experience. Try the free basic journeys, then upgrade to access 500+ levels of updated content tailored for chronic condition management.
Embrace a new way of thinking and coping with Thinkable—your partner in navigating the challenges of chronic medical conditions.
Privacy policy:
http://ggtude.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use:
http://ggtude.com/terms-of-use
More questions?
Email us to hello@ggtude.com
DISCLAIMER: The information on this app is not intended to be a substitution for diagnosis, treatment, or informed professional advice. You should not take any action or avoid taking any action without consulting with a qualified mental health professional.

bluejetty:00061942:ios.description:
Is your toddler learning to walk, eat and play by themselves? And now you'd like them to start recognizing letters and words? 
This fun game can help make the education process enjoyable and productive at the same time. 
The game is full of joyful artworks, sounds, and effects, so your kid won't get bored easily. Each letter is spoken out loud every time the kid interacts with the alphabet in the games. 
Your child will be able to:
• Recognize the letters of the English alphabet 
 • Recognize the sounds of the letters 
 • Get a head start into learning how to read 
 • Find themselves motivated to learn more about the letters and words surrounding them
Additional Features:
 • The app is completely free of Ads
 • Is available offline
 • Parental Gate is available to protect your child from going outside the app and making purchases. 
Children have immense capacity to absorb new information, but their minds wander a lot too. So if you want them to learn new things, you should make the learning more fun. This way, you can guarantee that your toddler has a fun time and new knowledge almost every day. 
And if you and your children enjoyed ABC games for kids, please leave a review and rate the app.

bluejetty:00132070:ios.name: The Buffalo News App
bluejetty:00132070:ios.summary: Your story lives in Buffalo. From reporting on the Bills and Sabres to the news that matters most in your community, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from Western New York's largest newsroom covering Buffalo, to Albany, Washington D.C.
bluejetty:00132070:ios.description:
Your story lives in Buffalo. From reporting on the Bills and Sabres to the news that matters most in your community, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from Western New York's largest newsroom covering Buffalo, to Albany, Washington D.C., and beyond – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts. Support local journalism by subscribing today for unlimited digital access.
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Continue watching – pause a video and pick up where you left off across devices
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access to breaking news updates, analysis, and more.
Get The Buffalo News in Your Inbox
Get convenient, curated updates delivered to your Inbox. Sign up for Breaking News updates as they happen, the Afternoon Update for a roundup of the latest local top stories, [BN] Hockey for day of and day after Sabres game analysis, Food & Drink for foodies, Garage Sales for bargain hunters and many more.
Visit https://buffalonews.com/newsletters/ to view and subscribe to all of The Buffalo News Newsletters.
Keep Up with The Buffalo News
Follow us on Facebook and other social platforms:
https://x.com/TheBuffaloNews
https://www.instagram.com/thebuffalonews/
https://www.facebook.com/TheBuffaloNews/
https://www.pinterest.com/thebuffalonews/
https://www.youtube.com/user/BuffaloNewsVideo
https://www.linkedin.com/company/thebuffalonews/
About The Buffalo News
The Buffalo News is Western New York’s leading resource for local journalism. Founded in 1880, we operate the largest newsroom in the region, publishing 7-days a week in print and around the clock on https://buffalonews.com/.
We'd love to hear what you think! For any technical issues or questions, contact us at subscriberservices@buffnews.com
https://buffalonews.com/terms 
The Buffalo News is part of Lee Enterprises.

- Rastreabilidade: O aplicativo permite fácil visualização do histórico das ações realizadas com seu certificado digital
- Cadastro de estações: Você terá total controle para habilitar ou desabilitar dispositivos e estações para uso do seu certificado digital
Saiba mais sobre o aplicativo SerproID em: https://loja.serpro.gov.br/serproid

bluejetty:00114213:ios.summary: The Tea App is an entertainment-focused AI chat companion designed for moments when you want a second opinion. Whether you’re thinking through a situation, reflecting on a relationship, or just talking something out, The Tea App offers a co
bluejetty:00114213:ios.description:
The Tea App is an entertainment-focused AI chat companion designed for moments when you want a second opinion. Whether you’re thinking through a situation, reflecting on a relationship, or just talking something out, The Tea App offers a conversational space to help you see things from another perspective.
The app is free to download and use, with optional paid features.
Built as a light, engaging, and thoughtful experience, The Tea App lets you chat freely and explore ideas without judgment. Conversations are designed to feel natural and supportive, making it easy to pause, reflect, and consider different viewpoints in everyday situations.
The Tea App is not a replacement for professional advice. It is created purely for entertainment and casual conversation, offering general perspectives to help users think, reflect, and unwind.
If you ever feel stuck in your thoughts, unsure how to view a situation, or simply want to “spill the tea” and get another take, The Tea App is there to chat.
Optional Paid Membership Information:
The Tea App offers an optional unlimited access membership available through in-app purchase. This membership enhances the experience by providing expanded access to AI-powered conversations and general content.
- Unlimited access requires a paid subscription
- Subscription options include monthly and yearly plans
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period
- You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in Apple ID account settings
By using The Tea App, you agree to our Terms of Use:
https://sites.google.com/view/the-tea-app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00117029:ios.description:
World Wide Bus Driving Simulator – Explore the World from the Driver's Seat
Ready to travel the world behind the wheel of a bus? In World Wide Bus Driving Simulator, your dream of becoming a professional bus driver comes to life. Drive licensed, high-quality buses through detailed cities and routes around the globe. From the busy streets to the scenic highways of the USA and the diverse landscapes, every journey is unique and filled with adventure.
- Create Routes Across Countries -
Take on the role of the captain and plan your journey across real-time maps and environments. Set your routes between major cities, manage your passengers, and complete objectives along the way. Your mission is to transport passengers safely and on time, while exploring new locations and managing realistic driving tasks.
- Realistic Bus Driving Experience -
This is not just a game; it’s a real-world driving simulator. Experience smooth handling, realistic traffic systems, and dynamic weather conditions like rain, fog, and clear skies. Manage fuel levels, wash your bus, stop at rest areas, and listen to in-game announcements. Pick up passengers, issue tickets with variable fares, and enjoy detailed scenery as you travel.
- Build Your Own Bus Empire -
Grow your company by hiring drivers, expanding your bus fleet, and unlocking new regions. Choose from a wide variety of buses, each with realistic driving physics, different gear ratios, and handling types. Customize and upgrade your buses with paint jobs, accessories, and interior features like Wi-Fi and air conditioning to enhance passenger comfort.
- Game Features -
Real-time map navigation and route creation
Multiple cities and countries with expanding world map
Licensed buses with accurate physics and control systems
Dynamic weather and day-night cycle
Passenger system with ticket generation and meal services
Refueling, maintenance, and repair systems
Bus wash, toll plazas, and rest stations
Bus terminals with specific Parking slots and realistic traffic
Multiple camera angles, including interior and dashboard views
Voice announcements, interactive passenger conversations
Customization options: colors, rims, lights, accessories
Realistic interiors with trunk space and working doors
- Advanced Controls and Gameplay -
Choose your control style: tilt, buttons, or steering wheel. Use cruise control to maintain speed and engage the handbrake when parking. Secure passengers with seat belts and drive responsibly, just like in the real world. From loading luggage to managing long-distance routes, every detail matters.
- Coming Soon -
Expect regular updates with new bus models including hybrid, electric, and luxury coaches. The map will expand with more cities and unique routes, along with additional gameplay systems and challenges.
- Your Bus Driving Journey Starts Now -
Whether you want to relax with a scenic drive or challenge your skills in heavy traffic, World Wide Bus Driving Simulator delivers an immersive and rewarding experience. Download now and start building your global transport empire.
